info.title: Factuarea Public API
info.description:
Public REST API for invoicing in Spain — manage invoices, quotes, proformas, delivery notes, products, clients and webhooks.

## Authentication

The API authenticates with a secret **API key**, sent on every request as:

```
Authorization: Bearer fact_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

or, alternatively, in the `X-API-Key` header. The key is issued from the Factuarea portal and must NEVER be exposed in public clients (browser, mobile apps).

## Environments: `live` and `test`

Each API key belongs to one of two environments, unambiguously identifiable by its **prefix**:

| Prefix | Environment | Data it operates on | External effects |
|---------|---------|---------------------------|------------------|
| `fact_live_` | **live** (production) | Your real company | Real: legal fiscal numbering, VeriFactu→AEAT, emails to clients, outbound webhooks |
| `fact_test_` | **test** (sandbox) | An isolated *sandbox* company | **Neutralized** (see below) |

The prefix is the **source of truth** for the environment: a `fact_test_` key always operates in test mode and a `fact_live_` key always in live. There is no request parameter that changes the environment — it is determined by the key.

### Data isolation (sandbox)

`fact_test_` keys operate on a dedicated **sandbox company** (a technical "twin company" of the account holder, automatically provisioned the first time test mode is used, which inherits the plan of your real company for faithful *feature-gating*). Thanks to per-company data isolation:

- Resources created with a `fact_test_` key are **not visible** from a `fact_live_` key, and vice versa.
- Test fiscal numbering uses the sandbox's own series and **never** consumes or alters the sequential numbering of your production series.

The functional surface is **identical** in both environments: the same endpoints and operations are available in test as in live.

### External effects neutralized in test

When you operate with a `fact_test_` key (sandbox environment), outbound effects are **disabled** so you can test your integration without real consequences:

- **VeriFactu**: the Alta record is created locally, but **not transmitted to AEAT**.
- **Email**: document emails are **not delivered** to real recipients.
- **Webhooks**: events are **not delivered** to your external HTTP endpoints.

In `live`, all these effects fire normally.

> **Recommendation**: always integrate and test first with a `fact_test_` key. Once your flow works, switch to the `fact_live_` prefix to operate in production.

post.description:
Accept a tax ID transfer with its `secret`: the tax ID moves to the account in the path. Irreversible.
- The body carries only `secret`; requires `Idempotency-Key` (else 422 `idempotency_key_required`).
- Plan gates run first, e.g. 402 `additional_nif_plan_required`, 402 `payment_method_required`.
- 422 `nif_transfer_invalid` for an unusable secret; 422 `nif_transfer_expired`. Requires the `nif_transfers:write` scope, which `*` does not cover: the API key must list it explicitly.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of your account. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.account.id`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifier of this request (`req_` + ULID, or the value you sent, up to 40 characters). Quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate limit window (60 seconds). Prefer this field over its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Limit`, which carries the same value and is kept only for backwards compatibility.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window before receiving a 429. Prefer this field over its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, which carries the same value and is kept only for backwards compatibility.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): SECONDS REMAINING until the rate limit window resets — a duration, not a clock reading. Its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Reset` expresses the SAME instant as a Unix timestamp, so the two values are deliberately different and must not be swapped: read this one as a delay and that one as an epoch.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Legacy rate-limit header, kept for backwards compatibility; the canonical field is `RateLimit-Limit`. Maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate limit window (60 seconds).

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Legacy rate-limit header, kept for backwards compatibility; the canonical field is `RateLimit-Remaining`. Number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window before receiving a 429.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Legacy rate-limit header, kept for backwards compatibility; the canonical field is `RateLimit-Reset`. Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the rate limit window resets and the counter returns to its maximum. Careful: the canonical `RateLimit-Reset` publishes the same instant as SECONDS REMAINING, so the two values never match.

Factuarea-Version.description: Effective API version (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Stripe-style date versioning) resolved for this request: the `Factuarea-Version` request header if sent, otherwise the version pinned on the API key, otherwise the latest version. Present on every response.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value `"true"` only when this response was replayed from the idempotency cache for a repeated `Idempotency-Key` (same key, same request fingerprint). Absent on the first, freshly executed request.

403.description: The request is authenticated but not allowed: the API key lacks the required scope (`insufficient_scope`), the company does not include the public API (`addon_not_active`), the module is not available with a test key (`module_not_available_in_sandbox`), the credential does not reach the titular company of the receiving account or its holder does not administer it (`forbidden_action`), the effective access of the credential to that company is read-only (`company_read_only`), the plan of the receiving account does not allow additional tax IDs (`additional_nif_not_in_plan`) or its billing is managed by another account (`billing_managed_by_provider`). The plan gate of the transfer scopes runs when the credential is issued, never on this request.

error.message: Esta operación requiere el scope 'nif_transfers:write'. Tu API key solo tiene los scopes: ninguno.
Tu plan no incluye NIF adicionales: pasa a Profesional o superior para añadir más NIF a tu cuenta.
La facturación de esta cuenta la gestiona otra cuenta: pide el cambio a quien la paga.
Tu acceso a esta empresa es de solo lectura.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifier of this request (`req_` + ULID, or the value you sent, up to 40 characters). Quote it when contacting support.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `resource_conflict` with `subcode` `empty_registration_company_not_empty`: the empty company created at sign-up was going to be replaced by the transferred NIF, but it already has business data. Nothing was transferred. `customer_offer_phase_incompatible` with `param` `quantity`: the conditions already acquired for the additional tax ID seat cannot be preserved by this purchase. `details.reason` is `phase_incompatible`. No company is created or activated and no charge is attempted. `customer_offer_operation_in_progress`: an operation for the same concept is still pending. Continue that operation instead of starting another. `customer_offer_legacy_outcome_unknown`: a previous billing operation of the account is still being verified. `details.operation_id` is that operation; read its state before repeating the request.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifier of this request (`req_` + ULID, or the value you sent, up to 40 characters). Quote it when contacting support.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). Nothing was created or modified — resolve the cause and retry the same request. Version note: `error.type` is `payment_required_error` from `Factuarea-Version: 2026-09-01` onwards; earlier versions receive `invalid_request_error` for the three codes that predate that cut (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed`; every other 402 code, such as `addon_required`, `plan_limit_exceeded` or the additional tax ID codes, is newer and always carries `payment_required_error`). `error.code` is stable across every version.

error.message: La cuenta no tiene un método de pago configurado para cobrar el NIF adicional: configúralo y vuelve a intentarlo.
Tu cuenta no tiene un plan vigente: activa el plan Profesional o superior para añadir NIF.
No se pudo cobrar el NIF adicional de la cuenta. Detalle: card_declined.

post.description: Mark a proforma as accepted by the client. Returns 422 if the proforma is in a status that cannot transition to `accepted`.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: proforma
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the proforma.

requestBody.description: Proforma acceptance accepts the `presentation_precondition` object with exactly seven fields and the optional `expected_presentation_uuid`. With revisioned presentation enabled for the company, the object is required for the first capture: when the proforma was never shared and has no retained capture, or its draft was edited or re-templated after it was captured (a missing object returns 428 `pdf_presentation_precondition_required` before anything is written). Build it from a `persisted_draft` preview (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/pdf-template-previews`): the artifact's `selection_version`, `source_token`, `expected_preview_context_fingerprint`, `template_revision_id` and `commercial_identity_revision_id`, with `purpose` `complete` and `format` `a4`; accepting a draft numbers it and captures what was reviewed. A proforma with a retained capture (sent as a draft) is accepted without the object and its capture follows the number; `expected_presentation_uuid` cites that capture and returns 409 `pdf_presentation_conflict` if it is no longer the current one. With revisioned presentation disabled both are ignored.

first_capture.summary: Proforma never shared · reviewed persisted_draft preview
first_capture.description: The proforma has no retained capture: send the seven fields of the `persisted_draft` preview the person reviewed. Accepting a draft numbers it and captures that original.

retained_capture.summary: Proforma already captured · cite the reviewed capture
retained_capture.description: The proforma already has a retained capture (it was sent as a draft): the acceptance follows it without the seven fields. `expected_presentation_uuid` is optional and returns 409 if that capture is no longer the current one.

requestBody.description: Internal reversible write: idempotency follows the current policy; a supplied key is replayed before CAS. Unknown fields are rejected. Until the company is prepared for revisioned templates (tenant initialization pending or revisioned rendering off) every library write returns 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` before any precondition or effect; reads stay available and no `Retry-After` applies.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_template_version_conflict`: the `expected_version` you sent is no longer the current version of the template or commercial identity, because another change was saved in the meantime. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read it again, or keep your local copy and repeat the request with the current version. Nothing was changed. `pdf_library_impact_conflict`: the impact you reviewed (`expected_impact_fingerprint`, from the impact operation) no longer matches what the change would affect: a document, series, contact or default that depends on it changed in the meantime. Read the impact again and confirm the new one. Nothing was changed.

post.description: Archive a template and resolve every association that depends on it in one atomic step. First read the impact of the template with `action=archive`, then send its `expected_impact_fingerprint`, the `expected_version` of the template and one decision per listed association in `replacements` (`replace`, `clear` or `pause`). A changed impact returns 409 `pdf_library_impact_conflict` and nothing is modified. Archived templates keep their revisions and the documents that already used them. Requires `pdf_templates:write` and supports `Idempotency-Key`.

requestBody.description: Internal reversible write: idempotency follows the current policy; a supplied key is replayed before CAS. Unknown fields are rejected. Until the company is prepared for revisioned templates (tenant initialization pending or revisioned rendering off) every library write returns 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` before any precondition or effect; reads stay available and no `Retry-After` applies.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_template_version_conflict`: the `expected_version` you sent is no longer the current version of the template or commercial identity, because another change was saved in the meantime. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read it again, or keep your local copy and repeat the request with the current version. Nothing was changed. `pdf_library_impact_conflict`: the impact you reviewed (`expected_impact_fingerprint`, from the impact operation) no longer matches what the change would affect: a document, series, contact or default that depends on it changed in the meantime. Read the impact again and confirm the new one. Nothing was changed.

Its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Reset` expresses the SAME instant as a Unix timestamp, so the two values are deliberately different and must not be swapped: read this one as a delay and that one as an epoch.

Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the rate limit window resets and the counter returns to its maximum. parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. requestBody.description: Bulk delivery-note send accepts an optional UUID-keyed map of complete seven-field presentation preconditions. The presentation precondition fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

200.description: With revisioned presentation enabled, a row that carries its `presentation_preconditions` entry needs the measured identity of the PDF engine. If the engine does not answer (down, restarting or in the middle of a deployment) that row is NOT applied and is returned in `failures[]` with `error_code` `pdf_engine_unreachable` (transient); the batch goes on with the other rows and the request does not fail. Repeat only the ids listed in `failures[]` with that code, after a short delay, so documents that already went out are not processed again. `pdf_engine_profile_unavailable` in a row is a terminal failure of the engine.

requestBody.description: Bulk invoice send accepts an optional UUID-keyed map of complete seven-field presentation preconditions. When revisioned presentation is enabled for the company, every DRAFT row must carry its precondition because sending issues it: a draft row without one is not issued or sent and is reported in `failures[]` with 428 `pdf_presentation_precondition_required`, while the other rows continue. Rows that are not drafts are re-sent as they are. With revisioned presentation disabled the precondition fields are ignored.

200.description: With revisioned presentation enabled, a row that carries its `presentation_preconditions` entry needs the measured identity of the PDF engine. Repeat only the ids listed in `failures[]` with that code, after a short delay, so documents that already went out are not processed again. `pdf_engine_profile_unavailable` in a row is a terminal failure of the engine.

post.description:

parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. requestBody.description: Bulk invoice status changes accept an optional UUID-keyed map of complete seven-field presentation preconditions. When revisioned presentation is enabled for the company and the change issues invoices (`issued` or the legacy `sent`), every draft row must carry its precondition: a draft row without one is not issued and is reported in `failures[]` with 428 `pdf_presentation_precondition_required`, while the other rows continue. With revisioned presentation disabled the precondition fields are ignored.

200.description: With revisioned presentation enabled, a row that carries its `presentation_preconditions` entry needs the measured identity of the PDF engine. If the engine does not answer (down, restarting or in the middle of a deployment) that row is NOT applied and is returned in `failures[]` with `error_code` `pdf_engine_unreachable` (transient); the batch goes on with the other rows and the request does not fail. Repeat only the ids listed in `failures[]` with that code, after a short delay, so documents that already went out are not processed again. `pdf_engine_profile_unavailable` in a row is a terminal failure of the engine.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): SECONDS REMAINING until the rate limit window resets — a duration, not a clock reading. post.description:
Moves up to 50 recurring invoices (by id) to `active` or `paused`, each through the same transition as `pause` and `resume`.
- Returns a `BulkPartialSuccessResult`; the batch never aborts.
- Not found, already in target status, cancelled or exhausted ids come back in `failures[]` with `error_code`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

post.description: Transition a delivery note to the `cancelled` state. Canonical REST replacement for the deprecated `POST /change_status`. Returns 409 `invalid_status_transition` if the note cannot be cancelled (e.g. already invoiced). Supports `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `resource_conflict`: the document is in a state that does not allow this operation and no more specific error code applies. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

error.message: El DeCA DC-2026-042 no se puede anular: está en estado «Finalizado». Solo se anula un DeCA emitido y en curso.

La operación «public-api.v1.transport_documents.cancel» exige la cabecera Idempotency-Key desde el 2026-12-01. Envía una clave única por operación (un UUID sirve) y, si reintenta, repite exactamente la misma clave para que la operación no se ejecute dos veces.

El PDF del DeCA ocuparía 5,31 MB y el máximo permitido es 5 MB. No se ha guardado ningún cambio. Reduce el contenido del documento (menos envíos o líneas de mercancía, descripciones u observaciones más cortas) o reparte los envíos en varios DeCA.

patch.description:

422.description: Validation failed, or the clock entry breaks a time tracking rule. Domain rejections share the code `business_rule_violation` and are told apart by `error.subcode`: `clocking_outside_employment_period` (the resulting entry falls before the employee’s `hire_date` or after their `termination_date`; `error.param` is `occurred_at` and the message names the date that is breached — nothing is written) or a workday transition that is not allowed, such as `already_clocked_in`. The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any.

post.description:
Freeze the immutable monthly close of the time record register for a finished `(year, month)`.
- Snapshots balances and absences of every employee in the period and locks it against retroactive entries.
- A month not yet ended returns 422; an already closed period returns 409.
- Returns 201 with the close and a `Location` header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

get.description:
List the company’s automation rules with cursor-based pagination, ordered by `id` ascending.
- Filter by `status`, `trigger_type`, creation window (`created[gte]`, `created[lte]`) and search by name with `search`.
- A cursor issued for another company yields an empty page.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of objects to return, between 1 and 100 (default 25).

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination: pass the `id` of the last object on the previous page (the `next_cursor` of the previous response).

parameters.name: ending_before
parameters.description: Cursor for backward pagination: pass the `id` of the first object on the current page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Lifecycle status of the automation rule. A rule only fires while it is `active`. Exact match on `status`.

parameters.name: trigger_type
parameters.description: Trigger of the rule in `resource.action` form (e.g. `invoice.paid`), as listed by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/automations/catalog`. Exact match on `trigger_type`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope of the rule: `empresa` watches only your own company, `cartera` watches the other tax IDs your account operates. Exact match on `scope`.

parameters.name: created[gte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[lte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[gt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: created[lt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search. Escaped `LIKE %term%` (case-insensitive, max 80 chars) across the resource's key text columns, combined with the other filters (AND) and compatible with the cursor.

get.description: List canonical contacts with cursor pagination. Filter by `roles` (`customer`, `supplier`, `lead`, or the synthetic `unassigned` relationship; CSV or array), `role_match` (`any` or `all`), role status, kind, fiscal identity, external ID, tags, metadata, archive state and creation date. parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of objects to return, between 1 and 100 (default 25).

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination: pass the `id` of the last object on the previous page (the `next_cursor` of the previous response).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search (up to 255 characters) over name, commercial name, tax identifiers, email, external ID and phone numbers.

parameters.name: roles[]
parameters.description: Only contacts with these roles: `customer`, `supplier`, `lead` or `unassigned` (repeat it or send a comma-separated list).

parameters.name: role_match
parameters.description: `any` (default) matches at least one of the `roles[]`; `all` requires all of them.

parameters.name: role_status
parameters.description: Only roles in this status: `active` or `inactive`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Contact kind: `person` or `company`.

parameters.name: fiscal_identity
parameters.description: Exact match on any tax identifier of the contact (NIF/NIE/CIF, EU VAT number or alternative ID document).

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Exact match on the `external_id` you assigned.

parameters.name: tags[]
parameters.description: Only contacts carrying all these tags (case-insensitive, up to 50).

parameters.name: is_archived
parameters.description: `true` returns only archived contacts and `false` only the rest; omit it to return both.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name, exact match.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Exact match on the province.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Exact ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

parameters.name: has_email
parameters.description: `true` returns only contacts with an email address and `false` only those without one.

parameters.name: has_phone
parameters.description: `true` returns only contacts with a phone number and `false` only those without one.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Only records created on or after this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: Only records created on or before this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: metadata[]
parameters.description: Metadata filter as `metadata[key]=value` (exact match, up to 20 pairs, all must match).

parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `resource_already_exists` with `subcode` `external_id_already_exists`: another employee of the company already uses that `external_id`; `details.existing_resource_id` is its identifier. `employee_batch_billing_state_conflict`: the current billing of the account does not allow completing the batch safely. `details.reason` is `offer_requires_chargeable_seats`, `fiscal_configuration` or `phase_incompatible`. Nothing was charged. `resource_already_exists` with `subcode` `external_id_already_exists`: an `external_id` of the batch is already used by an employee of the company. Nothing was charged or created. `employee_batch_state_conflict` with `subcode` `employee_batch_missing_payment_proof`: the payment of this operation is not proven yet. Read its current state. `employee_batch_state_conflict` with `subcode` `employee_batch_payment_outcome_unknown`: the payment of the batch is still being verified. `details.operation_id` is the operation to keep following; do not charge again. `employee_batch_quote_changed`: the quote changed since the version you accepted (`param` `quote_version`). Refresh it and accept the current version. `employee_seat_mutation_outcome_unknown`: an employee seat operation is still being verified. `details.operation_id` is its reference and `details.operation_kind` is `legacy_employee`; do not repeat the charge and contact support with the reference. `employee_seat_phase_incompatible` with `param` `quantity`: the subscription has scheduled conditions that must be reviewed before its seats change. `details.reason` is `phase_incompatible`. Nothing was charged. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds. `employee_batch_state_conflict`: the batch is in a state that does not allow this action. Read its current state. `employee_seat_operation_in_progress`: another employee operation is pending. `details.operation_id` identifies it when known; read its state before starting another.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). Nothing was created or modified — resolve the cause and retry the same request. 422.description: Validation failed, or the invoice cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. marking an already-paid invoice as paid, or editing an issued invoice — use a corrective instead). The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. Issuing or annulling an invoice can also be rejected with `verifactu_not_eligible`: either a field of the invoice does not fit its billing record, or — only when the company has VeriFactu enabled in NO VERI*FACTU mode — it has no usable signing certificate (`error.subcode: signing_certificate_unavailable`; `error.param` is `certificate`, `representation` or `system_certificate`, depending on what is missing); in both cases the invoice stays exactly as it was. invalid_invoice_payment_terms identifies an exact field such as payment_terms.N.id/due_date/amount/payment_means/account/iban/bic or payment_terms for ordering, sign and exact total_to_pay balance. New issue/corrective requires 02/04 account before commit; draft saving may omit it. No partial write occurs and account values are never echoed in diagnostics. A line that chooses a catalog tax by id (`tax_rate_id`, `retention_rate_id`, `surcharge_rate_id`) and contradicts it is rejected with `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`): the tax is of another class than its field (for example a withholding tax in `surcharge_rate_id`), or the declared `tax_rate`, `retention_rate` or `surcharge_rate` differs from the percentage of the chosen tax. `error.param` is `lines.N.tax_rate`, `lines.N.retention_rate` or `lines.N.surcharge_rate`, and `error.line_index` is N (the zero-based index of the line). Nothing is saved: send only the id, or the percentage of that tax. invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment (param due_on): with a nonempty schedule the invoice falls due on its last instalment, so issuing it with a missing or different due_on is rejected before a number is assigned and nothing is issued.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `resource_locked`: another request with the same `external_id` is still being processed (up to 20 seconds). Nothing was written by this request; send the same request again, which will return the invoice already issued. `unattended_replay_mismatch`: the `external_id` already belongs to an issued invoice with a different type or total. It identifies ONE operation: use a new `external_id` for a new operation. Nothing was changed. `resource_locked` with `subcode` `chain_position_conflict`: another process was generating VeriFactu billing records for the company at the same time and this one could not take its place in the chain after several attempts. Nothing was written; send the request again. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `pdf_legal_source_changed`: the legal data of the invoice changed after its presentation was captured, so that presentation can no longer be delivered as it is. Create an explicit legal presentation revision and repeat the request. Nothing was sent or delivered. `invoice_payment_terms_version_conflict`: the payment schedule of the invoice changed since the version you read. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read the invoice again and repeat the request. Nothing was changed. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). Nothing was created or modified — resolve the cause and retry the same request. Version note: `error.type` is `payment_required_error` from `Factuarea-Version: 2026-09-01` onwards; earlier versions receive `invalid_request_error` for the three codes that predate that cut (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed`; every other 402 code, such as `addon_required`, `plan_limit_exceeded` or the additional tax ID codes, is newer and always carries `payment_required_error`). `error.code` is stable across every version.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

post.description:
Issue a tax ID transfer over ONE tax ID of your account (`company_id`); returns 201 with its plaintext `secret`.
- The secret is shown once and never stored (`null` on replay); requires `Idempotency-Key`.
- Optional `recipient_account_id` restricts who can accept; `expires_at` defaults to 24 hours (max 7 days).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. get.description: List products in your catalog with cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of objects to return, between 1 and 100 (default 25).

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination: pass the `id` of the last object on the previous page (the `next_cursor` of the previous response).

parameters.name: ending_before
parameters.description: Cursor for backward pagination: pass the `id` of the first object on the current page.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Product SKU. Exact match on `sku`.

parameters.name: sku[in]
parameters.description: Product SKU. Comma-separated list. Any of the values matches.

parameters.name: sku[contains]
parameters.description: Product SKU. Partial case-insensitive match (`LIKE %term%`) on `sku`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Product name. Exact match on `name`.

parameters.name: name[contains]
parameters.description: Product name. Partial case-insensitive match (`LIKE %term%`) on `name`.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Filter by active / inactive products. Exact match on `is_active`.

parameters.name: created[gte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[lte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[gt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: created[lt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: price[gte]
parameters.description: Unit price. Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: price[lte]
parameters.description: Unit price. Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: price[gt]
parameters.description: Unit price. Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: price[lt]
parameters.description: Unit price. Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: Filter by products with available stock (`true` → stock > 0) or out of stock (`false` → stock = 0). Exact match on `in_stock`.

parameters.name: low_stock
parameters.description: Filter by products with low stock (`true` → 0 < stock ≤ configured threshold) or with ample stock (`false` → stock > threshold). Exact match on `low_stock`.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter by classification tag. Supports multiple values with `tag[in]`. Exact match on `tag`.

parameters.name: tag[in]
parameters.description: Filter by classification tag. Supports multiple values with `tag[in]`. Comma-separated list. Any of the values matches.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search. Escaped `LIKE %term%` (case-insensitive, max 80 chars) across the resource's key text columns, combined with the other filters (AND) and compatible with the cursor.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata filter as `metadata[key]=value` (deepObject): pairs combine with AND, up to 50, keys matching `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}`.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

422.description: Validation failed, or the proforma cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. editing an already-sent proforma). A line that chooses a catalog tax by id (`tax_rate_id`, `retention_rate_id`, `surcharge_rate_id`) and contradicts it is rejected with `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`): the tax is of another class than its field (for example a withholding tax in `surcharge_rate_id`), or the declared `tax_rate`, `retention_rate` or `surcharge_rate` differs from the percentage of the chosen tax. `error.param` is `lines.N.tax_rate`, `lines.N.retention_rate` or `lines.N.surcharge_rate`, and `error.line_index` is N (the zero-based index of the line). Nothing is saved: send only the id, or the percentage of that tax.

parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of objects to return, between 1 and 100 (default 25).

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination: pass the `id` of the last object on the previous page (the `next_cursor` of the previous response).

parameters.name: ending_before
parameters.description: Cursor for backward pagination: pass the `id` of the first object on the current page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Expense status. Exact match on `status`.

parameters.name: status[in]
parameters.description: Expense status. Comma-separated list. Any of the values matches.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Supplier ID (UUID v7). Exact match on `supplier_id`.

parameters.name: supplier_id[in]
parameters.description: Supplier ID (UUID v7). Comma-separated list. Any of the values matches.

parameters.name: created[gte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[lte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[gt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: created[lt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: issued_on[gte]
parameters.description: Issue date. Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: issued_on[lte]
parameters.description: Issue date. Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: issued_on[gt]
parameters.description: Issue date. Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: issued_on[lt]
parameters.description: Issue date. Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: total[gte]
parameters.description: Total amount. Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: total[lte]
parameters.description: Total amount. Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: total[gt]
parameters.description: Total amount. Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: total[lt]
parameters.description: Total amount. Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Exact match on `currency`.

parameters.name: currency[in]
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Comma-separated list. Any of the values matches.

parameters.name: external_invoice_number
parameters.description: Invoice number issued by the supplier. Exact match on `external_invoice_number`.

parameters.name: external_invoice_number[contains]
parameters.description: Invoice number issued by the supplier. Partial case-insensitive match (`LIKE %term%`) on `external_invoice_number`.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by classification tag (lowercase slug). Supports multiple values with `tags[in]=a,b` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics — matches expenses carrying ANY of the tags). Exact match on `tags`.

parameters.name: tags[in]
parameters.description: Only expenses carrying ANY of these classification tags (lowercase slugs, comma-separated).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: `created`, `total`, `issued_on`, `due_on` ascending, or with a `-` prefix for descending (default `-created`).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search. Escaped `LIKE %term%` (case-insensitive, max 80 chars) across the resource's key text columns, combined with the other filters (AND) and compatible with the cursor.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata filter as `metadata[key]=value` (deepObject): pairs combine with AND, up to 50, keys matching `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}`.

parameters.name: created[lte]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: created[gt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: created[lt]
parameters.description: Creation date (ISO 8601). Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: valid_until[gte]
parameters.description: Validity date. Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.description: Validity date. Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.description: Validity date. Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.description: Validity date. Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: total[gte]
parameters.description: Total amount. Greater than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: total[lte]
parameters.description: Total amount. Less than or equal to the given value.

parameters.name: total[gt]
parameters.description: Total amount. Strictly greater than the given value.

parameters.name: total[lt]
parameters.description: Total amount. Strictly less than the given value.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search. Escaped `LIKE %term%` (case-insensitive, max 80 chars) across the resource's key text columns, combined with the other filters (AND) and compatible with the cursor.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata filter as `metadata[key]=value` (deepObject): pairs combine with AND, up to 50, keys matching `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}`.

The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `recurring_presentation_policy_version_conflict`: the presentation policy of the recurring invoice changed since the `expected_presentation_policy_version` you sent. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read the recurring invoice again and repeat the request. Nothing was changed. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. get.description:
Search the tasks of your company across projects, filtering by `q`, `project_id`, `status`, `column_id`, `priority`, `assignee_id` (UUID or `me`), `label_id`, due dates and `completed`.
- `sort` takes `created_at`, `updated_at`, `due_on`, `priority` or `number`; prefix `-` for descending (default `-created_at`).
- Cursor-paginated: pass `next_cursor` as `starting_after`.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text matched against the task title and description. A value shaped like a task key (`DEV-12`) also matches that task by its key or a previous alias. Maximum 512 characters.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: UUID of a project of your company: only its tasks are returned.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Board status: `planned` (backlog), `active` (in a column of the board) or `archived`.

parameters.name: column_id
parameters.description: UUID of a board column: only tasks in that column are returned.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Task priority: `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high` or `urgent`.

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: UUID of the assigned member, or `me` for the member who owns the API key.

parameters.name: label_id
parameters.description: UUID of a task label: only tasks carrying that label are returned.

parameters.name: due_before
parameters.description: Only tasks due on or before this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: due_after
parameters.description: Only tasks due on or after this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: completed
parameters.description: `true` returns only completed tasks; `false` only open ones. Omit it to return both.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: `created_at` (default is `-created_at`), `updated_at`, `due_on`, `priority` or `number`; prefix it with `-` for descending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of tasks to return. Integer between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination: the `id` of the last task of the previous page (the `next_cursor` you received). An `id` that is not a task of your company returns 422 `invalid_param_value`.

Create a template with its first revision; only `name` is required (optional `id` and `revision_id`, UUID v7). Returns 201.
- `document_kind` is `commercial` by default or `transport-document` for a transport control document (DeCA) template; it never changes, and a DeCA template accepts only `branding`, `typography` and `colors`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

patch.description:
Update a draft invoice; once issued, most fields are immutable per AEAT.
- Sending `lines` replaces the whole set; a line without tax takes the default tax or returns 422.
- `operation_on` cannot be after `issued_on` (422 `operation_date_after_issue_date`); `type` switches a draft between `F1` and `F2`.
- `payment_terms`: omitted keeps it, `null`, `[]` or a list replace it; any calendar write needs `expected_payment_terms_version` (428 missing, 409 stale).

The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. Issuing or annulling an invoice can also be rejected with `verifactu_not_eligible`: either a field of the invoice does not fit its billing record, or — only when the company has VeriFactu enabled in NO VERI*FACTU mode — it has no usable signing certificate (`error.subcode: signing_certificate_unavailable`; `error.param` is `certificate`, `representation` or `system_certificate`, depending on what is missing); in both cases the invoice stays exactly as it was. invalid_invoice_payment_terms identifies an exact field such as payment_terms.N.id/due_date/amount/payment_means/account/iban/bic or payment_terms for ordering, sign and exact total_to_pay balance. New issue/corrective requires 02/04 account before commit; draft saving may omit it. No partial write occurs and account values are never echoed in diagnostics. A line that chooses a catalog tax by id (`tax_rate_id`, `retention_rate_id`, `surcharge_rate_id`) and contradicts it is rejected with `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`): the tax is of another class than its field (for example a withholding tax in `surcharge_rate_id`), or the declared `tax_rate`, `retention_rate` or `surcharge_rate` differs from the percentage of the chosen tax. `error.param` is `lines.N.tax_rate`, `lines.N.retention_rate` or `lines.N.surcharge_rate`, and `error.line_index` is N (the zero-based index of the line). parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

422.description: Validation failed, or the proforma cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. editing an already-sent proforma). The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. A line that chooses a catalog tax by id (`tax_rate_id`, `retention_rate_id`, `surcharge_rate_id`) and contradicts it is rejected with `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`): the tax is of another class than its field (for example a withholding tax in `surcharge_rate_id`), or the declared `tax_rate`, `retention_rate` or `surcharge_rate` differs from the percentage of the chosen tax. `error.param` is `lines.N.tax_rate`, `lines.N.retention_rate` or `lines.N.surcharge_rate`, and `error.line_index` is N (the zero-based index of the line). Nothing is saved: send only the id, or the percentage of that tax.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

422.description: Validation failed, or the quote cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. accepting an already-accepted quote, or converting a non-accepted quote). The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. A line that chooses a catalog tax by id (`tax_rate_id`, `retention_rate_id`, `surcharge_rate_id`) and contradicts it is rejected with `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`): the tax is of another class than its field (for example a withholding tax in `surcharge_rate_id`), or the declared `tax_rate`, `retention_rate` or `surcharge_rate` differs from the percentage of the chosen tax. `error.param` is `lines.N.tax_rate`, `lines.N.retention_rate` or `lines.N.surcharge_rate`, and `error.line_index` is N (the zero-based index of the line). Nothing is saved: send only the id, or the percentage of that tax.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `resource_already_exists` with `subcode` `external_id_already_exists`: another recurring invoice of the company already uses that `external_id`; `details.existing_resource_id` is its identifier. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `recurring_presentation_policy_version_conflict`: the presentation policy of the recurring invoice changed since the `expected_presentation_policy_version` you sent. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read the recurring invoice again and repeat the request. Nothing was changed.

422.description: Validation failed, or the recurring invoice cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. resuming a recurrence that is not paused). The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. Existing validation or invalid_recurring_presentation_policy / invalid_recurring_payment_terms_template: exact error.param identifies the field. Correct the complete policy or relative terms; no partial write. A line that chooses a catalog tax by id (`tax_rate_id`, `retention_rate_id`, `surcharge_rate_id`) and contradicts it is rejected with `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`): the tax is of another class than its field (for example a withholding tax in `surcharge_rate_id`), or the declared `tax_rate`, `retention_rate` or `surcharge_rate` differs from the percentage of the chosen tax. `error.param` is `lines.N.tax_rate`, `lines.N.retention_rate` or `lines.N.surcharge_rate`, and `error.line_index` is N (the zero-based index of the line). Nothing is saved: send only the id, or the percentage of that tax.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

post.description:
Copy the lines, client and metadata of an invoice into a new draft with a fresh `id`.
- The draft is issued today; each `payment_terms` instalment keeps its amount and moves by the days between both issue dates, and `due_on` is the last moved instalment.
- A simplified invoice is copied without a series and must still be eligible: 422 `simplified_invoice_not_allowed`.
- Corrective, annulled and cancelled invoices return 422 `invoice_not_duplicatable_in_current_state`.

post.description:
Create a new active template from the current configuration of a source template, which may be archived. Returns 201.
- Send `name` and the `expected_version` of the source in the body; `If-Match` is not accepted.
- `document_kind` keeps the kind of the source; `transport-document` on a commercial source creates a DeCA template with only its preset, layout, branding, typography (8-11 pt), colors and brand.
- The copy starts at version 1 without defaults, series or contact preferences. Requires `pdf_templates:write`; supports `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the PDF template.

requestBody.description: Internal reversible write: idempotency follows the current policy; a supplied key is replayed before CAS. Unknown fields are rejected. Until the company is prepared for revisioned templates (tenant initialization pending or revisioned rendering off) every library write returns 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` before any precondition or effect; reads stay available and no `Retry-After` applies.

document_kind.description: Template kind: `commercial` (invoice, quote, pro forma and delivery note) or `transport-document` (transport control document, DeCA). A template never changes kind. Omitted, the copy keeps the kind of the source; `transport-document` on a commercial source creates a new control template that copies only the design (preset, branding, typography and colors). A control template cannot be duplicated as `commercial`.

422.description: Validation failed. The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid.

error.message: El modo de marca de la plantilla requiere una identidad comercial disponible; elige una o define la de la empresa.

413.description: The packaged download you asked for is too large to build, so nothing was generated and no file was left on the server. Two catalog codes carry this status, both with `error.type: invalid_request_error`: `export_document_cap_exceeded` (the request covers more documents than the cap for that artifact allows — narrow the date range or export in batches) and `export_byte_cap_exceeded` (the artifact would weigh more than the byte cap; `error.subcode` says whether it was rejected up front from the size estimate, `before_writing`, or aborted mid-packaging, `while_writing`, in which case the partial file was deleted and nothing is served). Retrying the same request unchanged returns the same error — ask for less, do not wait. A third, unrelated code shares this status on every write operation: `payload_too_large`, raised when the REQUEST body exceeds the 1 MB limit, which is about what you send and not about the size of what you asked to build.

patch.description: Change only the name and the description of a template; the visual content is published with a new revision instead. Send the current `expected_version` in the body or the strong `ETag` of this same template in `If-Match`. A wrong tag returns 412, an outdated version returns 409 with `current_version`, and sending neither returns 428. Omitting the description keeps it; `null` clears it. A request that changes nothing does not create a new version. Requires `pdf_templates:write` and supports `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.description: Alternative precondition from GET of this exact URI. Strong comparison (RFC 9110); independently validated alongside expected_version: mismatched tag 412, stale version 409, neither 428. POST actions require expected_version in the body.

requestBody.description: Internal reversible write: idempotency follows the current policy; a supplied key is replayed before CAS. Unknown fields are rejected. Until the company is prepared for revisioned templates (tenant initialization pending or revisioned rendering off) every library write returns 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` before any precondition or effect; reads stay available and no `Retry-After` applies.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_template_version_conflict`: the `expected_version` you sent is no longer the current version of the template or commercial identity, because another change was saved in the meantime. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read it again, or keep your local copy and repeat the request with the current version. Nothing was changed.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `pdf_legal_source_changed`: the legal data of the invoice changed after its presentation was captured, so that presentation can no longer be delivered as it is. Create an explicit legal presentation revision and repeat the request. Nothing was sent or delivered. `recurring_presentation_activation_changed`: the company switched its presentation system on or off twice in a row while the recurring invoice was being generated. It is a retryable conflict, not a business-rule violation: nothing was written, no invoice was created and no occurrence was consumed. Repeat the request; with the same `Idempotency-Key` it does not duplicate the invoice. This response is not cached for replay. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

get.description:
Return a combined agenda between `from` and `to` (at most 93 days): due tasks plus due dates, expiries, tax deadlines, absences and holidays.
- `sources` picks the layers; each needs its own read scope, and unreadable layers are left out without error.
- The response `sources` lists the layers served; `assignee_id` filters tasks; one page.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the window (`YYYY-MM-DD`, included). Required.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the window (`YYYY-MM-DD`, included). Required. The window spans at most 93 days: a longer or inverted window returns 400 `parameter_invalid_range` on `to`.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Comma-separated agenda layers: `tasks`, `invoice_due`, `purchase_invoice_due`, `quote_expiry`, `proforma_expiry`, `recurring_invoice_run`, `fiscal_deadline`, `absence`, `holiday`; default all.

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: Only filters the `tasks` layer: `me` for the member who owns the API key, or the UUID of a member of your company. Any other value returns 422 `invalid_param_value`.
