post.description:
Register the representation that lets Factuarea remit your VeriFactu records to AEAT; send `multipart/form-data`.
- Required: `kind` (`social_collaboration_annex_i`/`aeat_power_of_attorney`), `signer_name`, `signer_tax_id`, `granted_on`, `document` (PDF, up to 5 MB).
- An active one is revoked; `remission_mode` may change. Returns 201 with `data`.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

201.description: The newly registered representation and the remission mode that results. A `Location` header points to `/v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/representation`.

remission_mode.description: Remission mode of the company AFTER registering: registering a representation moves a company that remits through a third-party mode to the mode of the new kind (or back to `own_certificate` when that mode cannot be used); with `own_certificate` it does not change.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

500.description: The retained PDF cannot be rendered or served, so there is no link to wait for (it is never answered as a pending 202): `pdf_engine_profile_unavailable` or `pdf_payload_resource_unavailable` (its render failed terminally), `pdf_image_resource_unavailable`, `pdf_original_unavailable` or `pdf_original_corrupt`. Preparing the PDF of a presentation derived from the original to add the legal QR or to refresh the legal data answers `pdf_original_layout_unavailable` when this release no longer serves the original's layout, which that presentation keeps: the original is intact and nothing is prepared. Nothing is enqueued by this answer. A render that failed but can be retried is never answered with that earlier failure: the request claims it again, so retrying makes progress. Any other internal error also returns 500; the response never exposes internal artifact data.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `pdf_legal_source_changed`: the legal data of the invoice changed after its presentation was captured, so that presentation can no longer be delivered as it is. Create an explicit legal presentation revision and repeat the request. Nothing was sent or delivered.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

get.description:
Return the Spanish tax catalog in one document: IVA/IGIC/IPSI regimes and rates, operation regimes, exemption causes, IRPF withholding rates and legal VAT/surcharge pairs.
- No company data or custom taxes (see `GET /v1/companies/{company}/taxes`); withholding rates are POSITIVE.
- Labels in es/en/ca; cacheable via `ETag` (304 on `If-None-Match`).

label.en: IGIC — Canary Islands general indirect tax (Canary Islands)

description.es: Operación interior ordinaria: se repercute IVA al tipo que corresponda y la factura no necesita ninguna mención legal adicional.
description.en: Ordinary domestic transaction: VAT is charged at the applicable rate and the invoice needs no additional legal wording.
description.ca: Operació interior ordinària: es repercuteix IVA al tipus que correspongui i la factura no necessita cap menció legal addicional.

operation_regimes.legal_mention: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta - Art. 25 LIVA

description.es: Entrega a un cliente de otro Estado miembro de la Unión Europea con NIF-IVA válido: la operación está sujeta y exenta, se factura sin cuota de IVA y la factura debe recoger la mención del artículo 25 de la Ley 37/1992.
description.en: Supply to a customer in another EU Member State holding a valid VAT number: the transaction is taxable but exempt, it is invoiced with no VAT amount, and the invoice must carry the reference to article 25 of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992).
description.ca: Lliurament a un client d'un altre Estat membre de la Unió Europea amb NIF-IVA vàlid: l'operació està subjecta i exempta, es factura sense quota d'IVA i la factura ha de recollir la menció de l'article 25 de la Llei 37/1992.

exemption_causes.legal_mention: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta conforme al artículo 25 de la Ley 37/1992.

description.es: Entrega de bienes con destino a otro Estado miembro, sujeta y exenta por el artículo 25 de la Ley 37/1992. Se factura sin repercutir cuota y ante la AEAT se declara con la causa de exención E5.
description.en: Supply of goods dispatched to another EU Member State, taxable but exempt under article 25 of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992). It is invoiced with no VAT amount and reported to AEAT with exemption reason E5.
description.ca: Lliurament de béns amb destinació a un altre Estat membre, subjecte i exempt per l'article 25 de la Llei 37/1992. Es factura sense repercutir quota i davant l'AEAT es declara amb la causa d'exempció E5.

exemption_causes.legal_mention: Operación acogida al régimen especial del recargo de equivalencia (artículo 154 de la Ley 37/1992).

label.es: Régimen especial del recargo de equivalencia — artículo 154 LIVA
label.en: Recargo de equivalencia regime — article 154 LIVA
label.ca: Règim especial del recàrrec d'equivalència — article 154 LIVA

description.es: Operación acogida al régimen especial del recargo de equivalencia (artículo 154 de la Ley 37/1992), obligatorio para el comercio minorista: el emisor repercute al minorista un recargo además del IVA. Ante la AEAT se declara con la clave de régimen 51.
description.en: Transaction under the "recargo de equivalencia" regime (article 154 of the Spanish VAT Act, Ley 37/1992), compulsory for retailers: the issuer charges the retailer a surcharge on top of the VAT. It is reported to AEAT with special regime key 51.
description.ca: Operació acollida al règim especial del recàrrec d'equivalència (article 154 de la Llei 37/1992), obligatori per al comerç minorista: l'emissor repercuteix al minorista un recàrrec a més de l'IVA. Davant l'AEAT es declara amb la clau de règim 51.

ETag.description: Strong validator of the catalog content (RFC 9110). Store it and send it back in `If-None-Match` on the next request to get a 304 with no body. The negotiated language travels inside the body, so two `Accept-Language` values yield two different `ETag`s.

Cache-Control.description: Freshness window of the catalog. The content only changes with a deployment (it derives from value objects and from the global tax catalog), so the body is safe for shared caches — it carries no data of the authenticated company. The response as a whole is still keyed per caller: see `Vary`.

Vary.description: Request headers this response varies on. `Accept-Language` is always present, because it decides the `primary_language` of the document; a shared cache that ignores it would serve one client the catalog of another language. `Authorization` is always present too: the body is identical for every company, but the response also carries your own `X-RateLimit-*` and `X-Request-Id` headers, and a shared cache must not replay one caller's quota to another. Browser requests get `Origin` appended by the CORS layer.

304.description: The catalog has not changed since the validator you sent in `If-None-Match`. No body is returned; the cache headers of the 200 are repeated so the cached copy can be refreshed (RFC 9110 §15.4.5).

- CSV, TXT, XLSX or XLS up to 10 MB.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

Issuing or annulling an invoice can also be rejected with `verifactu_not_eligible`: either a field of the invoice does not fit its billing record, or — only when the company has VeriFactu enabled in NO VERI*FACTU mode — it has no usable signing certificate (`error.subcode: signing_certificate_unavailable`; `error.param` is `certificate`, `representation` or `system_certificate`, depending on what is missing); in both cases the invoice stays exactly as it was. invalid_invoice_payment_terms identifies an exact field such as payment_terms.N.id/due_date/amount/payment_means/account/iban/bic or payment_terms for ordering, sign and exact total_to_pay balance. New issue/corrective requires 02/04 account before commit; draft saving may omit it. No partial write occurs and account values are never echoed in diagnostics. invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment (param due_on): with a nonempty schedule the invoice falls due on its last instalment, so issuing it with a missing or different due_on is rejected before a number is assigned and nothing is issued.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

post.description:
Prepare a batch purchase of 1 to 100 employees (explicit create profiles or inactive employee UUIDs).
- Preparing and refreshing never charge, provision people or send invitations.
- Confirm the reviewed `quote_version` with a stable Idempotency-Key.
- After a 202 or failure, GET the same UUID until terminal; never create a second purchase.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

post.description: Append an administrative routing revision to an issued or overdue invoice. Supply administrative_centres (including [] to select none), a nonblank reason of at most 500 characters and the current expected_version in the body. Missing version returns 428; a stale version returns 409 with current_version only after authorization. A successful append returns 201 and its committed administrative_version. Parent invoice If-Match does not replace the body precondition. Fiscal data, issuance, payment terms and delivery are unchanged; no invoice is emailed or submitted by this operation.

- Test keys never contact FACe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `resource_already_exists` with `subcode` `face_submission_already_exists`: the invoice already has an active FACe submission. `face_submission_attempt_conflict`: the FACe submission attempt changed while this request was running, or it is not in a state that allows this action. `details.attempt_id` is the attempt and `details.reason` says why (`attempt`, `claim`, `reconciliation` or `write_once`). Read the attempt before continuing. `face_transmission_uncertain`: an earlier transmission of this attempt did not confirm whether FACe received the invoice, so it cannot be transmitted again until it is reconciled. `details.attempt_id` is the attempt. Do not submit the invoice again; read the attempt and wait for its reconciliation. `invoice_payment_terms_version_conflict`: the payment schedule of the invoice changed since the version you read. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read the invoice again and repeat the request. Nothing was changed. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

post.description:
Provision a SEPARATE account for one of your clients, with its tax ID, plan and your `access_level`; your account pays it.
- Returns 201 with the claim voucher shown EXACTLY ONCE, or emailed with `send_email: true`.
- Repeating an `external_ref` returns 200 with no new voucher; `Idempotency-Key` is required.
- Requires the privileged `accounts:write` scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). Nothing was created or modified — resolve the cause and retry the same request. Version note: `error.type` is `payment_required_error` from `Factuarea-Version: 2026-09-01` onwards; earlier versions receive `invalid_request_error` for the three codes that predate that cut (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed`; every other 402 code, such as `addon_required`, `plan_limit_exceeded` or the additional tax ID codes, is newer and always carries `payment_required_error`). `error.code` is stable across every version.

413.description: The packaged download you asked for is too large to build, so nothing was generated and no file was left on the server. Two catalog codes carry this status, both with `error.type: invalid_request_error`: `export_document_cap_exceeded` (the request covers more documents than the cap for that artifact allows — narrow the date range or export in batches) and `export_byte_cap_exceeded` (the artifact would weigh more than the byte cap; `error.subcode` says whether it was rejected up front from the size estimate, `before_writing`, or aborted mid-packaging, `while_writing`, in which case the partial file was deleted and nothing is served). Retrying the same request unchanged returns the same error — ask for less, do not wait. A third, unrelated code shares this status on every write operation: `payload_too_large`, raised when the REQUEST body exceeds the 1 MB limit, which is about what you send and not about the size of what you asked to build.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

post.description:
Modify an `issued` transport document during the service, keeping its number, URL and QR; stores a new PDF version.
- Send the changes plus `reason` and `data_origin` (`company`/`carrier_reported`); parties are immutable.

- Irreversible: requires `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

422.description: Validation failed, or the transport document breaks a rule of the Spanish control document (DeCA): missing data to issue it (`transport_document_not_issuable`, with the list in `error.details.missing`), a transport date in the past, a shipment outside Spain, parties changed after issuing, a modification that changes nothing, or a lifecycle transition that its status does not allow. error.message: La modificación no cambia ningún dato del DeCA.
El DeCA DC-2026-042 ya está emitido y sus partes no se pueden cambiar. Para cambiar el cargador o el transportista, anúlalo y emite uno nuevo.
El DeCA DC-2026-042 no se puede modificar: está en estado «Finalizado». Solo se modifica un DeCA emitido y en curso.

La operación «public-api.v1.transport_documents.modify» exige la cabecera Idempotency-Key desde el 2026-12-01. Envía una clave única por operación (un UUID sirve) y, si reintenta, repite exactamente la misma clave para que la operación no se ejecute dos veces.

El PDF del DeCA ocuparía 5,31 MB y el máximo permitido es 5 MB. No se ha guardado ningún cambio. Reduce el contenido del documento (menos envíos o líneas de mercancía, descripciones u observaciones más cortas) o reparte los envíos en varios DeCA.

El DeCA DC-2026-042 ya tiene 49 versiones y no admite más modificaciones: un DeCA tiene como máximo 50 versiones y la última se reserva para anularlo o sustituirlo. Si el transporte sigue cambiando, emite un DeCA nuevo y marca este como sustituido.

El peso de la línea 1 del envío 1 no es válido: 2000000 unidades de 5000000 kg dan un peso de línea que debe ser mayor que 0 kg y no superar 9999999999.9999 kg. Revisa la cantidad o el peso por unidad.
Este identificador de envío no pertenece a este DeCA. Para añadir un envío nuevo, envíalo sin «id».

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. 503.description: Another request is still preparing or rendering this same artifact and did not finish within the wait window (`pdf_artifact_not_ready`); this request created and rendered nothing. Retry the same request after the Retry-After delay. If the PDF engine does not answer (down, restarting or in the middle of a deployment) while the plan of the PDF is prepared, the code is `pdf_engine_unreachable` instead: it is transient and nothing is created, so repeat the same request after the same delay. If the PDF engine does not answer while the PDF is being rendered (down, restarting or in the middle of a deployment) the answer is also `pdf_artifact_not_ready`: the artifact is not ready yet, and repeating the request after the `Retry-After` delay is the right recovery. Terminal engine failures are the 500 `pdf_engine_profile_unavailable`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

requestBody.description: Internal reversible write: idempotency follows the current policy; a supplied key is replayed before CAS. Unknown fields are rejected. Until the company is prepared for revisioned templates (tenant initialization pending or revisioned rendering off) every library write returns 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` before any precondition or effect; reads stay available and no `Retry-After` applies.

logo_dark_asset_id.description: Logo version for dark backgrounds (asset of kind `logo`); requires `logo_asset_id`. When clearing `logo_asset_id`, send `null` for this field too.

brand_image_dark_asset_id.description: Brand image version for dark backgrounds (asset of kind `imago`); requires `brand_image_asset_id`.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_template_version_conflict`: the `expected_version` you sent is no longer the current version of the template or commercial identity, because another change was saved in the meantime. `details.current_version` is the current one and `details.recovery` is `reload_or_keep_local`: read it again, or keep your local copy and repeat the request with the current version. Nothing was changed. `pdf_library_impact_conflict`: the impact you reviewed (`expected_impact_fingerprint`, from the impact operation) no longer matches what the change would affect: a document, series, contact or default that depends on it changed in the meantime. Read the impact again and confirm the new one. Nothing was changed.

post.description:
Append an immutable revision with the new compatibility, base preset, brand or configuration. Returns 201 with the new revision.
- First read the impact with `action=publish`, then send its `expected_impact_fingerprint` and the `expected_version` of the template; a changed impact returns 409.
- Objects in `configuration` are merged deeply and lists replaced; the kind is fixed, so `document_kind` is rejected.
- Earlier revisions and the documents issued with them are not modified. Requires `pdf_templates:write`; supports `Idempotency-Key`.

422.description: Validation failed, or the invoice cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. marking an already-paid invoice as paid, or editing an issued invoice — use a corrective instead). The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. Issuing or annulling an invoice can also be rejected with `verifactu_not_eligible`: either a field of the invoice does not fit its billing record, or — only when the company has VeriFactu enabled in NO VERI*FACTU mode — it has no usable signing certificate (`error.subcode: signing_certificate_unavailable`; `error.param` is `certificate`, `representation` or `system_certificate`, depending on what is missing); in both cases the invoice stays exactly as it was.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `pdf_legal_source_changed`: the legal data of the invoice changed after its presentation was captured, so that presentation can no longer be delivered as it is. Create an explicit legal presentation revision and repeat the request. Nothing was sent or delivered.

Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifier of this request (`req_` + ULID, or the value you sent, up to 40 characters). Quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate limit window (60 seconds). Prefer this field over its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Limit`, which carries the same value and is kept only for backwards compatibility.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window before receiving a 429. Prefer this field over its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, which carries the same value and is kept only for backwards compatibility.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): SECONDS REMAINING until the rate limit window resets — a duration, not a clock reading. Its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Reset` expresses the SAME instant as a Unix timestamp, so the two values are deliberately different and must not be swapped: read this one as a delay and that one as an epoch.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Legacy rate-limit header, kept for backwards compatibility; the canonical field is `RateLimit-Reset`. Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the rate limit window resets and the counter returns to its maximum. Careful: the canonical `RateLimit-Reset` publishes the same instant as SECONDS REMAINING, so the two values never match.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `employee_batch_billing_state_conflict`: the current billing of the account does not allow completing the batch safely. `details.reason` is `offer_requires_chargeable_seats`, `fiscal_configuration` or `phase_incompatible`. Nothing was charged. `resource_already_exists` with `subcode` `external_id_already_exists`: an `external_id` of the batch is already used by an employee of the company. Nothing was charged or created. `employee_batch_state_conflict` with `subcode` `employee_batch_missing_payment_proof`: the payment of this operation is not proven yet. Read its current state. `employee_batch_state_conflict` with `subcode` `employee_batch_payment_outcome_unknown`: the payment of the batch is still being verified. `details.operation_id` is the operation to keep following; do not charge again. `employee_batch_quote_changed`: the quote changed since the version you accepted (`param` `quote_version`). Refresh it and accept the current version. `employee_seat_mutation_outcome_unknown`: an employee seat operation is still being verified. `details.operation_id` is its reference and `details.operation_kind` is `legacy_employee`; do not repeat the charge and contact support with the reference. `employee_seat_phase_incompatible` with `param` `quantity`: the subscription has scheduled conditions that must be reviewed before its seats change. `details.reason` is `phase_incompatible`. Nothing was charged. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds. `employee_batch_state_conflict`: the batch is in a state that does not allow this action. Read its current state. `employee_seat_operation_in_progress`: another employee operation is pending. `details.operation_id` identifies it when known; read its state before starting another.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). Nothing was created or modified — resolve the cause and retry the same request. Version note: `error.type` is `payment_required_error` from `Factuarea-Version: 2026-09-01` onwards; earlier versions receive `invalid_request_error` for the three codes that predate that cut (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed`; every other 402 code, such as `addon_required`, `plan_limit_exceeded` or the additional tax ID codes, is newer and always carries `payment_required_error`). `error.code` is stable across every version.

post.description: Render a prepared artifact. `mode` is required: `sync` waits for the result and `async` queues it. The artifact is returned in state `ready` (200) or still pending (202); poll the show operation while it is `queued` or `processing`. Rendering an artifact that is already ready changes nothing. It counts against the PDF generation budget. Requires `pdfs:read` and `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

requestBody.description: Internal reversible preparation/rendering uses the existing idempotency policy; the same key and raw body replay, another body with that key is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_reused` before admission.

500.description: The retained original is missing (`pdf_original_unavailable`) or cannot be verified (`pdf_original_corrupt`), or rendering failed terminally; no implicit regeneration occurs. post.description:
Reprocess a parked gateway event once the cause that parked it is fixed.
- Needs `integration_events:write`; the event must have `is_replayable: true`, otherwise 422.
- It can issue a real invoice with VeriFactu registration; confirm with the owner first.
- 202 means queued, not completed; the outcome arrives as a new event, and invoices are never duplicated.

422.description: The integration event exists but cannot be replayed. All three cases share the code `business_rule_violation` and are told apart by `error.subcode`: `integration_event_not_parked` (it was never parked, so there is nothing to reprocess and there never will be), `integration_event_payload_purged` (it was parked, but its content was deleted when the 30-day retention window elapsed) and `integration_event_reason_not_replayable` (it is parked and still holds its content, but its discard reason would take exactly the same branch again). An event whose `is_replayable` is `true` never reaches this response.

422.description: Validation failed, or the invoice cannot undergo the requested state transition (e.g. marking an already-paid invoice as paid, or editing an issued invoice — use a corrective instead). The `error.param` field identifies which input is invalid, if any. Issuing or annulling an invoice can also be rejected with `verifactu_not_eligible`: either a field of the invoice does not fit its billing record, or — only when the company has VeriFactu enabled in NO VERI*FACTU mode — it has no usable signing certificate (`error.subcode: signing_certificate_unavailable`; `error.param` is `certificate`, `representation` or `system_certificate`, depending on what is missing); in both cases the invoice stays exactly as it was. invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment (param due_on): with a nonempty schedule the invoice falls due on its last instalment, so scheduling or rescheduling it with a missing or different due_on is rejected and the invoice keeps its status and date.

post.description:
Resend a pending invitation: a NEW acceptance secret is issued, the previous one stops working and expiry is renewed.
- Returns 200; `secret` and `accept_url` appear once, only for a copy-link invitation; `null` on replay.

- 422 `invitation_expired` if expired; 404 `invitation_not_found`. Requires the `invitations:write` scope, which `*` does not cover: the API key must list it explicitly.

post.description:
Re-arm a failed delivery: the SAME delivery returns to `pending` and is sent again with the current signing secret.
- Only `failed` and `failed_permanently` can be retried; others return 422 subcode `account_webhook_retry_not_allowed`.
- Returns 202; requires a live key and an `Idempotency-Key`; 404 `webhook_delivery_not_found`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

202.description: The delivery was re-armed and queued: the SAME delivery goes back to `pending` and is sent again with the current signing secret. `data.id` is that delivery; read its outcome with the delivery detail.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the re-armed delivery: the `{delivery}` of the path.

status.description: Always `queued`: the delivery was accepted and is sent asynchronously.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `pdf_legal_source_changed`: the legal data of the invoice changed after its presentation was captured, so that presentation can no longer be delivered as it is. Create an explicit legal presentation revision and repeat the request. Nothing was sent or delivered. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

delete.description:
Revoke the grant of a member on one tax ID of the account and return 204.
- Revoking a missing grant changes nothing and also returns 204; no notification is sent.
- The member loses access to that tax ID through app, API and MCP, and its API keys are lowered; set the grant again to restore.
- 404 `member_not_found`; 422 `grant_company_not_in_account`. Requires the `members:write` scope, which `*` does not cover: the API key must list it explicitly.

post.description:
Revoke an API key of your account immediately and irreversibly; later requests with it fail with 401.
- Revoking the key in use cuts off your own access.
- A key of another account returns 404 `api_key_not_found`.
- A key with scopes the calling key does not cover returns 403 `insufficient_scope`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

post.description:
Upload up to 20 PDF, JPEG or PNG files as `multipart/form-data` (`files[]`) to the purchase scanner.
- Responds `202` with `accepted[]` and `rejected[]`; `422` when no file was accepted.
- Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: a replay returns the same result without re-ingesting.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. RateLimit-Reset.description: Canonical rate-limit field (RFC 9331): SECONDS REMAINING until the rate limit window resets — a duration, not a clock reading. Its legacy twin `X-RateLimit-Reset` expresses the SAME instant as a Unix timestamp, so the two values are deliberately different and must not be swapped: read this one as a delay and that one as an epoch.

post.description:
Record a handwritten signature on a delivery note: base64 PNG up to 2 MB, other formats return 422.
- `signed_by` (up to 120 characters) is required; the server sets the signature time and ignores the deprecated `signed_at`. The status does not change.
- The optional presentation context (`expected_*`) is all-or-nothing and requires an `Idempotency-Key`.
- The audit log keeps hashed PII for 5 years; erase it via `signature-audits/{auditId}/forget`.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.scope[].id`).

parameters.name: delivery_note
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the delivery note.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

402.description: The operation requires a payment that could not be completed: either no payment method is on file (`error.details.payment_setup_url` links to the Billing Portal where it can be set up), the immediate charge was declined by the payment provider, the account lacks the plan or add-on this operation bills against, the annual document limit is reached (`plan_limit_exceeded`, with `error.details.period_end` indicating the end of the period — wait until it has ended or upgrade the plan to continue now), or the account has reached its maximum usage (`storage_quota_exceeded`, raised by upload operations such as signing a delivery note or attaching a file to an expense — contact support before retrying). Nothing was created or modified — resolve the cause and retry the same request. Version note: `error.type` is `payment_required_error` from `Factuarea-Version: 2026-09-01` onwards; earlier versions receive `invalid_request_error` for the three codes that predate that cut (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed`; every other 402 code, such as `addon_required`, `plan_limit_exceeded` or the additional tax ID codes, is newer and always carries `payment_required_error`). `error.code` is stable across every version.

post.description:
Starts connecting a Stripe account to the company and returns the Stripe onboarding `url` (201, `status` `pending`).
- Needs `Idempotency-Key` and an `https` `return_url` on an allowed domain (`connect_return_url_not_allowed`).
- Live credentials only: test keys fail with 403 `live_credential_required`.
- No MCP tool: it needs a browser redirect.

parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

409.description: The request conflicts with data that already exists or with a request running at the same time. `pdf_presentation_conflict`: the presentation of the document changed since you read it. The selection version or the presentation you referenced is no longer the current one, or another request captured it at the same time. Read the presentation again, review it and repeat the request: the server never substitutes a newer version for you. Nothing was changed. `pdf_presentation_context_changed`: what you reviewed no longer matches the document. Its content, the reviewed preview, the expected presentation or the requested format differ from the current ones. Refresh the preview, review it again and repeat the request with the new values. Nothing was changed. `pdf_legal_source_changed`: the legal data of the invoice changed after its presentation was captured, so that presentation can no longer be delivered as it is. Create an explicit legal presentation revision and repeat the request. Nothing was sent or delivered. `resource_conflict`: another request was reserving identifiers for the same kind of record at that moment and this one could not complete its reservation. Nothing was written; send the request again after a few seconds.

patch.description:
Put the account in the name of another member: the outgoing owner becomes `admin`, the target `owner`. Irreversible.
- Needs the `account:owner` scope, the current owner, and `Idempotency-Key`.
- `owner_user_id` is the person UUID, not the member `id`; 403 `owner_transfer_forbidden` if not the owner.
- 422 `business_rule_violation` for an invalid target. Requires the `account:owner` scope, which `*` does not cover: the API key must list it explicitly.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of your account. Get it from `GET /v1/me` (`data.account.id`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency). **Required on this operation**: repeating it delivers an effect that cannot be taken back (an email sent, a file generated, a third-party call, a charge), so a request without this header is rejected with `422 idempotency_key_required` before any business logic runs.

OAuth2.description:
OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE (`code_challenge_method=S256`).
Discovery metadata (RFC 8414) is published at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`.

The access tokens of this flow authorize the Factuarea MCP server; the REST operations of this API accept only API keys (`fact_live_` / `fact_test_`), which is why no operation lists this scheme in `security`.

The scopes of this flow use the dotted vocabulary of the consent screen (`invoices.read`, `factuarea.full`): a request that names a fine-grained scope such as `invoices:read`, which is how API keys are scoped, is rejected with `invalid_scope`. The consent grants business data of one tax ID and never the administration of the account.

## API key rotation policy

API keys and OAuth client secrets are long-lived credentials and MUST be rotated periodically and immediately after any suspected leak.

- **Prefixes**: every key carries an unambiguous environment prefix — `fact_live_` (production) and `fact_test_` (sandbox). The prefix is the source of truth for the environment; never mix them across environments.
- **How to rotate**: rotate an API key from the Factuarea portal (or via the self-service `account:write` endpoints). Rotation issues a brand-new secret and returns it **once** — store it immediately, it is never shown again.
- **Grace window (dual-secret)**: after a rotation the previous secret keeps working for a **24-hour grace window**, so you can roll out the new secret with zero downtime. During that window both the new and the previous secret are accepted; once the window expires the previous secret is rejected and purged.
- **When to rotate**: on a regular schedule (e.g. every 90 days), whenever a teammate with access leaves, and **immediately** if a secret is ever exposed in logs, source control or a public client. Rotation leaves the previous secret valid for the 24-hour grace window, so to cut an exposed secret off at once, **revoke** the key instead (revocation is immediate) and issue a new one.
- **What a key reaches**: an API key belongs to one account and operates only on the companies (tax IDs) in its scope, fixed when the key is issued; `GET /v1/me` returns the account (`data.account.id`) and that scope (`data.scope[]`). The company each request acts on travels in the path, `/v1/companies/{company}/…`, and must be in the scope.
- Secrets MUST NEVER be embedded in browsers, mobile apps or any public client — keep them server-side only.
