scopes.factuarea.full: Macro scope: grants the 58 simple scopes it expands to.

AbsenceBalance.description: An absence balance for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: the accrued, carried-over, consumed and available days of one employee for one absence type in a given year. Day amounts are decimal strings. `accrued_days`, `carried_over_days` and `consumed_days` are the exact ledger figures; `available_days` is the usable balance (accrued + non-expired carried-over − consumed) **rounded up to a whole day**, because absences are requested in whole working days. As a result `available_days` can exceed the exact arithmetic by up to one day — that fraction is granted by the company — so do not expect it to reconcile to the cent with the other three fields.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the balance, a UUID v7.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the balance belongs to.

absence_type_id.description: UUID v7 of the absence type the balance tracks.

absence_policy_id.description: UUID v7 of the absence policy the balance accrues under.

year.description: Accrual year the balance belongs to (e.g. `2026`).

accrued_days.description: Days accrued so far this year, as an exact decimal string.

carried_over_days.description: Days carried over from the previous year (capped by the policy), as an exact decimal string.

carryover_expires_on.description: Date on which the carried-over days expire (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or `null` when they do not expire or there is no carryover.

consumed_days.description: Days already consumed against this balance, as an exact decimal string.

available_days.description: Usable balance (accrued + non-expired carried-over − consumed), rounded up to a whole day. Always an integer value, serialised as a decimal string.

measurement_unit.description: Unit in which the balance is measured: `days` or `hours`.

AbsenceBalance.title: AbsenceBalance

AbsencePolicy.description: An absence policy for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: how many days per year an employee accrues for a set of absence types, how those days accrue, and which employees it applies to. `allowance_type` decides whether the yearly allowance is capped (`limited`, with `allowance_days`) or `unlimited`.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the policy, a UUID v7.

name.description: Human-readable name of the policy (e.g. `Vacaciones estándar`).

allowance_type.description: Whether the yearly allowance is capped (`limited`) or `unlimited`.

allowance_days.description: Days accrued per year when `allowance_type` is `limited`; `null` when `unlimited`.

accrual_method.description: How the allowance accrues: `annual` (all at once) or `monthly` (prorated).

absence_type_ids.description: UUID v7 of each absence type this policy covers.

assigned_employee_count.description: Number of employees currently assigned to the policy.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `active` (usable) or `archived` (retired from use).

carryover.description: How much unused balance carries over at year-end under this policy.

max_days.description: Maximum days that carry over when `type` is `capped`; `null` otherwise.

expiry_month.description: Month (1..12) on which carried-over days expire, or `null` when they do not expire.

expiry_day.description: Day of month on which carried-over days expire, or `null` when they do not expire.

AbsencePolicy.title: AbsencePolicy

AbsencePolicyAssignment.description: An employee assigned to an absence policy. The assignment has no identity of its own; it exposes the assigned employee as `employee_id` (UUID v7) together with the employee’s name.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the assigned employee.

employee_name.description: Full name of the assigned employee.

AbsencePolicyAssignment.title: AbsencePolicyAssignment

AbsenceRequest.description: An absence request for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: an employee’s request to be off for a date range under an absence type. `status` walks `pending → approved | rejected | cancelled`. `day_amount` is the requested amount as an exact decimal string, measured in `measurement_unit` (days or hours). Review fields (`reviewer_user_id`, `review_note`, `reviewed_at`) are `null` while the request is still pending.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the absence request, a UUID v7.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the request belongs to.

absence_type_id.description: UUID v7 of the requested absence type.

absence_type_name.description: Human-readable name of the absence type (e.g. `Vacaciones`).

color.description: Hex color `#RRGGBB` of the absence type, used to render the request on the calendar.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the request: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected` or `cancelled`.

day_amount.description: Requested amount (working days or hours) as an exact decimal string.

measurement_unit.description: Unit the request is measured in: `days` or `hours`.

note.description: Optional note the employee attached when requesting.

reviewer_user_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who approved or rejected the request; `null` while pending.

review_note.description: Reason given on rejection (or note on approval); `null` while pending.

reviewed_at.description: Timestamp of the approval/rejection (ISO 8601); `null` while pending.

AbsenceRequest.title: AbsenceRequest

AbsenceType.description: A configurable absence type for the Control Horario (time tracking) module — what an employee can request (holidays, sick leave, paid leave, …). Its flags decide whether the period is paid (`is_paid`) and whether it needs manager approval (`requires_approval`); `measurement_unit` fixes whether balances are tracked in days or hours.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the absence type, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

name.description: Human-readable name of the absence type (e.g. `Vacaciones`).

is_paid.description: Whether the absence is paid (the employee is compensated for the period).

requires_approval.description: Whether requesting this absence requires a manager’s approval.

measurement_unit.description: Unit in which the absence is measured: `days` or `hours`.

color.description: Hex color `#RRGGBB` used to render the type on the calendar.

visibility.description: Who can see the type: `everyone` or `managers_only`.

is_system.description: Whether it is a default system type seeded for every company.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `active` (usable) or `archived` (retired from use).

AbsenceType.title: AbsenceType

AcceptNifTransferV1Request.description: Body of the tax ID transfer acceptance. It carries the plaintext `secret` exactly as the issuance response returned it, and nothing else. There is NO `company_id` here and it is not an omission: the tax ID is named by the TRANSFER, not by whoever presents it, so accepting one would allow aiming a transfer at a tax ID it does not cover — the request rejects it explicitly instead of ignoring it in silence. The secret travels from the body to the command and dies there: it is never logged, never recorded in any audit metadata, and never returned in the response, not even in the one that spends it.

secret.description: Plaintext secret of the tax ID transfer, exactly as its issuance response returned it.

AcceptNifTransferV1Request.title: AcceptNifTransferV1Request

AcceptProformaRequest.description: Optional body to record the client acceptance: `reason` (string, ≤500 chars) and `metadata` (object, ≤50 keys, ≤500 chars per value) and, when revisioned presentation is enabled, `presentation_precondition` (first capture) and `expected_presentation_uuid` (retained capture).

expected_presentation_uuid.description: UUID of the presentation the caller reviewed. If it is no longer the current presentation of the document the request is rejected with 409 and nothing is changed. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored. Optional: cite the retained capture you reviewed when the proforma already has one; a proforma that was never shared has none to cite and is accepted with `presentation_precondition` alone.

presentation_precondition.description: Optional reviewed presentation precondition. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

AcceptProformaRequest.title: AcceptProformaRequest

AcceptQuoteRequest.description: Optional body to record the acceptance of the quote: `accepted_on` (date, defaults to today) and `notes` and, when revisioned presentation is enabled, `presentation_precondition` (first capture) and `expected_presentation_uuid` (retained capture). A quote whose `valid_until` date has already passed cannot be accepted (422 `quote_expired`).

presentation_precondition.description: Optional reviewed presentation precondition. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

expected_presentation_uuid.description: UUID of the presentation the caller reviewed. If it is no longer the current presentation of the document the request is rejected with 409 and nothing is changed. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored. Optional: cite the retained capture you reviewed when the quote already has one; a quote that was never shared has none to cite and is accepted with `presentation_precondition` alone.

AcceptQuoteRequest.title: AcceptQuoteRequest

Account.description: Snapshot of the company, plan, Developer API entitlement, personalization and metadata of the API key used to make the request. To introspect the calling credential and its scope of tax IDs, use `GET /v1/me` instead, which returns the `Me` resource.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `account` for this resource.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. AEAT control-digit (checksum) validation is enforced when the request opts in via the `Factuarea-Version` header on or after the activation version; without that opt-in the legacy permissive behaviour is preserved.

addon.description: Developer API entitlement derived from the company plan. The `addon` property name is retained for backwards compatibility.

active.description: true when the company plan includes Developer API access.

in_grace.description: Legacy compatibility field. The plan-based entitlement does not grant an add-on grace period.

expires_at.description: Legacy compatibility field. Always null for the canonical plan-based entitlement.

api_key.description: Metadata of the API key used to authenticate the request. The secret is never returned (it is only shown once at creation time).

name.description: Human-friendly label assigned at creation time.

prefix.description: First chars of the key (e.g. `fact_live_1N0Fnyhh`) — safe to log.

scopes.description: Authorized scopes. `*` means super scope (full access).

tier.description: Rate-limit tier (`free`, `starter`, `pro`, `scale`). Derived from the company plan (or preserved by historical grandfathering).

environment.description: Environment of the authenticated key: `live` (`fact_live_` prefix, real side effects) or `test` (`fact_test_` prefix, sandbox company, no real-world effects).

personalization.description: Account personalization: invoice-emission language and PDF template/accent color. Mutable via `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/personalization`.

language.description: Invoice-emission language of the account. One of `es`, `en`, `ca`.

pdf_template.description: Slug of the invoice PDF template (closed `PdfTemplate` catalog).

accent_color.description: Accent color of the PDF in `#RRGGBB` hex, or null when not configured.

Account.title: Account

AccountBilling.description: Billing snapshot of the authenticated company: current plan (trial, grace period, pending change), additional NIF subscription in `gestoria_seats` (when the account has additional tax IDs) and payment method. A tax ID whose billing is paid by another account returns `managed: true` with plan `gestionada`, no additional NIF subscription and no payment method: what the payer pays is never shown to it.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `account_billing` for this resource.

managed.description: true when the effective tax ID is paid by another account: it has no plan billing of its own, so `gestoria_seats` and `payment_method` are null.

plan.description: Current plan subscription of the account.

status.description: Subscription status (e.g. `active`, `trialing`, `blocked`).

billing_interval.description: Billing interval of the plan, or null when there is no paid subscription.

is_on_grace_period.description: true when the plan was cancelled but remains usable until `ends_at`.

current_period_end.description: End of the current billing period (ISO 8601), or null.

ends_at.description: Scheduled end of the subscription (ISO 8601) when cancelled, or null.

pending_change.description: Scheduled plan change taking effect at the end of the current period, or null.

gestoria_seats.description: Additional NIF subscription of the account (one seat per active additional tax ID; the field keeps its original public name `gestoria_seats` for compatibility), or null when the account has no additional tax IDs. Amounts are in euros as 2-decimal strings and are null when the recurring cost is not resolvable (enterprise outside Stripe, sandbox, no active plan) — never a misleading 0.

status.description: Status of the additional NIF subscription (`active`, `past_due`, …), or `none` when there is no subscription yet (e.g. trial: additional tax IDs are free).

quantity.description: Number of billed seats (one per active additional tax ID) in the additional NIF subscription.

active_companies.description: Number of ACTIVE additional tax IDs of the account.

unit_amount.description: Taxable base of one seat per billing cycle, in euros as a 2-decimal string.

tax_rate.description: Applied VAT rate (e.g. 21), or null when not resolved.

tax_amount.description: VAT amount of one seat, in euros as a 2-decimal string.

total_per_seat.description: Base + VAT of one seat, in euros as a 2-decimal string.

recurring_total.description: Projected recurring total (`total_per_seat` × `quantity`), in euros as a 2-decimal string. Null when VAT is not resolved.

billing_interval.description: The seat is always billed monthly, regardless of the plan interval.

next_invoice_at.description: Next invoice date of the additional NIF subscription (ISO 8601), or null.

ends_at.description: Scheduled end of the additional NIF subscription (ISO 8601) when cancelled at period end, or null.

payment_method.description: Default payment method on file, or null when none is configured.

last_four.description: Last four digits of the card.

AccountBilling.title: AccountBilling

AccountEventEnvelope.description: The signed body an account webhook endpoint receives on every delivery: the envelope of a company event plus `account`, `account_relationship` and `company_id`. The same event carries the same `id` in its company envelope and in this one, so a receiver can deduplicate. Requests are signed with the `Factuarea-Signature` header, as for company endpoints.

id.description: Identifier (UUID v7) of the event. It is also sent in the `Factuarea-Event-Id` header and is the `Idempotency-Key` of the delivery.

anyOf.description: A company event type of the public catalog, for the events of a tax ID forwarded to the account.

type.description: Type of the event: an account-level type of `AccountEventType`, or a company event type when the event is about a tax ID.

api_version.description: Payload version (`YYYY-MM-DD`) the `data` is shaped in.

created.description: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

livemode.description: `true` for an event of the live environment, `false` for the test environment.

test.description: `true` on a synthetic event sent by the test operation of the endpoint; it is not related to `livemode`.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier of the request or process that caused the event, or `null`.

account.description: The account the endpoint belongs to.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of your account.

account_relationship.description: Relationship of the event with your account: `own` (about your account or one of its tax IDs) or `managed` (about an account your account manages).

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID the event is about. Always present: `null` in the account-level events that are not about a tax ID.

data.description: The content of the event, in the version of `api_version`.

type.description: Type of the event, the same as the envelope `type`.

object.description: Snapshot of what the event is about. In an account-level event it is the member, owner, grant, relation, tax ID or import concerned, always with opaque identifiers (UUID v7) and never with internal ones; in a company event it is the same snapshot the company webhook carries.

AccountEventEnvelope.title: AccountEventEnvelope

AccountEventType.description: Type of an account-level event (the `account.*` catalog). Only account webhook endpoints can subscribe to them: they are not part of the company event catalog (`GET /v1/event-catalog`). Members: `account.member_added`, `account.member_removed`, `account.member_role_changed`, `account.owner_transferred` and `account.member_grant_changed`. Relations between accounts: `account.access_granted`, `account.access_revoked` and `account.access_level_changed`. Managed accounts: `account.managed_account_provisioned`, `account.managed_account_claimed` and `account.management_ended`. Tax IDs of the account: `account.nif_added`, `account.nif_transferred` and `account.nif_archived`. Bulk imports: `account.import_completed`.
AccountEventType.title: AccountEventType

AccountInvitation.description: An invitation to join your ACCOUNT with an account role and its initial grants. The acceptance secret is never part of this representation: publishing it would turn a read permission into an effective power to add members, and one that would survive revoking the credential.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the invitation, a UUID v7.

email.description: Address the invitation was sent to.

role.description: Account role the person would join with. `owner` never appears: ownership is transferred, never handed out by invitation.

items.description: The access of a `member` to one tax ID of the account. Only a `member` carries grants: an `owner` or `admin` reaches every tax ID of the account without one.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID of the account the grant applies to.

level.description: Access level on that tax ID: `view` is read-only, `operate` can also write.

grants.description: Initial per-tax-ID grants of a `member` invitation, limited to the tax IDs your credential reads. Always empty for an `admin`.

send_email.description: Whether the invitation was delivered by email (`false`: the link was copied and delivered by whoever invited).

external_advisor.description: Whether this is the invitation of the external advisor of the account (only created from the web app).

status.description: Derived state. `accepted` and `revoked` are final; `expired` only applies to an invitation that was still pending when its expiry passed.

created_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601) the invitation was created, or `null` when it is not known.

sent_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601) of the last send: the creation or the last resend. `null` when it is not known.

invited_by.description: The person who created the invitation. `null` when that person no longer belongs to the account.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the person.

name.description: Full name of the person.

AccountInvitation.title: AccountInvitation

AccountInvitationList.description: Cursor-paginated list of account invitations (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`). The acceptance secret never appears here.

data.description: Page of account invitations.

has_more.description: `true` when more invitations exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`.

AccountInvitationList.title: AccountInvitationList

AccountInvitationWithSecret.description: The response of creating or resending an account invitation: the fields of `AccountInvitation` PLUS the acceptance `secret` and `accept_url`. They are returned ONLY for a copy-link invitation (`send_email: false`), and only once: when the invitation is delivered by email (`send_email: true`) the secret travels only in that email and both fields are `null`. They are not stored in the clear, not even in the idempotency cache, so an idempotent replay returns both as `null`. Resending issues a NEW secret and the previous one stops working.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the invitation, a UUID v7.

email.description: Address the invitation was sent to.

role.description: Account role the person would join with. `owner` never appears: ownership is transferred, never handed out by invitation.

items.description: The access of a `member` to one tax ID of the account. Only a `member` carries grants: an `owner` or `admin` reaches every tax ID of the account without one.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID of the account the grant applies to.

level.description: Access level on that tax ID: `view` is read-only, `operate` can also write.

grants.description: Initial per-tax-ID grants of a `member` invitation, limited to the tax IDs your credential reads. Always empty for an `admin`.

send_email.description: Whether the invitation was delivered by email (`false`: the link was copied and delivered by whoever invited).

external_advisor.description: Whether this is the invitation of the external advisor of the account (only created from the web app).

status.description: Derived state. `accepted` and `revoked` are final; `expired` only applies to an invitation that was still pending when its expiry passed.

created_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601) the invitation was created, or `null` when it is not known.

sent_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601) of the last send: the creation or the last resend. `null` when it is not known.

invited_by.description: The person who created the invitation. `null` when that person no longer belongs to the account.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the person.

name.description: Full name of the person.

secret.description: The plaintext acceptance secret, returned ONCE for a copy-link invitation (`send_email: false`). Treat it as a credential: anyone holding it can accept the invitation. `null` when the invitation is delivered by email and in an idempotent replay.

accept_url.description: Acceptance link carrying the secret, returned ONCE, to deliver yourself when `send_email` is `false`. `null` when the invitation is delivered by email and in an idempotent replay.

AccountInvitationWithSecret.title: AccountInvitationWithSecret

AccountMember.description: A member of your ACCOUNT. The membership is of the account, not of a tax ID: an `owner` or `admin` reaches every tax ID of the account, and a `member` only the tax IDs of its `grants`.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the account member, a UUID v7. It is the `{member}` of the member routes, not the identifier of the person.

name.description: Full name of the person.

role.description: Account role. There is exactly one `owner`; ownership is transferred, never assigned.

external_advisor.description: Whether this member is the external advisor of the account (always a `member`, at most one per account, and it does not take a seat of the plan).

items.description: The access of a `member` to one tax ID of the account. Only a `member` carries grants: an `owner` or `admin` reaches every tax ID of the account without one.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID of the account the grant applies to.

level.description: Access level on that tax ID: `view` is read-only, `operate` can also write.

grants.description: Per-tax-ID grants of a `member`, limited to the tax IDs your credential reads. Always empty for an `owner` or `admin`.

joined_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601) the person joined the account, or `null` when it is not known.

last_access_at.description: Lower bound (ISO 8601) of the last time the person accessed the account, or `null` if they never did. It reflects the last session, not every request.

AccountMember.title: AccountMember

AccountMemberGrant.description: The access of a `member` to one tax ID of the account. Only a `member` carries grants: an `owner` or `admin` reaches every tax ID of the account without one.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID of the account the grant applies to.

level.description: Access level on that tax ID: `view` is read-only, `operate` can also write.

AccountMemberGrant.title: AccountMemberGrant

AccountMemberGrantList.description: The grants of one account member with the canonical list envelope (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`). The collection is complete — bounded by the tax IDs of the account — so `has_more` is always `false` and `next_cursor` always `null`.

data.description: Grants on the tax IDs your credential reads.

has_more.description: Always `false`: the collection is complete.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: the collection is complete.

AccountMemberGrantList.title: AccountMemberGrantList

AccountMemberList.description: Cursor-paginated list of account members (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`).

data.description: Page of account members.

has_more.description: `true` when more members exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`.

AccountMemberList.title: AccountMemberList

AccountMemberPermissions.description: What the person behind the credential can do on this member right now. It is computed for the reader, so two credentials can read different permissions for the same member.

can_change_role.description: Whether the reader can change the account role of this member.

assignable_roles.description: Roles the reader can assign to this member; empty when `can_change_role` is `false`.

can_remove.description: Whether the reader can remove this member from the account.

can_transfer_ownership.description: Whether the reader can transfer the account ownership to this member.

can_edit_grants.description: Whether the reader can set or revoke the grants of this member.

AccountMemberPermissions.title: AccountMemberPermissions

AccountNifStatsList.description: Invoicing statistics of every company (tax ID) your credential reads in the account (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`). Not paginated: an account holds a bounded set of companies, so `has_more` is always `false` and `next_cursor` always `null`.

data.description: One row per company of the account your credential reads (active and inactive; archived ones are not included).

has_more.description: Always `false`: the whole list is returned in one response.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: there is no next page.

AccountNifStatsList.title: AccountNifStatsList

AccountOwner.description: The ownership of an account after a transfer. It carries NO `id` and that is not an omission: its identity is `account_id`, because the subject of the resource is the ownership of the account and not an entity of its own.

account_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the account.

owner_user_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the person who now owns the account.

previous_owner_user_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the person who owned it before.

AccountOwner.title: AccountOwner

AccountPersonalizationTemplates.description: Plan-aware catalog of PDF templates available for the account, plus the accepted hex format for the accent color. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/personalization/templates`. Use it to discover which `pdf_template` slugs and colors can be set via `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/personalization`.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `personalization_templates` for this resource.

templates.description: Available PDF templates for the account's plan.

available.description: Whether the template is available for the account's current plan.

accent_color.description: Accepted format for the `accent_color` of the PDF.

AccountPersonalizationTemplates.title: AccountPersonalizationTemplates

AccountUsage.description: Usage of the whole account for the current billing period, with the per-NIF breakdown. It is an AGGREGATE, not an entity: it carries no `id` because the subject is the period, and the period is named by its own boundaries.

period.description: Boundaries of the period being reported.

start.description: First day of the period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

end.description: Last day of the period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

requests_count.description: Public API requests attributed to the account in the period, across every NIF in its scope.

documents_count.description: Documents issued by the account in the period, across every NIF in its scope.

companies.description: Breakdown per NIF. A NIF with no activity still appears, with zeros: leaving it out would make "no activity" and "not in the account" look the same.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the NIF.

requests_count.description: Requests attributed to this NIF in the period.

documents_count.description: Documents issued under this NIF in the period.

AccountUsage.title: AccountUsage

AccountWebhook.description: A webhook endpoint of your ACCOUNT: where the events of the tax IDs your account holds or manages, and the account-level events, are delivered, which ones, with which relationship filter, in which environment and in which state. The signing secret is never part of this representation.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the account webhook endpoint. It is the `{webhook}` of the endpoint routes.

environment.description: Environment of the endpoint: always the one of the credential that created it, and it never changes. A `live` credential never sees a `test` endpoint and the other way round. A `test` endpoint never reaches the network: its deliveries are recorded with their envelope and stay `pending`.

url.description: HTTPS callback URL that receives the signed events.

enabled_events.description: Event types this endpoint subscribes to: the company events of the public catalog (`GET /v1/event-catalog`) and the account-level events of `AccountEventType`. Duplicates are collapsed.

account_relationship.description: Whose tax IDs the endpoint hears about: `own` (the tax IDs of your account), `managed` (the accounts your account manages) or `all` (the default).

status.description: `active` while the endpoint receives events; `disabled` once it stopped receiving them (the reason is in `disabled_reason`).

disabled_reason.description: Why the endpoint was disabled, or `null` while it is active. `creator_lost_capability`: the person or key that created it stopped being an owner or admin of the account, or no longer reaches every tax ID of the account.

api_version.description: Payload version (date-based, `YYYY-MM-DD`) pinned for this endpoint. A new endpoint is pinned to the latest version when created; `null` makes it follow the version in force on every emission.

description.description: Free text you give the endpoint, or `null`.

updated_at.description: When the endpoint was last changed (ISO 8601).

AccountWebhook.title: AccountWebhook

AccountWebhookDelivery.description: The delivery of ONE event to ONE account webhook endpoint: which event, about which tax ID, with which relationship to your account, in which state, how many attempts it took, what your server answered and the signed envelope that was sent. Unlike a company delivery, a manual retry re-arms this same delivery instead of creating another one.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the delivery. It is the `{delivery}` of the delivery routes.

event_id.description: Identifier (UUID v7) of the event this delivery carries: the same `id` as its envelope, so a receiver can deduplicate. A company event keeps the id it has in the event log.

event_type.description: Type of the event delivered: an account-level type of `AccountEventType` or a company event type of the public catalog.

event_source.description: Where the event comes from: `company` (an event of a tax ID forwarded to the account) or `account` (an `account.*` event).

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID the event is about, or `null` in the `account.*` events that are not about a tax ID.

account_relationship.description: Relationship of THIS delivery with your account: `own` (a tax ID of your account) or `managed` (an account your account manages). It is not the filter of the endpoint.

environment.description: Environment of the delivery, the one of its endpoint.

status.description: Delivery status. `pending` (queued or waiting for its next attempt; in the `test` environment a delivery is recorded but never sent, so it stays `pending`), `delivered` (a 2xx was received), `failed` (a recoverable failure), `failed_permanently` (attempts exhausted or the destination refused it; it can be retried by hand) and `cancelled` (aborted, terminal; see `cancel_reason`).

manual_retry_count.description: Times the delivery was re-armed by hand with the retry operation. It is a different counter from `attempt`.

next_retry_at.description: When the next attempt is scheduled (ISO 8601), or `null`.

response_status.description: HTTP status returned by your server on the last attempt, or `null`.

response_body.description: Body returned by your server on the last attempt, truncated, or `null`.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the last attempt in milliseconds, or `null`.

payload.description: The signed envelope that was sent, in the version of `payload_api_version`; `null` when it can no longer be read and always `null` on a `cancelled` delivery, which drops its envelope when it is cancelled.

payload_api_version.description: Payload version (`YYYY-MM-DD`) the envelope was built in.

cancel_reason.description: Stable code of why the delivery was cancelled (endpoint deleted or disabled, tax ID no longer eligible…), only on a `cancelled` delivery; `null` otherwise.

delivered_at.description: When your server accepted the delivery (ISO 8601), or `null`.

failed_at.description: When the last failed attempt happened (ISO 8601), or `null`.

AnnulInvoiceV1Request.description: Annul an issued invoice. `reason` (3–500 characters) is required and is kept in the audit trail and, with VeriFactu, in the cancellation record. `revert_collections` (default `false`) reverts every live payment of the invoice and annuls it in one atomic operation — only for an invoice issued by mistake.

reason.description: Why the invoice is annulled (3–500 characters). It is kept in the audit trail and, when the company is enrolled in VeriFactu, it becomes the reason of the AEAT cancellation record. When `revert_collections` is `true` it is also the note of every reverted payment.

revert_collections.description: When `true`, every live payment of the invoice is reverted with the reserved reason `issued_in_error` and the invoice is annulled, all in ONE atomic operation: if any step fails no payment stays reverted. Use it only when the invoice was issued by mistake (a duplicated charge at a kiosk); if the customer has to get the money back, issue a corrective instead. Defaults to `false`: an invoice with live payments is then rejected with 422 `invoice_has_active_collections`.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the scope is not available, or `null` when it is. `module_not_granted` means the company does not have the gestoría module (upgrading the plan grants it); `company_is_managed_child` means the company is not the titular company of its account: the portfolio belongs to the account and its titular represents it, so no plan unlocks it for an additional tax ID.

AutomationDryRun.description: What an automation rule WOULD do against a sample event, without materialising a single effect: no e-mail is sent, no webhook delivery is created, no target entity is mutated, no run or step row is written, and neither the monthly budget nor the rate limit is consumed. That is why the operation only requires the read scope even though it is a POST.

automation_rule_id.description: UUID v7 of the automation rule that was tested.

trigger_type.description: Trigger declared by the rule, in `resource.action` form. It is the only event type the rule can be tested against.

matched.description: Whether the condition of the rule would be satisfied by the sample payload. When `false`, no step would fire.

condition_trace.description: One entry per LEAF node that was evaluated, in evaluation order — which is the order the condition was written in. An empty array with `matched: true` means the rule has no condition and always acts. Same shape the real execution path produces.

path.description: Path of the evaluated field inside the `data.object` of the sample event.

expected.description: Comparison value declared by the condition. Its shape follows the `value_shape` of the operator: a scalar, an array of scalars, or `null` for operators that take no value.

observed.description: Value actually found at `path` in the sample payload, or `null` when the field was absent.

condition_error.description: Why the condition could not be evaluated, in Spanish, or `null` when it evaluated fine. It travels in the DOCUMENT with a 200, not as an HTTP failure: seeing why a rule cannot be evaluated BEFORE activating it is exactly what the dry run is for. Not redundant with `matched`: a non-null error implies `matched: false`, but the common case is a condition that evaluates perfectly and simply is not satisfied.

steps.description: One entry per action, in the order they would run.

index.description: Position the step WOULD have in the real run — the one that results from ordering the actions by their `order`, not the position in the stored array. It matches the `step_index` you would later replay.

action_type.description: Raw value of the action type, exactly as stored in the definition. Returned verbatim and NOT as a closed enum: a type retired from the catalogue must still be countable in a dry run instead of breaking it.

executable.description: Whether the code path reached the edge of the effect without anything discarding it. It never promises the effect would SUCCEED. It is `false` in three cases: the condition of the rule is not satisfied, the action type has no registered adapter, or the adapter refused the action because of some state of the world.

resolved_parameters.description: Parameters that would be frozen into the step — those of the current rule definition. `{}` when the action takes none.

effects.description: Traces of the effects that would fire, in order. Same shape the real execution path records.

kind.description: Family of the effect (sending an e-mail, mutating a document, …).

target.description: What the effect would act on.

summary.description: What the adapter derived from the parameters — recipient, subject, document — which is where the detail of the effect is readable. `{}` when there is none.

simulated.description: Always `true` here: the trace comes from the simulator, never from a materialised effect.

reason.description: Why the step would NOT run, in Spanish, or `null` when it would. A guardrail that would also cut the real execution shows up here as a non-executable step instead of faking success.

AutomationRun.description: One execution of an automation rule, with its steps. Delivered as the `data.object` of the `automation_run.*` webhook events, captured at emission time and frozen there: a run snapshotted while `running` keeps showing `running` even after it completes. It carries the frozen definition it executed (`rule_version` + `rule_snapshot`) and the frozen payload of the event that triggered it (`event_payload`), so an execution stays readable weeks later, when the rule has moved on to a newer version.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the run, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

automation_rule_id.description: UUID v7 of the automation rule that produced this run.

rule_version.description: Version number of the rule definition this run executed. It can lag behind the rule’s `current_version`: editing a rule never rewrites past runs.

rule_snapshot.description: The rule definition of `rule_version`, frozen at execution time (its condition tree and its actions with their parameters). Returned verbatim, because its shape is defined by the account owner.

trigger_type.description: Event the rule listens to, in `resource.action` form. It is the trigger of the rule, not necessarily identical to `event_name` in future versions of the matcher.

subject_company.description: The tax ID this run acted upon, when it comes from a rule of scope `cartera`. It is `null` for runs of scope `empresa`, which act on the company that owns the rule and have no subject. `id` and `name` are themselves `null` when the company cannot be read at that moment: the block is still emitted, so a portfolio run stays distinguishable from a company-scoped one. When the tax ID is deleted, the run is kept but its link to the company is cleared, so `subject_company` becomes `null`, as in a run of scope `empresa`.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the tax ID, a UUID v7, or `null` when it can no longer be read.

name.description: Name of the tax ID, or `null` when it can no longer be read.

event_name.description: Public name of the event that triggered this run (e.g. `invoice.paid`), one of the types returned by `GET /v1/event-catalog`.

event_aggregate_id.description: UUID v7 of the resource the triggering event happened on (the invoice that was paid, the quote that was accepted, …).

event_occurred_on.description: When the triggering event happened (ISO 8601), or `null` when the emitter did not record it.

event_payload.description: The `data.object` of the triggering event, frozen at execution time. Its keys are those of the resource of `event_name`, so the shape varies with the trigger and it is returned verbatim.

correlation_id.description: Identifier shared by everything that descends from the same originating event, so a chain of automations can be followed end to end. `null` when the emitter did not propagate one.

chain_depth.description: How deep this run sits in a chain of automations triggering one another (`0` for a run triggered directly by a business event). The platform caps the depth to stop runaway chains: a run over the cap is blocked with reason `chain_depth_exceeded`.

status.description: State of the run: `pending` (queued), `running`, `completed`, `failed` (finished without producing its effect and not reprocessable), `dead_lettered` (parked awaiting a manual replay) or `blocked` (stopped by a guardrail such as the chain-depth cap, the rate limit or the monthly budget).

discard_reason.description: Classified reason why the run did not produce its effect, or `null` while it has not finished in the red. It is what tells apart a run stopped by a guardrail (`chain_depth_exceeded`, `rate_limit_exceeded`, `monthly_budget_exhausted`) from one that exhausted its attempts (`step_attempts_exhausted`) or timed out (`run_execution_timeout`) — a guardrail cut-off has no step carrying a reason, so this is the only place it shows. Returned VERBATIM as stored: the current engine writes values of a closed catalogue, but rows written before that catalogue existed still hold free-form text, so do not model this as a fixed enum.

discard_reason_label.description: Human-readable label of `discard_reason`, in Spanish. `null` when there is no reason, or when the stored value predates the closed catalogue and therefore cannot be interpreted — in that case `discard_reason` still carries the raw value. The label is always Spanish: it is part of the vocabulary of the automation engine and does not follow `Accept-Language`.

last_error.description: Technical message of the last failure, or `null`. Free-form text meant for debugging: the classified reason of the outcome is `discard_reason` (and the `discard_reason` of each step), an orthogonal axis.

started_at.description: When the run started (ISO 8601), or `null` while it is still queued.

finished_at.description: When the run reached its outcome (ISO 8601), or `null` while it has not finished.

created_at.description: When the run row was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: When the run row was last modified (ISO 8601).

steps.description: Steps of the run, ALWAYS in execution order — the order is part of the contract, because `step_index` is the identity of a step. The `automation_run.step_dead_lettered` event publishes the index of the parked step as the extra key `data.step_index`: resolve it here, against the element whose `step_index` matches.

items.description: One step of a run: an action of the frozen rule definition together with its outcome. It is the same document that `GET /v1/companies/{company}/automations/runs/{run}/steps` returns as `AutomationStepRun`, inlined here so a run is readable in one call.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the step, a UUID v7.

step_index.description: Zero-based position of the step inside its run, unique within the run. It is the identity of the step: it is what `automation_run.step_dead_lettered` publishes as `data.step_index`, and what `POST /v1/companies/{company}/automations/runs/{run}/steps/{step_index}/replay` takes.

action_type.description: Type of action of the step, as frozen in the rule version snapshot.

status.description: State of the step: `pending`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `skipped`, `dead_lettered` (parked awaiting a manual replay) or `blocked` (stopped by a guardrail).

parameters.description: Parameters of the action, frozen from the rule version snapshot. `{}` when the action takes none.

result.description: Trace the action adapter returned. `{}` while the step has not finished, or when the adapter produced no trace.

discard_reason.description: Classified reason of the step outcome, or `null` when there is none. Returned VERBATIM as stored: the current engine writes values of a closed catalogue (`condition_not_matched`, `chain_depth_exceeded`, `step_attempts_exhausted`, …), but rows written before that catalogue existed still hold free-form text, so do not model this as a fixed enum. The catalogue value IS guaranteed on the `data.discard_reason` extra of `automation_run.step_dead_lettered`.

discard_reason_label.description: Human-readable label of `discard_reason`, in Spanish. `null` when there is no reason, or when the stored value predates the closed catalogue and therefore cannot be interpreted — in that case `discard_reason` still carries the raw value. The label is always Spanish: it is part of the vocabulary of the automation engine and does not follow `Accept-Language`.

replayable.description: Whether replaying this step can produce a different outcome. `true` only for reasons caused by an external state you can change (a disconnected channel, a client without an e-mail address, exhausted attempts): those park the step in `dead_lettered`, the only state that allows re-entry. `false` for reasons frozen into the rule snapshot (an unregistered action type, invalid parameters) and for guardrail cut-offs, where a replay would take exactly the same branch. Also `false` when the reason is unknown to the catalogue.

last_error.description: Technical message of the last failure of the step, or `null`. Orthogonal axis to `discard_reason`: this one is the raw message, that one is the classification.

next_retry_at.description: When the step is scheduled to be retried (ISO 8601), or `null` when no retry is pending.

claimed_at.description: When a worker claimed the step (ISO 8601), or `null` while unclaimed.

finished_at.description: When the step reached its outcome (ISO 8601), or `null` while it has not finished.

AutomationTriggerFields.description: The fields of ONE trigger that an automation condition can evaluate, with the operators each field accepts. Served per trigger, not inside the catalogue: with around a hundred visible triggers and dozens of properties each, a single document would be hundreds of kilobytes to end up using the fields of one.

trigger.description: Trigger these fields belong to, in `resource.action` form. It travels in the body as well as in the URL so a cached response stays interpretable on its own.

fields.description: Evaluable fields, in the order the payload contract declares them. This list is never empty: a trigger without a declared payload contract is rejected as such instead of degrading to an empty list.

path.description: Path of the field relative to the `data.object` of the event. This is the value you put in the `field` of a condition.

type_label.description: Human-readable name of the type, already translated.

AutomationUsage.description: Current active automation rules and automation runs consumed this period, with the limits of the plan. Activating a rule checks the active-rule cap; the execution budget is checked only when admitting a run. Read both counters to anticipate reaching either limit. The figure comes from the same counter the engine applies when admitting a run, so it advances by exactly N after N admitted runs and does NOT change when run history is purged.

consumed.description: Automation runs already consumed in the current period.

limit.description: Cap of the plan for the period, or `null` when there is no automatic ceiling. Enterprise capacity is agreed by contract. `null` is not an unknown value or zero: omit the progress bar.

limit.description: Active-rule cap of the plan. Zero permits no activations; null means no automatic ceiling. Enterprise capacity is agreed by contract.

BaseUnitChange.description: Whether the base unit of the product can be edited in place. `mode` is `direct` exactly when there are no blockers; with blockers it is `replacement` and the base unit is changed by replacing the product (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/base-unit-replacement`); an already replaced product is `unavailable` with no blockers. Attempting to edit `base_unit` with blockers is rejected with 422 `business_rule_violation`, subcode `product_base_unit_locked`, and the same `blockers` in `details`. Only calculated on single-product reads (show, create, update, replacement): list responses omit the key.

after.description: Relevant values as strings (`quantity`, `unit_code`, `price`, `conversion_factor`, …). `null` when the element did not exist before or is not transferred.

BulkCreateInvoicesV1Request.description: Create invoices in bulk. `invoices[]` holds up to 100 invoice payloads and `dry_run` (default `false`) validates each row without persisting. Per-row rules (format, duplicate `external_id`, recipient AEAT census) are reported per row instead of failing the whole batch. Each invoices.N may include payment_terms; bulk is create-only, so duplicate `external_id` values do not upsert an existing invoice and expected_payment_terms_version is not accepted. There is no top-level calendar block. The schedule uses the same closed row/account shapes, signed strings, balance and optional non-null UUID v7 id semantics as singular create; omitted ids are generated on actual creation. dry_run does not assign persisted ids; `invalid_invoice_payment_terms` and its exact `payment_terms.N` field path are reported per row, not as a top-level 422; actual execution uses the shared assembler.

dry_run.description: Whether the operation ran in validate-only mode (no invoice was created).

total.description: Number of rows processed (`successful + failed`).

successful.description: Number of rows that validated successfully (`dry_run=true`) or were created (`dry_run=false`).

failed.description: Number of rows that were invalid or could not be created. Equals `failures` length in create mode.

results.description: Per-row classification of validate-only mode (`dry_run=true`). Empty in create mode.

index.description: 0-based position of the row within the batch.

status.description: Row status: `valid` (would be created without error) or `invalid` (has blocking errors).

errors.description: Per-field blocking issues of the row. Empty when the row is valid.

warnings.description: Per-field non-blocking warnings of the row (e.g. recipient not found in the AEAT census). Empty when there are none.

failures.description: Rows that could not be created (create mode, `dry_run=false`). Each item carries the 0-based `index`, an `error_code`, a Spanish `error_message` and the per-field `errors[]`. Empty in validate-only mode.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code from the v1 error catalog (stable across languages).

BulkPartialSuccessResult.description: Result of a bulk or import operation that reports per-resource status. `total` is how many rows/resources were processed (`successful + failed`), `successful` how many were applied (deleted, created or validated) and `failed` how many could not be processed. `failures[]` carries one item per failed row. Shape shared by every bulk endpoint of the public API (the bulk-delete endpoints emit it today). Anchored integrators before `2026-09-01` keep receiving the previous `{object, deleted, failed[{id, reason}]}` shape via `Factuarea-Version`.

total.description: Number of rows/resources processed (`successful + failed`).

successful.description: Number of rows/resources processed successfully (deleted, created or validated).

failed.description: Number of rows/resources that could not be processed. Equals `failures` length.

failures.description: One item per failed row/resource. Always a list (empty, never `null`, when there are no failures).

items.description: A failed row/resource. Identity is polymorphic: `id` for an existing resource (bulk-delete/bulk-send/bulk-pdf), or `index` for a new row without a resource yet (bulk-create with `dry_run`, import CSV). Exactly one of `id`/`index` is present.

id.description: UUID v7 of the existing resource that could not be processed. Present for bulk operations over existing resources (e.g. bulk-delete).

index.description: 0-based position of the row within the batch. Present for new rows without a resource yet (bulk-create with `dry_run`, import CSV).

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code from the v1 error catalog (stable across languages). For bulk-delete: `resource_not_found` or `resource_not_deletable`.

error_message.description: Human-readable reason for the failure, in Spanish (internal messages are not exposed).

errors.description: Per-field blocking issues (validate-only / bulk-create flows). Empty or absent for bulk-delete.

warnings.description: Per-field non-blocking warnings (validate-only / bulk-create flows). Empty or absent for bulk-delete.

Every transition passes the document state guard, and invoices that cannot transition are returned under `failures[]`.

new_status.description: Target status: `issued` issues each draft (definitive number, VeriFactu record) without sending any email; `paid` records a payment for the outstanding amount of each issued invoice. `sent` is accepted as an alias of `issued` in every API version and never sets the delivery mark (`is_sent`).

A product or variant that is unknown (or does not belong to the product) is skipped. `items` is accepted as an alias of `updates`.

updates.description: Up to 500 entries `{product_id, stock, operation?, variant_id?}`. `variant_id` targets the own balance of a variant of that product; entries whose product or variant is unknown are skipped silently.

product_id.description: UUID v7 of the product. A product that does not exist or does not belong to your company is skipped, without revealing whether it exists.

assignee_id.description: `id` of the new assignee, a member of the company; `null` removes the assignee.

BusinessContact.description: A canonical business contact with cumulative customer, supplier and fiscal lead roles, or no assigned role. The fiscal lead role requires the same fiscal identity as other contacts; pre-fiscal opportunities belong to the separately planned CRM.

id.description: Public UUID v7. Internal numeric keys are never exposed.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates. Each axis is nullable independently; the object is null only when neither axis is recorded.

dir3_proponent.description: Canonical DIR3 code of the proposing body (role 04): 9-10 uppercase alphanumeric characters starting with a letter. Not a foreign key. Always present for a customer profile; null when no proponent is recorded, including historical contacts.

financial_summary.description: Directional sales and purchases totals for this contact, as 2-decimal strings. Amounts use the currency declared in each direction.

latest_activity.description: Most recent sales or purchases movement, or `null` when the contact has no financial activity.

BusinessContact.title: BusinessContact

BusinessContactActivity.description: An item in the canonical contact timeline. It combines sales, purchases and relationship changes in reverse chronological order.

amount.description: Amount of the movement in EUR as a 2-decimal string, or `null` when the activity carries no amount.

metadata.description: Sanitized event metadata. Internal numeric identifiers are removed.

BusinessContactActivity.title: BusinessContactActivity

BusinessContactImport.description: Tracking of a contact import. `outcomes` lists at most 500 rows (`outcomes_truncated`); `skip_reasons` counts the skipped rows by reason.

outcome_kind.description: `nothing_changed` means the import finished without creating or updating anything; do not present it as a success.

severity.description: Only present on warnings; errors omit it.

received_value.description: Received cell value, truncated to 120 characters.

errors.description: Errors and warnings of the row.

BusinessContactImport.title: BusinessContactImport

reason.description: Why the row is skipped, failed or leaves the contact unchanged; null when the row is applied.

result.description: Present for confirmed execution rows; omitted from planned preview rows.

merge_candidate.description: Rows matching an existing contact under the `merge` strategy: nothing is applied and they are flagged for manual review (`reason=merge_review_required`).

skip.description: Rows that change nothing: identical to the existing contact (`no_changes`) or targeting an archived contact (`update_not_allowed`).

import_uuid.description: Persisted import reference for synchronous and queued execution; null for dry-run.

outcome_kind.description: Business reading of a finished execution, same as the tracking resource; null for preview, dry-run and queued imports. `nothing_changed` means nothing was created or updated; do not present it as a success.

status.description: Persisted execution status; null for preview and dry-run. Synchronous responses can be failed with unprocessed rows after a concurrent closure.

BusinessContactStats.description: Aggregated counters for canonical identities and their cumulative customer, supplier and fiscal lead roles. A contact with multiple roles is counted once in `total` and in each applicable role counter.
BusinessContactStats.title: BusinessContactStats

taxes_id.description: Identifier (UUID v7) of the tax to apply, from the Factuarea catalog plus your company's own taxes. A well-formed but non-existent value returns 404 `tax_not_found`.

CalculateTaxRequest.title: CalculateTaxRequest

CalculateTotalsRequest.title: CalculateTotalsRequest

CanAnnulInvoice.description: Result of the pre-cancellation validator of an invoice: whether it can be cancelled, the blocking reasons (when it cannot), whether the cancellation will create an additional VeriFactu record and whether its live payments are the only obstacle (`requires_collection_reversal`). `can_annul` is the verdict of `POST .../annul` WITHOUT `revert_collections`.

can_annul.description: Whether the invoice can be annulled in its current status.

reasons.description: Blocking reasons when `can_annul` is `false`. Empty `[]` when the invoice can be cancelled.
example: La factura está en estado Borrador y no puede ser anulada
examples: La factura está en estado Borrador y no puede ser anulada

will_create_verifactu.description: Indicates whether the cancellation will generate a cancellation record in VeriFactu.

info.description: Additional informational messages about the cancellation (non-blocking warnings). Empty `[]` when there are none.
example: La factura no tiene registro VeriFactu de alta. Se anulará sin registro VeriFactu.
examples: La factura no tiene registro VeriFactu de alta. Se anulará sin registro VeriFactu.

requires_collection_reversal.description: `true` when the live payments of the invoice are the ONLY obstacle to annulling it: `POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/annul` with `revert_collections: true` would succeed. `can_annul` stays `false` in that case, because it is the verdict without `revert_collections`. `false` when there are no live payments or when something else also blocks the annulment.

active_collections_amount.description: Amount, in euros, of the live payments of the invoice — what `revert_collections` would revert. `0` when there are none.

CanAnnulInvoice.title: CanAnnulInvoice

CatalogConfigurationImpact.description: What a proposed restriction of a product configurable catalog would invalidate, plus the token that confirms THAT exact change. `impact_token` is not a credential: it carries no secret and does not expire in time, it is the proof of "you were shown the impact over THIS catalog". On confirmation the backend recomputes the fingerprint with the product freshly loaded under lock; if the catalog or the set of prices to retire changed meanwhile, the fingerprints differ and the confirmation is refused asking for a new preview.

currently_legacy.description: True when the product declares no active combination and any cross of active variants and presentations is still sellable.

requires_confirmation.description: False when the change widens or does not touch what is sellable, and can be applied with no token.

impact_token.description: Fingerprint to send back as `impact_token` when applying the change. Null when `requires_confirmation` is false.

CatalogConfigurationImpact.title: CatalogConfigurationImpact

CensusVerification.description: Result of verifying the account's persisted company name + tax ID pair against the AEAT census (VNifV2). Use it to anticipate VeriFactu 4104 rejections before invoicing. Fail-open: returns `unavailable` when AEAT cannot be reached.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `census_verification` for this resource.

status.description: Census result. `identified`: name + tax ID match an active taxpayer. `not_identified`: the pair is not in the census. `not_identified_similar`: a similar individual exists (natural persons only). `identified_inactive` / `identified_revoked`: the taxpayer is deregistered or revoked. `unavailable`: AEAT could not answer (timeout, fault, no platform certificate) — verification is informational and never blocks.

verified_name.description: The company name that was checked against the census (the persisted account name). `null` when the account has never been verified.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last verification. `null` when never verified.

CensusVerification.title: CensusVerification

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the hash chain is intact.

first_invalid_record_id.description: UUID v7 of the first invalid record, or `null` if the chain is intact.

role.description: New account role: `admin` or `member`. Required when `external_advisor` is not sent.

external_advisor.description: Mark or unmark the member as the external advisor of the account (only a `member`, one per account). Required when `role` is not sent.

level.description: New access level of your account: `none`, `view` (read-only) or `operate`.

ChangeManagedAccountAccessLevelV1Request.title: ChangeManagedAccountAccessLevelV1Request

ChargeRule.description: A charge treatment rule of a connected Stripe account. Rules are evaluated in `position` order and the first one that matches decides whether the charge is invoiced or left out. The public `id` is the rule UUID v7.

id.description: UUID v7 of the rule. Public identity (KEY `id`).

position.description: Evaluation order within the account, starting at 1. Change it with `PUT /v1/companies/{company}/connected-accounts/{account}/charge-rules/order`.

condition.description: Condition a charge must meet for the rule to apply.

type.description: Kind of condition: the charge metadata `key` equals `value`, the charge description contains `value`, or the charge comes from the payment link `value`.

key.description: Metadata key. Only used (and required) with `metadata_equals`; `null` otherwise.

value.description: Value to compare against.

outcome.description: `invoice` issues the invoice (optionally with `concept` and `vat_rate`); `do_not_invoice` leaves the charge out and records it with `non_invoice_reason`.

non_invoice_reason.description: Reason recorded for charges left out. Only with `do_not_invoice`; `null` with `invoice`.

concept.description: Concept of the invoice line. Only with `invoice`; `null` otherwise.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent applied to the line. Only with `invoice`; `null` otherwise.

updated_at.description: When the rule was last updated (ISO 8601).

ChargeRule.title: ChargeRule

commercial_name.description: Optional trade name (DBA), distinct from the legal name.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. AEAT control-digit (checksum) validation is enforced when the request opts in via the `Factuarea-Version` header on or after the activation version; without that opt-in the legacy permissive behaviour is preserved.

billing_emails.description: Additional emails for invoice delivery (administration, accounting). Maximum 5.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates of the client. `null` when not recorded.

default_discount.description: Default discount applied to the client (percentage).

default_vat_rate.description: Default VAT rate applied to the client (percentage).

is_surcharge_subject.description: Whether the equivalence surcharge (*recargo de equivalencia*, the Spanish special VAT regime for retailers) applies to the client.

bank_accounts.description: Bank accounts associated with the client. Empty `[]` when there are none.

preferred_operation_regime.description: Preferred operation regime of the client for VAT / VeriFactu purposes.

accumulate_347.description: Whether this client accumulates towards the annual Modelo 347 report (operations with third parties above the legal threshold).

dir3_accounting_office.description: DIR3 code of the public-administration accounting office (Oficina Contable). FACe/Facturae directory code, not a foreign key. `null` for non-AAPP clients.

dir3_managing_body.description: DIR3 code of the public-administration managing body (Órgano Gestor). FACe/Facturae directory code, not a foreign key. `null` for non-AAPP clients.

dir3_processing_unit.description: DIR3 code of the public-administration processing unit (Unidad Tramitadora). FACe/Facturae directory code, not a foreign key. `null` for non-AAPP clients.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this client to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, distinct from the fiscal `tax_id`.

default_price_list_id.description: UUID v7 of the default price list assigned to the client.

default_price_list_name.description: Snapshot of the assigned default price-list name.

employee_id.description: Employee ID (UUID v7) clocking in or out.

source.description: Origin of the clock entry: `web` or `mobile`.

occurred_at.description: Clock entry timestamp in ISO 8601 (defaults to the server instant).

year.description: Year of the period to close (YYYY).

month.description: Month of the period to close (1-12).

Company.description: A company (tax ID) of your account, registered and operated through the `/v1/accounts/{account}/companies` endpoints. `readiness` (whether it can issue right now, with the same contract as `GET /v1/accounts/{account}/companies/{company}/issuing-readiness`) is present only when the list is requested with `include=readiness`; otherwise the key is absent.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID.

name.description: Commercial name of the tax ID.

business_name.description: Legal/registered business name (razón social), or `null` if not set.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF/CIF/NIE). Unique within your account.

status.description: Status of the tax ID in the account: `active` (operational), `inactive` (deactivated, data preserved, can be reactivated) or `archived` (no longer accepts operations).

status_since.description: When the tax ID entered its current `inactive` or `archived` status (ISO 8601). `null` for an `active` tax ID and for one whose change predates the lifecycle events: the date is never invented.

address.description: Street address of the fiscal domicile, or `null`.

city.description: City of the fiscal domicile, or `null`.

postal_code.description: Postal code of the fiscal domicile, or `null`.

province.description: Province of the fiscal domicile, or `null`.

country_aeat_zone.description: AEAT territorial zone of the company (`peninsula`, `canarias`, `ceuta`, `melilla`), or `null`.

country.description: Country of the fiscal domicile as recorded in the company profile (free text, up to 100 characters), or `null` when it was not set.

logo_url.description: Absolute URL of the company logo, or `null` if not set.

paid_until.description: Paid coverage of this company as an additional tax ID of the account (ISO 8601): reactivating it before this date is free. `null` when it was never charged or the coverage expired.

suspension_reason.description: Why the system suspended this `inactive` tax ID, or `null` when it is not suspended by the system (active, archived, or deactivated by the account itself). `payer_blocked`: the account paying for this managed account has its billing blocked; it resumes when the payer settles. `management_ended`: the management of this managed account ended before anyone took over the payment; it resumes when the holder of the account takes over the payment.

created_at.description: When the tax ID was registered in the account (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: When the tax ID was last updated (ISO 8601), or `null`.

Company.title: Company

id.description: UUID v7 of the certificate.

subject_nif.description: Tax ID (NIF) of the X.509 certificate holder.

subject_kind.description: Type of holder (individual / legal entity / representative).

is_active.description: Whether this is the active certificate used to sign transmissions.

revoked_at.description: Revocation date, or `null` if not revoked.

CompanyCreationStatus.description: Provisioning lifecycle status of a tax ID (company) of the account. Poll it after registering the tax ID to know when it becomes operational.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID.

payment_setup_url.description: URL to set up the payment method of the account titular; when it is saved the person returns to the Companies page of the app (`/companies`). Only present while `awaiting_payment` and for a production credential that reaches the titular company; `null` otherwise.

failed_reason.description: Human-readable reason the provisioning failed. Only present when `provisioning_status` is `failed`; `null` otherwise.

started_at.description: When provisioning started (ISO 8601), or `null` if not started yet.

completed_at.description: When provisioning completed (ISO 8601), or `null` if not completed yet.

CompanyCreationStatus.title: CompanyCreationStatus

CompanyList.description: Cursor-paginated list of the tax IDs of your account (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`).

data.description: Page of tax IDs.

has_more.description: `true` when more companies exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`.

CompanyRepresentation.description: The representation with which your company authorizes Factuarea to remit its VeriFactu records to AEAT on its behalf: social collaboration (annex I of the Resolution of 18-12-2024) or a power of attorney registered with AEAT. There is at most ONE active representation per company; a revoked one is kept in the history and never reactivated. The custodied document is never returned.

id.description: UUID v7 of the representation.

kind.description: `social_collaboration_annex_i`: the signed annex I (social collaboration). `aeat_power_of_attorney`: a power of attorney registered with AEAT.

signer_name.description: Name of the person who signed the authorization.

granted_on.description: Date on which the authorization was granted.

has_document.description: Whether the signed document (annex I or power-of-attorney proof) is custodied. The document itself never leaves the system.

power_of_attorney_reference.description: Reference of the power of attorney in the AEAT register, or `null`.

valid_until.description: Last day of validity (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Madrid), or `null` when the representation does not expire.

is_expired.description: `true` once the last day of validity has passed. An expired representation does NOT enable third-party remission any more, so register a new one before it expires (you are warned 30 and 7 days ahead and when it expires).

is_active.description: `true` while the representation has not been revoked, that is, it is the CURRENT one — even when it has expired. It only enables third-party remission when `is_active` is `true` AND `is_expired` is `false`.

revoked_at.description: Instant of the revocation, or `null` while it is active.

revocation_reason.description: Reason recorded on revocation, or `null` while it is active.

CompanyRepresentation.title: CompanyRepresentation

amount.description: Taxable base of the proration (without VAT), in euros as a 2-decimal string.

ConnectStoreV1Request.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/companies/{company}/stores.

Connect an e-commerce store to your company. Required: `integration_id` (the
provider connection that backs the store), `provider`, `external_store_id`
(the identifier the provider gives to the shop) and `name`. The eight
settings are optional and each one falls back to its declared default, so a
store connected without any of them is created with automatic invoicing OFF
and in the `test` environment. `simplified_threshold` is expressed in EUROS
and capped at the legal maximum for a simplified invoice. `series_id` is a
series of type invoice; omit it to follow the default series of your company,
which is never frozen into the store. A company may connect several stores of
the same provider, but not the same remote shop twice.

integration_id.description: Identifier (UUID v7) of the provider connection that backs the store.

provider.description: E-commerce provider of the store: `woocommerce`, `shopify` or `prestashop`.

external_store_id.description: Identifier the provider gives to the shop; unique per provider within your company.

name.description: Display name of the store, editable at any time.

series_id.description: Series (UUID v7, type invoice) the store numbers into; omit to follow the default series of your company.

simplified_threshold.description: Order total, in euros, up to which the store issues a simplified invoice. Maximum 3000.00.

require_tax_id.description: Whether the buyer tax ID is required for the order to be invoiced.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices of the store already include taxes.

autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether paid orders are invoiced automatically. Off unless you turn it on.

autosend_enabled.description: Whether the invoice is emailed to the buyer automatically. Off unless you turn it on.

remote_base_url.description: Base address of the remote shop, checked against the outbound policy of your company.

environment.description: Environment the store reports as: `live` invoices for real, `test` discards with a typed reason.

authorize_remote_host.description: Authorize the host of `remote_base_url` as an outbound destination in the same call.

ConnectedAccount.description: A connected Stripe account (Stripe Connect, multi-store) for your company. The public `id` is the account UUID v7. `external_account_id` (`acct_xxx`) is the external Stripe id, not a foreign key. `series_id` is the UUID v7 of the auto-invoicing document series (`null` means the company default series). The configuration fields are the effective per-account auto-invoicing settings.

id.description: UUID v7 of the connected account. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `connected_account` for this resource.

name.description: Editable display name of the connected account.

external_account_id.description: External Stripe connected account id (`acct_xxx`). NOT an internal UUID nor a foreign key.

series_id.description: UUID v7 of the document series used for invoices auto-created from this account. `null` means the company default series is used.

simplified_threshold_cents.description: Simplified invoice (F2) threshold in cents for this account, range `[0, 300000]` (0–3,000 €). Defaults to 40000 (400 €).

require_nif.description: Whether a Spanish tax ID (NIF) is required for auto-invoicing on this account. Defaults to `false`.

refunds_enabled.description: Whether a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`) on this account automatically generates a linked corrective invoice. Defaults to `true`.

subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether Stripe subscription cycles on this account are auto-invoiced. Defaults to `false`.

default_line_concept.description: Default concept of the single line created for charges whose lines cannot be recovered, or `null` if not configured. Editable with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/connected-accounts/{account}`.

invoice_note.example: Pago recibido. Gracias por su compra.
invoice_note.description: Optional note written in the notes of the invoices auto-created from this account, or `null` when none is configured (the default: invoices carry no note). When a charge needed a currency conversion to EUR, the conversion trace is appended to the note. Editable with `PUT`; `null` or an empty string clears it.

connection_method.description: How the account was linked to Stripe: `account_links` (Stripe Connect onboarding), `stripe_app` (Stripe App) or `platform` (the own Stripe account of the company that issues the Factuarea invoices; it has no stored credential and does not accept `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled`).
