Required: `url` (HTTPS, up to 2048 characters) and `enabled_events` (at least one type: the company events of the public catalog and the `account.*` events of `AccountEventType`; an unknown, reserved or not released type returns 422 and nothing is created). The environment is never a field: the endpoint is born in the environment of the credential and never changes it.

Requested `scopes` must belong to the closed v1 catalog and stay within the holder plan; a scope above the plan returns 422. The optional `scoped_company_ids` is the list of companies of your account (company IDs, UUID v7) the key will be able to operate on; when omitted the key reaches the same companies as the credential that creates it, and it can never reach more. It is rejected with `environment: test`: a test key only reaches the sandbox company. Every requested scope must fit the plan of EVERY company in that list, so mixing companies on different plans returns 422. To change the scope of a key you already issued, use the dedicated scope operation.

The new company joins your account and is adopted into the scope of the calling key, so you can operate on it right away. A tax ID already registered in another account is rejected: the account that holds it has to hand it over to yours with a tax ID transfer instead.

CreateCorrectiveInvoiceRequest.description: Generate a corrective (rectificativa) invoice for a previously issued invoice. `correction_reason` (required) maps to a VeriFactu R-code; `correction_type` is `full` or `partial`; the optional `correction_nature` is `I` (by differences: void the whole invoice with `full` and no `lines`, or correct amounts with `partial` and the adjustment `lines`) or `S` (substitution: `full` with the final `lines`, no negative quantity) — omitted, `full` with `lines` is `S` and the rest `I`; `unit_price` is never negative (a negative `quantity` subtracts); the optional `correction_code` (`R1`..`R5`) forces the explicit R-code and is validated against the AEAT legal matrix for the original invoice type. Optional `justification`, `notes`, and `lines[]` (none to void the whole invoice; required for a partial correction and for a substitution). Each line may also declare the fiscal nature of the line it corrects — `unit`, `regime_key`, `exemption_reason` and `exemption_reason_text` — with the same rules as `POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices`: a key you OMIT inherits the value of the original line at the same index, a key you SEND (even `null`) replaces it, and `null` means explicitly none. Commercial line inheritance is identity-based: lines.N.source_line_id may identify an active UUID v7 line of the original invoice once. Omitted commercial values inherit only from that identified source; there is no positional fallback for commercial data. New destination line ids are generated and caller-supplied destination ids are rejected. Header commercial data is copied from the source; do not send header commercial fields or read-only snapshot/source/version fields. payment_terms defaults to [] for the new corrective. A negative payable accepts only explicit negative signed two-decimal rows whose exact sum balances. New row ids may be omitted and are returned UUID v7; supplied null/empty ids are invalid. Account 02/04 must be present before this corrective is issued; no automatic schedule or collection is created. The corrective falls due on its last instalment, or 30 days after issue without a schedule.

line_type.description: Kind of line: `NORMAL` (default) for an ordinary line, or `SUPLIDO` for a DISBURSEMENT — an amount paid in the name and on behalf of the client (an official fee, duty or registry charge) re-invoiced at cost, which stays out of the taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA) and is aggregated into `total_disbursements`. A `SUPLIDO` line must carry no VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount or product, and requires `source_invoice_reference`. Only meaningful when `lines[]` is sent (a partial correction or a substitution); a value outside the catalog is rejected with 422.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the corrected line (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), up to 20 characters. Presentation only. OMIT it and the line inherits the unit of the original line at the same index; SEND it (even `null`) and it replaces it, `null` meaning no unit.

regime_key.description: VeriFactu special-regime key of the corrected line (the closed AEAT catalog, e.g. `01` general regime, `14` or `15` for operations whose VAT accrues later than the issue date). OMIT it and the line inherits the key of the original line at the same index; SEND it (even `null`) and it replaces it, `null` meaning no special regime.

exemption_reason.description: Cause of VAT exemption of the corrected line (the closed catalog of `POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices`). OMIT it and the line inherits the exemption of the original line at the same index; SEND it and it replaces it; send `null` for explicitly none — for example, `exemption_reason: null` turns an exempt original line into a taxed one.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of the corrected line (up to 255 characters), printed under the line description (art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012). OMIT it and the line inherits the text of the original line at the same index; SEND it (even `null`) and it replaces it, `null` meaning no text.

anyOf.description: Ordered delivery-note references; duplicates are preserved. A supplied list replaces the previous list.

sequence_number.description: Optional sequence. JSON integers only: 0 is valid; booleans, floats and numeric strings are rejected.

source_line_id.description: Optional UUID v7 of a line of the corrected invoice. Copies omitted commercial values from that source, never from its position. Each source may occur once; destination id is generated.

expected_selection_version.description: Not accepted by this operation: rejected with 422 when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company, ignored otherwise.

pdf_template_id.description: Optional nullable tenant-template UUID for the corrective invoice. Omit it to inherit the default; a UUID requests a compatible manual selection. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

correction_nature.description: Nature of the correction (art. 15.5 Royal Decree 1619/2012; VeriFactu `TipoRectificativa`). Optional: OMIT it and `full` with `lines` is a substitution (`S`), while `full` without `lines` and `partial` are by differences (`I`). `I`, by differences: the corrective carries the amount of the rectification, whatever its sign — void the whole invoice with `correction_type: full` and no `lines`, or correct some amounts with `partial` and the adjustment `lines` (`full` with `lines` and an explicit `I` is rejected). `S`, substitution: `correction_type: full` with the FINAL `lines` of the correct invoice (no negative quantity); registered with `ImporteRectificacion` (base and tax of the original). An incoherent combination is rejected with 422 before anything is created.

vehicle_plate.description: Licence plate of the vehicle used for the delivery (up to 20 characters).

pdf_template_id.description: Optional tenant-template UUID. On a new document, omission or null inherits the current default; a UUID requests a compatible manual selection. If POST resolves to an existing external_id, omission preserves intent and null clears it. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

expected_selection_version.description: Optional positive selection version. When POST upserts an existing external_id, it is the selection CAS and must be sent together with pdf_template_id. A new document initializes its selection version. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Send a JSON number or a decimal string with up to 4 decimals (`"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): the string is the exact form the response returns, so a line read from the API can be sent back unchanged. Derived amounts are computed from it and keep 2 decimals.

tax_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the VAT-class tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `tax_rate`, the rate (and the indirect-tax regime, the AEAT qualification and, for an exempt or not-subject tax, the exemption cause) comes from that tax. A tax that is not a VAT-class tax, or a `tax_rate` that differs from the rate of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line). Send only the id, or a `tax_rate` equal to the tax's own rate.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate of the line (0–100). Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) the line takes, in this order, the tax it references or the tax assigned to its product, and otherwise the DEFAULT TAX of your company for this kind of document (tax settings), inherited as a whole: its rate, its indirect-tax regime (IVA, IGIC or IPSI) and its AEAT qualification; an exempt or not-subject default also declares its cause (`exemption_reason`) on the line unless the line sends its own. The line ends up exactly as if you had chosen that tax. A `0` you send is honoured as a real 0 % rate, never confused with «not stated».

retention_rate.description: Withholding (IRPF) percentage of the line, 0–100 (the magnitude: a catalog withholding stored with a negative sign is declared here without it). CreateInvoiceRequest.description: Create an invoice. Required: `series_id`, `issued_on`, `due_on`, `lines[]` (at least one) and `client_id` — except on a simplified invoice (`type: F2`), where the client is optional. A terminal can issue an already-paid simplified invoice in ONE idempotent call (unattended checkout): send `type: F2`, `prices_include_tax`, a `payment` block and `options.register_verifactu`, and identify the operation with `external_id`. Optional: `notes`, `metadata`, `tags`, `custom_fields`, and an `options` object to atomically create, issue, send and wait for the PDF in a single call. Without `options` the invoice is created as a draft. A line may also be a DISBURSEMENT (`line_type: "SUPLIDO"`): an amount paid in the name and on behalf of the client (an official fee, duty or registry charge) that is re-invoiced at cost and, under art. 78.Tres.3 of the Spanish VAT Act (LIVA), stays out of the taxable base — it carries no VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount or product, requires `source_invoice_reference`, and is not allowed on a simplified (`F2`) invoice. Worked example: a 1,000.00 service line at 21% plus a 150.00 `SUPLIDO` line returns `subtotal` 1000.00, `taxes_total` 210.00, `total` 1210.00, `total_disbursements` 150.00 and `total_to_pay` 1360.00. Optional commercial data: business_references has only receiver_contract_reference, receiver_transaction_reference and file_reference (20 Unicode characters each); invoicing_period requires start_date <= end_date; legal_literals is an ordered list (250 characters per item). Lines support five reference/date pairs, delivery_notes_references (number up to 30 characters, optional date) and a JSON-integer sequence_number from 0 to 2147483647. Administrative centres accept one DIR3 code per role 01..04; omission or null inherits a frozen contact snapshot, [] selects none. All public line ids are generated; caller-supplied ids and read-only source/snapshot/version fields are rejected. payment_terms accepts null/[]/an ordered instalment list; new row id may be omitted, but present id must be non-null UUID v7. due_date is real YYYY-MM-DD, amount is a nonzero signed two-decimal EUR string, payment_means is 01-19, and optional account contains IBAN and nullable BIC8/11 only for 02/04. Exact sum equals total_to_pay including disbursements. Omission/null means unknown, [] explicitly no schedule. Draft can save missing 02/04 accounts; immediate issue cannot. With a nonempty schedule the invoice falls due on its last instalment: `due_on` must be that date to issue it (422 `invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment` otherwise), while a draft keeps the date you send. New creation needs no CAS; existing external_id upsert requires expected_payment_terms_version when modifying a calendar.

line_type.description: Kind of line: `NORMAL` (default) for an ordinary line of your own operation, or `SUPLIDO` for a DISBURSEMENT — an amount you paid in the name and on behalf of the client (an official fee, duty or registry charge) and now re-invoice at cost. A disbursement is not part of your taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA): it stays out of `subtotal`/`taxes_total`/`total`, is aggregated into `total_disbursements`, and is never declared in the AEAT VeriFactu record. A `SUPLIDO` line must carry no VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount, regime key, exemption cause or product, and is rejected on a simplified (`F2`) invoice.

source_invoice_reference.description: Reference of the supporting document that originated the disbursement — the receipt or fee number issued by the public body (up to 100 characters). REQUIRED when `line_type` is `SUPLIDO`; leave it out on a normal line. Free text on purpose: the receipt of a public body is rarely a supplier invoice.

source_invoice_ids.description: Optional traceability of a disbursement: list of IDs (UUID v7) of your own expenses that back it. An expense of another company is rejected with 422. Omit it (or send `null`) when there is nothing to link.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the document (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), up to 20 characters. Presentation only: free text, no closed catalog and no fiscal effect.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of this line (up to 255 characters), printed under the line description to satisfy the mention required by art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012 when the catalogued cause does not cover it. Orthogonal to `exemption_reason` and to the document-level exemption cause; no coherence is enforced between them.

line_total.description: Optional CHECKSUM of the line total. When sent, it is compared against the total this API computes and the request is rejected with 422 (`line_total_checksum_mismatch`, with the expected and received values in `error.details`) when they differ by more than one cent. Never stored and never returned: the invoiced amount is always the computed one, so this field only reports a rounding mismatch with your own ERP. Omit it and no checksum runs.

anyOf.description: Ordered delivery-note references; duplicates are preserved. A supplied list replaces the previous list.

sequence_number.description: Optional sequence. JSON integers only: 0 is valid; booleans, floats and numeric strings are rejected.

expected_payment_terms_version.description: Body CAS for editing an existing calendar, including null/[] and a no-op. Also required if total_to_pay changes with a nonempty current schedule. Missing returns 428, stale returns 409 with current_version only after parent authorization. 0 means no row. New creation needs no version; POST external_id upsert follows the update rules. Idempotent replay precedes CAS. Neither If-Match nor expected_version/administrative_version substitutes this field.

type.description: Invoice type: `F1` (complete invoice, the default) or `F2` (simplified invoice, the ticket of a terminal). A simplified invoice needs simplified invoices enabled for the company (422 `simplified_invoices_disabled`) and cannot exceed the absolute cap of 3,000 € VAT included (422 `simplified_invoice_not_allowed`).

client_id.description: Id of the client (UUID v7). Required with `type: F1` (or without `type`), and the client must have a complete tax ID. Optional with `type: F2`: without it the invoice is an anonymous ticket; with it, a qualified simplified invoice (the client must belong to your company).

prices_include_tax.description: When `true`, the `unit_price` of every line is the FINAL price with taxes (VAT included) and the system computes the net base to the cent, so the invoice total equals the sum of the amounts you sent. If no distribution of the cents reaches that total the request is rejected with 422 `amount_reconciliation_failed` and nothing is issued. Catalog lines (`product_id`) are not accepted in this mode. Defaults to `false`.

operation_on.description: Date the operation took place (YYYY-MM-DD) when it differs from the issue date (arts. 6.1.f and 7.1.c of Royal Decree 1619/2012). It cannot be later than `issued_on` (422 `operation_date_after_issue_date`) unless the first line that declares a `regime_key` uses 14 or 15. It is printed on the PDF and reported in the VeriFactu record.

method.description: Payment method, from the catalog of `GET /v1/payment-methods`. Required when `payment` is sent.

paid_at.description: Date of the payment (ISO 8601); only its date is used. Defaults to the issue date.

reference.description: Reference of the payment, for example the transaction id of the card terminal (up to 100 characters).

payment.description: Payment recorded in the same call: after issuing, a payment is registered for the whole amount due and the invoice ends up paid. It implies issuing. Its presence makes the request an unattended checkout.

pdf_template_id.description: Optional tenant-template UUID. On a new invoice, omission or null inherits the current default; a UUID requests a compatible manual selection. If POST resolves to an existing external_id, omission preserves intent and null clears it. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

expected_selection_version.description: Positive selection version. It applies only when POST resolves to an existing external_id, where it is the selection CAS for pdf_template_id; a new invoice rejects it with 422. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

due_on.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD). It drives the overdue status, payment reminders and debt ageing. With a nonempty `payment_terms` schedule the invoice falls due on its last instalment, so send that date: a draft keeps a different one, but issuing it (in this call through `options`, or later) returns 422 `invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment` and nothing is issued.

issue_directly.description: When `true`, the invoice is issued right after it is created (definitive number, frozen document) instead of staying as a draft.

send_automatically.description: When `true`, the invoice is emailed once issued; it implies issuing. The recipient is `options.send_to` or, when you omit it, the email of the client. If there is no possible recipient (no client, or a client with no email, and no `send_to`) the request is rejected with 422 `missing_required_param` and `param` = `options.send_to` BEFORE anything is created: no draft is left behind and no number is consumed. Repeating the request of an `external_id` that is already issued does not email it again while that email is queued or delivered.

send_to.description: Recipient email for `options.send_automatically`. Optional when the client has an email; required (422 `missing_required_param`) when you ask for the sending with no client or with a client that has no email. An empty value is rejected as well.

wait_for_pdf.description: When `true`, the response waits up to about 15 seconds for the A4 PDF to be materialized (`pdf.status: ready`); if it is not ready by then `pdf.status` is `pending`. It implies issuing.

register_verifactu.description: When `true`, the VeriFactu alta is generated synchronously, BEFORE responding, and the response carries its huella and QR in the `verifactu` block. It implies issuing. If the alta cannot be generated the invoice stays issued and the block reports `status: failed` with its `error_code`. Its transmission to AEAT follows its course in batches.

CreateNifTransferV1Request.description: Body of the tax ID transfer issuance. `company_id` is the opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID of your account that this transfer gives away; it must be within your credential scope and cannot be the owner company of the account. `recipient_account_id` is OPTIONAL and names the only account that will be able to accept the transfer. `expires_at` is OPTIONAL and is a REQUEST, not a command: pass an ISO 8601 instant in the future and within the product ceiling, or omit it and the product default applies. Nothing else is accepted — the issuing account and the acting person come from the authenticated credential, never from the body, because issuing a transfer is giving away control of a tax ID and the giver is always the account that holds it.

company_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the company of your account that this transfer gives away. It cannot be the owner company of the account.

expires_at.description: REQUESTED expiry of the tax ID transfer (ISO 8601). Optional: without it the default period (24 hours) applies, and the product enforces the ceiling (7 days).

recipient_account_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the ONLY account that will be able to accept this transfer. Optional: without it, whoever holds the secret can accept it.

CreatePdfTemplatePreviewRequest.description: Requires the existing `pdfs:read` and additional `pdf_templates:read` scopes. Send exactly one of `example`, `unsaved_form`, `persisted_draft`, `presentation_revision` or `invoice_substitution`, with required purpose, format and locale. A `persisted_draft` source accepts a draft document or a quote, pro-forma or delivery note that has left draft and has no retained presentation yet; with a retained presentation (or an issued invoice) it returns 403. `invoice_substitution` is only valid for `invoice` / `complete` / `a4` and must omit the visual triple. Example and unsaved form require the complete `base_preset`, `layout_version` and `configuration`; owner-bound sources accept that complete triple or omit all three. Partial or explicit-null triples return 422 with field paths. Omission resolves the exact effective root from the authoritative owner on the server, preserves null defaults and retained pins, and performs no import or live fill. A supplied full root must match that root exactly. The commercial identity selector exists only on `example`: omit it or send null/`inherit` for inheritance; `exact_revision` requires both retained identity and revision UUIDs; `draft` requires a library administrator and all six nullable keys (`commercial_name`, `logo_asset_id`, `brand_image_asset_id`, `brand_mode`, `contact_email`, `contact_phone`); `logo_dark_asset_id`, `brand_image_dark_asset_id`, `dark_background_fallback` (default `silhouette`) and `brand_size` (default `medium`) are optional. Draft assets must already be retained; preview neither reads live brand data nor saves, publishes, or asserts continuity. A revision source binds an authentic owner document and exact retained parent, nullable target template (null inherits), captured/current_legal policy and positive `expected_version` CAS. Its returned `source_token` and revision precondition authorize only a later explicit Revise action; they never authorize issue, send, accept or sign. Semantic normalization precedes admission and equivalent previews may resolve to one retained artifact; HTTP idempotency still compares the raw body, so changing the body with the same key returns 409. Missing canonical tenant initialization or disabled revisioned presentation returns a recoverable 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` (`invalid_request_error`) with no artifact, intent or reservation: preserve form data and complete authorized initialization. GET and preview never import or initialize; an owner CLI may be an optional initialization entry point, never a required client step. Exact retained prepared/READY reads do not require fresh initialization.

packaging included: up to four decimal places, greater than zero.

CreateProductRequest.description: Create a product in your catalog. Required: `name` and `price`. Optional: `sku` (unique per company), `description`, `tags`, `stock` (initial quantity), `low_stock_threshold`, `manage_stock`, `currency` (`EUR` only — any other code returns 422), `tax_rate_id`, `is_active`, `metadata` and `external_id`. Stock changes after creation are made through `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/stock`, not through this endpoint.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit (your own product code), unique per company. Optional; up to 100 characters.

stock.description: Initial stock. Absent → defaults to 0. Later you can set it absolutely with `stock` on `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}`, or move it with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/stock` (`set`/`increase`/`decrease`).

manage_stock.description: Whether this product takes part in document-driven stock movements: with `true`, issuing or receiving a document that includes it moves its stock automatically and the movement is recorded in the stock ledger. It only takes effect if your company also has stock management enabled; absent or `null` means `false`.

currency.description: Product amounts are read-only EUR: only `EUR` (or absence/null) is accepted.

external_id.description: Third-party integration key from your ERP/CRM (orthogonal to `sku`). Free-form, up to 100 characters.

id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the option group. A new group sent with another UUID version is rejected with 422.
Public identifier (UUID v7) of the option value. A new value sent with another UUID version is rejected with 422.
Public identifier (UUID v7) of the configuration. A new configuration sent with another UUID version is rejected with 422.

external_id.description: External business key (integration key from your ERP/CRM), unique per company. Orthogonal to `external_invoice_number` (the supplier fiscal number): `external_id` is the resource ID in the integrator system.

custom_fields.description: Typed custom fields as `[{field, value}]`. `field` up to 60 characters (non-empty), `value` up to 500 characters, up to 50 entries.

operation_class.description: Classifies the origin of the expense for the input VAT of Modelo 303 (boxes [28]-[39]). Closed set; nullable → defaults to `corriente`.

exclude_347.description: Whether to exclude this expense from the annual Modelo 347 declaration.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Send a JSON number or a decimal string with up to 4 decimals (`"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): the string is the exact form the response returns, so a line read from the API can be sent back unchanged. Derived amounts are computed from it and keep 2 decimals.

tax_rate.description: Per-line VAT rate (0–100). REQUIRED. There is no silent default: a purchase with no VAT is declared explicitly as `tax_rate: 0`, so that "not stated" and "stated as zero" never collapse into the same document.

retention_rate.description: Per-line IRPF retention and deductible VAT. `retention_rate` is the percentage withheld from the supplier (0–100); `vat_deductible` flags VAT deductibility — it does not change the amount paid, but a `false` line is excluded from the deductible input VAT of Modelo 303 (boxes [28]-[37]).

surcharge_rate.description: Per-line equivalence surcharge (the legal VAT↔surcharge pair is validated) and LIVA exemption reason (closed catalog).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Per-line indirect tax regime of the supplier. Passthrough only (purchase lines have no `tax_id`): the incoming override is the sole regime channel; the real invariant lives in the domain.

pdf_template_id.description: Optional tenant-template UUID. On a new document, omission or null inherits the current default; a UUID requests a compatible manual selection. If POST resolves to an existing external_id, omission preserves intent and null clears it. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

expected_selection_version.description: Optional positive selection version. When POST upserts an existing external_id, it is the selection CAS and must be sent together with pdf_template_id. A new document initializes its selection version. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Send a JSON number or a decimal string with up to 4 decimals (`"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): the string is the exact form the response returns, so a line read from the API can be sent back unchanged. Derived amounts are computed from it and keep 2 decimals.

tax_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the VAT-class tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `tax_rate`, the rate (and the indirect-tax regime, the AEAT qualification and, for an exempt or not-subject tax, the exemption cause) comes from that tax. A tax that is not a VAT-class tax, or a `tax_rate` that differs from the rate of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line). Send only the id, or a `tax_rate` equal to the tax's own rate.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate of the line (0–100). Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) the line takes, in this order, the tax it references or the tax assigned to its product, and otherwise the DEFAULT TAX of your company for this kind of document (tax settings), inherited as a whole: its rate, its indirect-tax regime (IVA, IGIC or IPSI) and its AEAT qualification; an exempt or not-subject default also declares its cause (`exemption_reason`) on the line unless the line sends its own. The line ends up exactly as if you had chosen that tax. If none of them exists the request is rejected with 422 `missing_required_param`, with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line): the API never guesses a rate. A `0` you send is honoured as a real 0 % rate, never confused with «not stated».

retention_rate.description: Withholding (IRPF) percentage of the line, 0–100 (the magnitude: a catalog withholding stored with a negative sign is declared here without it). Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) and the line carries `retention_rate_id`, it is taken from that tax. If you send both and the percentage differs from the one of the chosen tax, the request is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.retention_rate` and `error.line_index` = N.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence-surcharge percentage of the line, 0–100. Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) and the line carries `surcharge_rate_id`, it is taken from that tax. retention_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the withholding (IRPF) tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. CreateRecurringFromInvoiceRequest.description: Create a recurring invoice from an existing invoice, reusing its lines, client and series. The body supplies only the recurrence configuration: `frequency` and `start_on` are required; `end_on`, `name`, `description`, `notes`, `metadata`, `holiday_handling`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences`, `generation_mode` (`draft`, `issue` or `issue_and_send`) and an `auto_delivery` object are optional.

presentation_policy.description: Create omitted/null means latest inherited. Update omitted preserves; null resets inheritance; a complete object replaces the policy. {} and partial objects are invalid. This field only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

payment_terms_template.description: Relative payment calendar of the recurrence; the schema explains the null, [] and list semantics. This field only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

generation_mode.description: What each run of the recurrence does with the invoice it generates: `draft` leaves it as a draft; `issue` issues it (definitive number, VeriFactu record, stock movements) without emailing it; `issue_and_send` issues it and emails it to the `auto_delivery` recipients. Any other value is rejected with 422. Optional and nullable: when omitted (or `null`) the mode is derived from `send_automatically` (`true` → `issue_and_send`, `false` or absent → `draft`). When sent, it takes precedence and `send_automatically` becomes a derived field (`true` only with `issue_and_send`); sending a `send_automatically` (top-level or inside `auto_delivery`) that contradicts it is rejected with 422. Recipients are only required with `issue_and_send`: if an `auto_delivery` object is configured, `auto_delivery.recipients` must then contain at least one address (422 `auto_delivery_recipients_required` otherwise); `draft` and `issue` send no email and need none. Available in every API version.

send_automatically.description: Compatibility flag derived from `generation_mode`. Without `generation_mode`, `true` selects `issue_and_send` and `false` selects `draft`. Together with `generation_mode` it must agree with it (`true` only with `issue_and_send`), otherwise the request is rejected with 422. Prefer sending `generation_mode`.

CreateSeriesRequest.description: Create a fiscal numbering series using code and document_type, with the existing name, initial_number, invoice_kind, counter_reset, year_reset and number_format options. Optional pdf_template_id is a tenant-template UUID or null; omitted or null creates an inherited preference at version 1, a compatible assignment at version 2. No visual precondition is needed on creation. Invoice purpose and supported paper formats must match; ticket-only invoice templates are valid. name.description: Field name (1-60 characters; duplicate names are allowed within a project).

type.description: Field type: `text`, `number`, `date`, `dropdown`, `boolean` or `multiselect`. Any other value returns 422 `invalid_custom_field_definition`.

required.description: Whether the field is required; a required field needs a non-empty default value.

default_value.description: Default value, applied to the existing tasks that have no value for the field: text, number, boolean, a `YYYY-MM-DD` date, an option or a list of options (`multiselect`).

options.description: Options of a `dropdown` (at least 1) or `multiselect` (at least 2, all different) field, up to 100.

name.description: Label name, unique within the company ignoring case (1-60 characters).

target_task_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the target task of the relation, from the same company.

type.description: Relation type: `subtask` (the target task is a subtask of the task in the path), `blocks` (the task in the path blocks the target task) or `related`.

target.description: Where the uploads received through the link are delivered: `comment` (default) or `description`.

note.description: Note for whoever uploads the files.

project_id.description: `id` of the project the task belongs to.

description.description: Description in Markdown.

column_id.description: `id` of the project column the task is created in. Mutually exclusive with `status`.

status.description: Virtual status the task is created in (`planned` or `archived`). Mutually exclusive with `column_id`.

assignee_id.description: `id` of the company member user the task is assigned to.

label_ids.description: `id` of the company task labels to attach to the task.

custom_fields.description: Values of the project's custom fields, as a map from the custom field public identifier (UUID v7) to its value: text, number, boolean, or a list of options for a `multiselect` field. `null` leaves the field empty.

entity_link.description: Links the task to a Factuarea document or contact in the same transaction. If the entity does not exist, belongs to another company or its module is not accessible, the call returns 404 `linked_entity_not_found` and the task is not created.

id.description: UUID of the entity.

customer_visible_label.description: Custom label for this tax shown to the customer on documents (e.g. "IVA 21% incluido"). Up to 200 characters.

valid_until.description: End date of the tax validity window (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Must be on or after `valid_from`.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: FK to the linked equivalence-surcharge tax. UUID v7 value referencing the Factuarea catalog plus your company's own taxes.

default_for_documents.description: Sets this tax as the default per document type. Object with optional booleans: `invoice`, `quote`, `delivery_note`, `proforma`, `purchase_invoice`, `recurring_invoice`.

CreateTransportDocumentRequest.description: Create a transport control document (DeCA) in `draft`. Only `company_role` (`shipper` or `carrier`) is required: a draft admits incomplete data and the minimum data is enforced when issuing. Your own party is filled with your company data; the other one comes from `contact_id` or from the fields you send. `delivery_note_ids` (1 to 50 of your delivery notes, without repetition) pre-fills one shipment per delivery note. Every reference is a UUID of your company (`*_id`); `shipments[].loading_place_id` is not accepted in the public API. A shipment that omits `origin` gets your default loading place or, without one, your registered address (role `shipper`) or the address of the shipper contact (role `carrier`); an explicit `origin: null` leaves the shipment without origin. `shipments[].id` is optional: an identifier already in use, in this or any other company, returns 422 on `shipments.N.id`. Every UUID is normalised to lower case before validating.

api_version.description: Payload version (date-based, `YYYY-MM-DD`) to pin for the events delivered to this endpoint. Supported values: `2026-05-22`, `2026-10-01` and `2026-10-05`. Omitted or `null`, the endpoint is pinned at creation to the payload version that matches the effective REST version of the request: `2026-10-05` (the latest) when that version is `2026-10-01` or later (`Factuarea-Version` header, or the version pinned on the API key), and `2026-05-22` otherwise, including requests without a version header. So nobody receives the new vocabulary without opting in. With `2026-10-01` amounts are JSON numbers and the payment keys are `paid_at`/`paid_on`; with `2026-10-05` amounts are decimal strings and the payment keys are `paid_recorded_at`/`paid_date`. With `2026-05-22`, invoices keep the previous vocabulary (`status: sent` for an issued invoice, `sent_at` equal to the issuance instant). A value that is not a `YYYY-MM-DD` date returns 422 (subcode `api_version_invalid_format`), and an unsupported one 422 (subcode `api_version_unsupported`).

name.description: Weekly schedule name.

mode.description: Schedule mode: `validated` (assumed fulfilled) or `real_clocking` (computed from real clock entries).

week_pattern.description: Weekly pattern: list of days with their time ranges.

day.description: Day of the week in ISO 8601 format (1 Monday .. 7 Sunday).

ranges.description: Time ranges for the day (empty = rest day).

end.description: Range end time (HH:MM; 24:00 is allowed as end of workday).

CustomField.description: A typed custom field as an ordered `{field, value}` pair. Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata.

value.description: Field value (≤ 500 chars).

CustomHeaders.description: Custom HTTP headers (string → string) added to every delivery request for a webhook endpoint. Max 20 entries, each value ≤ 1024 chars. Header names are normalized to Title-Case. Reserved names (`Host`, `Content-Type`, `Factuarea-Signature`, `X-Forwarded-*`, …) are rejected. Empty object when none are set. Never put secrets here — values are returned verbatim by the API.

result.description: Safe owner UUID/result receipt; no profile or financial evidence.

DailyPresence.description: An office/remote presence declaration for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: an employee’s declared work location for a single day (one row per company + employee + day). Read-only over the public API — the declaration itself is made from the Factuarea app.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the presence record, a UUID v7.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the declaration belongs to.

declared_at.description: Timestamp of the declaration (ISO 8601), or `null` when not retained.

DayBalance.description: The balance of a single day of the period for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: expected vs worked minutes, the resulting balance (worked − expected) and the day’s overtime minutes, plus the flags that explain why the expected minutes are zero (holiday, approved absence, rest day, no schedule in effect, outside the employment period). The live monthly sheet and the period balance always include `is_unscheduled` and `is_outside_employment`; the frozen daily detail of a monthly close report does not.

expected_minutes.description: Expected working minutes of the day derived from the schedule (0 on holidays, approved absences, rest days, days without a schedule in effect and days outside the employment period).

worked_minutes.description: Worked minutes of the day. Always the minutes actually clocked, also on days without a schedule in effect or outside the employment period, except under a `validated` schedule, where a scheduled day counts its expected minutes.

balance_minutes.description: Day balance in minutes (worked − expected); negative when the employee worked less than expected. 0 on days without a schedule in effect or outside the employment period (no reference to compare against).

overtime_minutes.description: Overtime minutes of the day (worked above the configured threshold, with the tolerance applied). 0 on days without a schedule in effect or outside the employment period: minutes clocked on those days never count as overtime.

is_holiday.description: Whether the day is a public holiday for the employee.

is_approved_absence.description: Whether the day is covered by an approved absence.

is_rest_day.description: Whether the day is a rest day (no shift in the schedule).

is_unscheduled.description: Whether the day falls within the employment period but no work schedule is in effect for it. Expected, balance and overtime minutes are 0; worked minutes are the minutes actually clocked. Never `true` together with `is_outside_employment`. Absent from the daily detail of a monthly close report.

is_outside_employment.description: Whether the day is before the employee’s `hire_date` or after their `termination_date`. Expected, balance and overtime minutes are 0 even if a schedule assignment covers the day; clock entries recorded before this rule existed still show as worked minutes. Absent from the daily detail of a monthly close report.

id.description: UUID v7 of the declaration.

system_id.description: Identifier of the invoicing software system (SIF).

system_name.description: Name of the invoicing software system (not its code: that is `system_id`).

components.description: Components of the system (art. 15.d of Order HAC/1177/2024). An empty string in declarations that predate the full art. 15 content.
components.example: Aplicación web de facturación y su API REST pública; servicio de remisión de registros a la AEAT.
examples: Aplicación web de facturación y su API REST pública; servicio de remisión de registros a la AEAT.

producer_tax_id.description: Tax ID (NIF) of the SIF producer.

producer_address.description: Postal address of the SIF producer (art. 15.j). An empty string in declarations that predate the full art. 15 content.

verifactu_only.description: Whether the system can ONLY operate as VERI*FACTU (art. 15.e, `TipoUsoPosibleSoloVerifactu`). It declares a possibility of the system, not the mode of a company.

multi_ot.description: Whether the system can serve several obliged taxpayers (art. 15.f, `TipoUsoPosibleMultiOT`). It declares a possibility of the system; the per-customer `IndicadorMultiplesOT` reported on each record is computed separately and is not part of art. 15.

signature_types.description: Signature types the system uses when it also works outside VERI*FACTU (art. 15.g). `null` when the system only works as VERI*FACTU and in declarations that predate the full art. 15 content.
signature_types.example: XAdES Enveloped Signature, clase EPES (ETSI EN 319 132), con la política de firma de la Administración General del Estado (OID 2.16.724.1.3.1.1.2.1.9), huella SHA-256 de las referencias y del certificado firmante, algoritmo de firma RSA-SHA256 y canonicalización XML 1.0, generada con la clave privada de un certificado electrónico en vigor.

signing_place.description: Place where the declaration is signed.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the declaration content for integrity verification (the full content is not exposed).

DeliveryNote.description: A delivery note tracking goods delivered to a customer. The delivery address fields, `transport_details` and `reference_number` are both accepted on write and returned here; `delivery_city`, `delivery_province` and `delivery_postal_code` are also filterable on `GET /v1/companies/{company}/delivery-notes`. Empty strings are normalized to `null`.

status.description: Delivery note lifecycle status exposed by the public API: `draft` (created, editable), `sent` (goods marked as delivered, no signature recorded yet), `signed` (delivered AND a recipient signature has been recorded), `invoiced` (converted into an invoice, terminal), `cancelled` (terminal). Note: the internal `delivered` state is surfaced as `sent` (without signature) or `signed` (with signature) — there is no `delivered` value in the public API. Recording a signature on a `sent` note moves it to `signed` (it does not introduce a brand-new lifecycle stage; the signature presence is the only difference).

price_list_id.description: UUID of the price list selected for this document.

price_list_name.description: Price-list name snapshot frozen on the document.

delivery_address.description: Street of the delivery address recorded on the delivery note. `null` when not set.

delivery_city.description: Town or city of the delivery address recorded on the delivery note. Filterable via `?delivery_city=` (also `[in]` and `[contains]`). `null` when not set.

delivery_postal_code.description: Postal code of the delivery address recorded on the delivery note. Filterable via `?delivery_postal_code=`; the first two digits identify the Spanish province. `null` when not set.

delivery_province.description: Province of the delivery address recorded on the delivery note. Filterable via `?delivery_province=` (also `[in]` and `[contains]`). `null` when not set.

delivery_country.description: Country of the delivery address recorded on the delivery note. Free text, not an ISO code. `null` when not set.

transport_details.description: Free-text transport details of the delivery. `null` when not set.

vehicle_plate.description: License plate of the delivery vehicle.

name.description: Driver name.

tax_id.description: Driver tax ID (NIF/CIF/NIE).

driver.description: Delivery driver data. `null` when no sub-field is provided.

tracking.description: Shipment tracking data. `null` when no sub-field is provided.

name.description: Name of the person who received the goods.

tax_id.description: Recipient tax ID (NIF/CIF/NIE).

received_by.description: Goods recipient data. `null` when no sub-field is provided.

billing_emails.description: Additional emails for delivery note dispatch (administration, accounting). Maximum 5. Empty `[]` when there are none.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on an expense the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Output VAT (IVA repercutido) accrued by the document: sum of the VAT of its lines. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 303 declares, and it is NOT recoverable from `taxes_total`, which nets the withholding out.

total_retention.description: Withholding (retención de IRPF) applied to the document: sum of the withholding of its lines, as a POSITIVE amount that SUBTRACTS from the total. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 130/111 declares. It is ALREADY netted out inside `taxes_total`, so do not subtract it again.

total_surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) of the document: sum of the surcharge of its lines. It ADDS to the total exactly like VAT does, and is ALREADY included inside `taxes_total`.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

total_gross_weight_kg.description: Total gross transport weight in kg (decimal string, scale 4): the sum of the lines that have a weight. `null` when no line has one. Partial when `lines_without_weight_count` is above 0.

lines_without_weight_count.description: Number of product lines without a known weight. Services and free-text lines never count.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

reference_number.description: Commercial reference of the delivery note — usually the client's purchase order number, which an ERP uses to reconcile its orders against deliveries. `null` when not set.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

converted_to_id.description: UUID v7 of the invoice this delivery note was converted into.

DeliveryNoteLine.description: A line item on a delivery note.

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.
additional_description.example: Auditoría inicial e informe de mejoras

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal STRING with the 4-decimal scale of its column (e.g. `"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): it is returned exactly as it was accepted and stored, so reading a line and sending it back never changes its price. Derived amounts (`subtotal`, `taxes`, `total`) keep 2 decimals.

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

counted_quantity.description: Pieces the customer asked for on a variable-weight line sold by count (decimal string, scale 4, greater than 0), e.g. `"4.0000"` for four pieces weighing `quantity` kg in total. Informational: the line is charged and the stock is discounted by `quantity` (the real weight), never by the pieces. `null` on any other line. Only accepted on a `variable_measure` presentation whose unit is a count unit.

counted_unit.description: UN/ECE code of the count unit of `counted_quantity` (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack…). `null` exactly when `counted_quantity` is `null`.

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the resolved price: `per_base_unit` (product/variant own price, converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (presentation, combination or price-list entry, never converted). `null` on a line with no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string. Informational when an exact price already absorbed them.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the resolved price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined — the assembler refuses such a line with 422 rather than risking charging the adjustments twice, so `null` only ever reaches a reader on a legacy line with no configurable options at all.

gross_weight_kg.description: Gross transport weight of the whole line in kg (decimal string, scale 4): quantity × the weight per commercial unit frozen when the line was created or edited in draft. `null` for services, free-text lines and products without a known weight. It does not change after delivery even if the catalog weight changes.

total_amount.description: Aggregate amount of the delivery notes (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

by_status.description: Breakdown by internal delivery note state. The key is the internal state (`draft`, `delivered`, `invoiced`, `cancelled`); the value is an object with `status`, `count` and `total` (accumulated amount in EUR). States with no delivery notes do not appear.

format.description: PDF format captured for this output, or `null` when unavailable.

unavailable_reason.description: Stable reason when output is unavailable, such as `privacy_erased`.

retry_after.description: Suggested retry delay in seconds, or `null` when no retry is scheduled.

EmailDelivery.description: One email your company sent through the platform (an invoice, a quote, a payment reminder…). Read-only and scoped to your own company. Internal implementation details — the mailable class, the queue job id, the user id and the raw metadata — are never exposed.

id.description: UUID v7 of the send. Use it in `GET /v1/companies/{company}/emails/{email}`.

recipient_email.description: Address the message was sent to.

cc.description: Addresses in copy. Empty array when there were none.

bcc.description: Addresses in blind copy. Empty array when there were none.

status.description: Status of the send. It describes the hand-off to the OUTGOING SMTP SERVER, NOT real delivery to the recipient's mailbox: `queued` (accepted, waiting for the worker), `sending` (being handed off), `sent` (the outgoing mail server accepted the message) and `failed` (every attempt failed). A `sent` message can still bounce or land in spam afterwards without the platform finding out. There are deliberately no `delivered`, `bounced` or `opened` values: observing them would require a mail provider with delivery webhooks, which is out of scope.

attempts.description: Number of hand-off attempts made for this message.

error_message.description: Error reported by the outgoing mail server on the last failed attempt, or `null` when there was none.

sent_at.description: When the outgoing mail server accepted the message (ISO 8601), or `null` if it never did. It marks the hand-off, not a confirmed delivery or a read.

failed_at.description: When the last attempt failed (ISO 8601), or `null` when none failed.

related_entity_type.description: Type of the document the email was sent for, or `null` for non-document emails (test messages, account emails).

related_entity_id.description: UUID v7 of the related document, or `null` for non-document emails and for older rows recorded before the sender stored it.

EmailDelivery.title: EmailDelivery

EmailDeliveryIndicator.description: Aggregated email summary for ONE related document. Only documents that have at least one email produce an entry.

related_entity_id.description: UUID v7 of the document, exactly as you sent it in `related_entity_ids`. Match the results back by this field, never by position.

related_entity_type.description: Document type RESOLVED for this id. It is always reported, even when you did not send `related_entity_type`, so a batch can mix types safely.

total.description: Number of emails registered for this document.

last_status.description: Status of the most recent email of this document. Status of the send. It describes the hand-off to the OUTGOING SMTP SERVER, NOT real delivery to the recipient's mailbox: `queued` (accepted, waiting for the worker), `sending` (being handed off), `sent` (the outgoing mail server accepted the message) and `failed` (every attempt failed). A `sent` message can still bounce or land in spam afterwards without the platform finding out. There are deliberately no `delivered`, `bounced` or `opened` values: observing them would require a mail provider with delivery webhooks, which is out of scope.

last_sent_at.description: Latest time something left for the outgoing mail server (ISO 8601), or `null` if nothing ever did. It is the MAXIMUM across the document's emails, so it can be non-null while `last_status` is `failed`: the last attempt failed, an earlier one went out.

attempts.description: Highest number of attempts among the emails of this document — the maximum, NOT their sum.

failed_count.description: How many emails of this document ended in `failed`.

EmailDeliveryIndicator.title: EmailDeliveryIndicator

EmailDeliveryIndicators.description: Email summary of a batch of documents (`{ data }`). It does NOT paginate: you asked for a bounded batch (up to 100 ids) and you get one entry per document that HAS emails. Documents without any email, and ids that do not belong to a document of your company, are OMITTED — never returned with zeros — so `data` can be shorter than the batch you sent, or empty.

data.description: One entry per requested document that has at least one email.

has_more.description: `true` when more emails exist beyond this page.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the employee, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF/NIE) of the employee, or `null` when unknown. Not a foreign key.

job_title.description: Role or position of the employee, or `null` when unset.

contract_hours.description: Weekly contracted hours (e.g. `40` for a full-time schedule).

hire_date.description: Calendar date the employee was hired, in `Y-m-d`.

termination_date.description: Calendar date the employee was deactivated, in `Y-m-d`; `null` while active.

ccaa.description: Spanish autonomous community (comunidad autónoma) the employee is assigned to, as its two-letter code.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `active` (in the workforce) or `inactive` (deactivated).

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/HR system) mapping this employee to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, distinct from the fiscal `tax_id`.

user_id.description: UUID v7 of the portal user linked to this employee, or `null` when no linkage exists yet.

A computed resource with no entity identity of its own: its `id` is the UUID v7 of the employee, never a presence record id.

id.description: UUID v7 of the employee this presence belongs to (the resource has no id of its own).

work_state.description: Derived workday state from the ledger: `working`, `paused`, `finished` (clocked out) or `away` (no open workday).

since.description: Start of the current open segment (ISO 8601), or `null` when there is no open workday.

first_clock_in_at.description: First clock-in of the day (ISO 8601), or `null` when the employee has not clocked in today.

is_late.description: true when the employee clocked in after their planned start time.

planned_start_at.description: Planned start time of the day (ISO 8601), or `null` on a rest day / when no schedule applies.

location.description: Declared work location for today: `office`, `remote`, or `null` when not declared.

location_declared.description: true when the employee has declared a work location today (distinguishes "office not declared" from "no data").

name.description: Human-readable name of the schedule.

week_pattern.description: Weekly pattern: one entry per configured weekday with its ordered, non-overlapping time ranges. A weekday absent from the list (or with an empty `ranges`) is a rest day.

ranges.description: Ordered, non-overlapping time ranges worked that day (empty = rest day).

weekly_hours.description: Total weekly hours derived from the pattern.

EmployeeSeatBillingStatus.description: Billing status of the per-employee add-on for your company (Control Horario). Whether the dedicated `employee-seats` subscription is active, how many seats are billed, how many employees are active and the recurring per-seat cost. Amounts are euro 2-decimal strings and are null when the cost is not resolvable (not subscribed, no active plan, enterprise outside Stripe, sandbox) — never a misleading 0. Employees never count towards the plan `users` seat limit. Read `subscribed` together with `seats_billable` to tell a legitimate no-charge state apart from a billing anomaly.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `employee_seat_billing_status` for this resource.

subscribed.description: true when the company has the per-employee add-on subscribed (`employee-seats` subscription active).

quantity.description: Number of BILLED seats: while subscribed it follows the number of active employees; 0 when not subscribed.

active_employees.description: Real number of `active` employees of the company. When not subscribed it reveals how many seats an opt-in would bill; when subscribed it matches `quantity`.

unit_amount.description: Taxable base of one seat per billing cycle, in euros as a 2-decimal string, or null when not resolvable.

tax_rate.description: Applied VAT rate (e.g. 21), or null when not resolved.

tax_amount.description: VAT amount of one seat, in euros as a 2-decimal string, or null.

total_per_seat.description: Base + VAT of one seat, in euros as a 2-decimal string, or null.

recurring_total.description: Projected recurring total (`total_per_seat` × `quantity`), in euros as a 2-decimal string. Null when VAT is not resolved.

billing_interval.description: The seat is always billed monthly, regardless of the plan interval; null when not subscribed.

next_invoice_at.description: End of the current covered period of the seat subscription (ISO 8601), or null.

requires_active_plan.description: true when the company has no active paid plan, so the seat cost cannot be resolved.

seats_billable.description: true when your company MUST be paying per seat (live paid plan), regardless of whether the `employee-seats` subscription exists — it is independent of `subscribed`. Combine both: `subscribed: true` means seats are being billed normally; `subscribed: false` with `seats_billable: true` and `active_employees > 0` is a BILLING ANOMALY (active employees with no seat billed) that your provider must settle; `seats_billable: false` is a legitimate no-charge state (enterprise by contract, trial or sandbox).

EmployeeSeatBillingStatus.title: EmployeeSeatBillingStatus

EmployeeSeatChargePreview.description: Preview of the prorated per-seat charge for activating or hiring employees, computed from the Stripe upcoming invoice without charging. The exclusive reason flags for a 0 amount, by precedence: `already_covered` > `requires_active_plan` > `included_in_trial`. At most one is true. `requires_payment_method` is NOT a 0-amount branch: it flags an obstacle on a REAL amount. Read `seats_billable` before promising a charge: when false the operation never bills (enterprise by contract, trial, sandbox or live mode off) even though the amount is computed. `amount`, `tax_amount` and `total` are euro 2-decimal strings; `recurring_base_cents` and `recurring_total_cents` stay in cents, as their names state.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `employee_seat_charge_preview` for this resource.

amount.description: Taxable base of the proration (without VAT), in euros as a 2-decimal string.

tax_amount.description: VAT amount of the proration, in euros as a 2-decimal string.

total.description: Total actually charged (`amount + tax_amount`), in euros as a 2-decimal string.

tax_rate.description: Applied VAT rate (e.g. 21), or null when Stripe Tax did not resolve it (then `tax_amount` is 0 and `total` = `amount`).

next_invoice_date.description: End of the current period of the seat subscription (ISO 8601), never today; null when not resolvable.

requires_payment_method.description: true when the company operates in live mode with no payment method on file. This does NOT zero the amount: the proration is still computed (previewing it needs no card), so you can show what the operation will cost before asking for the card. Configure the payment method to proceed.

requires_active_plan.description: true when the company has no active paid plan (amount is 0).

included_in_trial.description: true when the company is on trial, so the activation is free (amount is 0) until the trial converts to a paid plan.

already_covered.description: true when every employee to activate is still covered this period (free reactivation, amount is 0).

is_first_seat.description: true when the activation creates the FIRST seat subscription of the company (full-month charge that anchors the monthly billing day).

recurring_quantity.description: Projected total seat quantity (current + new) of the joint monthly cost after activation, or null on reason branches.

recurring_base_cents.description: Base (without VAT) of the projected joint monthly cost, in cents, or null.

recurring_total_cents.description: Projected joint monthly cost with VAT, in cents; null when VAT is not calculable.

seats_billable.description: true when the seat WILL actually be billed: the very same predicate the hiring/reactivation gate uses (live paid plan, company not in sandbox) and the same field `GET /v1/accounts/{account}/employee-seats` exposes. When false the operation never charges (enterprise by contract, trial, sandbox or live mode off) even though `amount` is computed — do not present it as a payment, and do not ask for confirmation of a charge that will not happen. Independent of the 0-amount branches: it can be true together with `already_covered` (the plan does bill seats, but THIS operation is free).

external_ref.description: Your own reference for this account, unique per provider. Provisioning it again returns this same account.

type.description: Machine-readable category of the error. Versioned by `Factuarea-Version`: from `2026-09-01` onwards the payment gate codes `payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed` are served as `payment_required_error`; requests pinned to an earlier version keep receiving `invalid_request_error` for those three. The additional tax ID codes (`additional_nif_plan_required`, `additional_nif_charge_failed`) and `addon_required` are newer and carry `payment_required_error` in every version. `error.code` and `error.subcode` never change — branch on `code` if you want version-independent behaviour.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. missing_api_key, insufficient_scope, parameter_invalid, invalid_status_transition. Full reference of every code, grouped by area: https://docs.factuarea.com/guides/errors/all.

subcode.description: Sub-code detailing the subtype within `code`. Present only on some errors, and only where `code` alone is ambiguous: on 409 duplication conflicts it pins the duplicate key (`code=resource_already_exists`, `subcode=tax_id_already_exists`), and on 402 payment errors it pins which gate rejected the call (`code=additional_nif_charge_failed`, `subcode=additional_nif_charge_failed`; `code=addon_required`, `subcode=webhooks_addon_required`). Like `code`, it is stable and invariant across locales and API versions.

message.example: No se ha proporcionado una API key válida en el header Authorization.
examples: No se ha proporcionado una API key válida en el header Authorization.

param.description: Field that caused the error (for parameter_invalid and similar invalid_request_error codes). On multi-field validation errors it points to the FIRST failed field; the full set lives in `errors[]`.

line_index.description: Zero-based position of the document line that raised the error, the same `N` as in a validation path `lines.N.field`. Present only when a domain rule rejects ONE specific line of the document (a product, variant, presentation, configuration or option that does not exist or is deactivated, a missing price or VAT rate, an exemption cause or regime key outside its catalog, a disbursement line carrying what it may not, a line total that does not match, …) and absent on every other error. It is additive: `param` keeps naming the field exactly as before, so a client can ignore `line_index`. Use it to highlight the offending line without parsing `message`.

errors.description: Present on 422 validation errors: ALL failed fields, one item per field (not only the first). Each item carries `param`/`code`/`message` plus the optional hints `expected_format`/`allowed_values`. Additive and backward-compatible — `error.param`/`error.message` still mirror the first failed field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for this field, derived from the failed validation rule (e.g. parameter_missing, parameter_invalid_format, parameter_invalid_enum).

message.description: Human-readable description of the field error. Localized (es/en/ca) when its `code` belongs to the stable catalog.

expected_format.description: Expected format hint, as emitted: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `UUID`, `email`, `URL`… Only present when the failure is a format error.

allowed_values.description: Legal values of the enum. Only present when the failure is an enum/`in` error.

details.description: Structured details about the error, present only on some errors and with a shape that depends on the case. On 409 duplication conflicts (subcodes `tax_id_already_exists`, `external_id_already_exists`, `sku_already_exists`) it carries `existing_resource_id`, the UUID of the resource that already exists. On 402 `payment_required_error` responses caused by a missing payment method it carries `payment_setup_url`, the Billing Portal link that unblocks the operation. On the 422 subcodes raised inside the domain it carries the hint of that case: `allowed_values` (rejected value outside a closed catalog), `offending_field` (field a disbursement line may not carry) or `expected` + `received` (line total checksum mismatch).

operation_id.description: Operation in the authenticated company that must be resolved before another employee-seat mutation.

row_errors.description: Employee-batch validation failures identified by the stable row_id; no employee was charged or created.

row_ids.description: Stable row_id of every employee-batch row whose external_id is already taken (repeated inside the batch or already in use in the company). Present on 409 `external_id_already_exists` of employee batches; correct those rows and send the batch again.

field_errors.description: Review fields that must be corrected before a purchase scan can be converted. Keys use public identifiers, for example supplier_id or lines.0.tax_rate.

existing_resource_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the resource that already exists, so you can fetch it with a `GET` and no extra `find_by_*` call. Only present on 409 duplication conflicts.

payment_setup_url.description: Billing Portal URL where the payment method can be set up. Only present on 402 errors caused by a missing payment method (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required`); once the payment method is on file, retrying the same call succeeds. Absent on the other 402 codes (declined charge, plan or add-on required).

allowed_values.description: Legal values of the closed catalog the rejected value does not belong to. Present on the 422 subcodes that validate against a catalog inside the domain (`line_type_invalid`, `correction_code_illegal_for_original`). Note that a 422 raised by request validation reports the same hint per field in `error.errors[].allowed_values` instead.

offending_field.description: Name of the line field that made the operation illegal. Present on 422 `suplido_line_cannot_carry_taxes`: a disbursement line (`line_type: "SUPLIDO"`) may not carry VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount, regime key, exemption cause or product, and this names the one that was sent.

expected.description: Amount this API computed for the line. Present on 422 `line_total_checksum_mismatch`, together with `received`, so the rounding mismatch with your own ERP can be located without guessing.

received.description: Amount sent in `lines[].line_total`, which differs from `expected` by more than one cent. Present on 422 `line_total_checksum_mismatch`.

active_rules.description: Current active automation rule count on automation_active_rules_limit_exceeded.

limit.description: Plan limit reached, including the active automation rule cap on automation_active_rules_limit_exceeded.

resource.description: Resource whose quota was reached on plan_limit_exceeded, for example documents_year or users.

current.description: Current usage of the resource on plan_limit_exceeded.

period_end.description: End of the quota period on plan_limit_exceeded; null for resources without a period, including platform users.

doc_url.description: Link to error reference in docs.

Event.description: A read-only record of something that happened in your account. The same object is delivered to your webhook endpoints.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the event, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`). Consistent with the `id` field of every other v1 resource.

type.description: Event type in `<category>.<action>` form (e.g. `invoice.paid`, `quote.approved`). See `GET /event-catalog` for the full list.

aggregate_id.description: UUID v7 of the resource that produced this event (e.g. the invoice for `invoice.paid`). `null` for events without backfill. Distinct from `id`, which identifies the event itself.

correlation_id.description: UUID v7 correlating this event end-to-end with the operation that produced it. `null` for events without a correlation context (e.g. born from scheduler sweeps). The key is always present.

api_version.description: API version (date-based) the event data was serialized under, sealed at emission (e.g. `2026-10-05`). An event re-emitted by an automation declares the payload version its data was frozen in, which can be older than the latest version. `null` only for legacy events emitted before versions were sealed.

livemode.description: `true` for events generated in production (live keys, `fact_live_`); `false` for events generated in test mode (sandbox company, test keys `fact_test_`).

test.description: `true` when the event is a test delivery triggered from the dashboard; `false` for real events. Orthogonal to `livemode`, which reflects the key environment (live vs sandbox): a test delivery may be issued in either, so e.g. `livemode: true, test: true` is valid.

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of when the event was created.

Event.title: Event

EventCatalogEntry.description: A single event type available for webhook subscriptions. The full catalog is returned by `GET /v1/event-catalog`.

name.description: Event identifier (e.g. `invoice.created`, `quote.approved`).

category.description: High-level group derived from the prefix (`invoice`, `quote`, `client`, …).

description.description: Human-readable description in Spanish.

status.description: `available` if the event is emitted today; `coming_soon` if reserved for a future release.

EventCatalogEntry.title: EventCatalogEntry

EventData.description: The payload embedded when the event was emitted, discriminated by `type`. Carries the full snapshot of the affected resource under `object` — identical to the `GET` of that resource at emission time (for an invoice, `GET /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}`) — plus event-specific keys, e.g. `{ "type": "invoice.paid", "object": { ...invoice... }, "amount": "1210.00" }`. The snapshot is frozen: later changes to the resource do not rewrite past events.
