ExportInvoicesExcelV1Request.description: Export invoices to a spreadsheet. `format` selects the content layout (`SUMMARY` one row per invoice, `ITEMS` one row per line) and `file_format` the file type (`xlsx` or `csv`). Narrow the selection with `date_from`/`date_to`, `client_id`, `series_id` or `invoice_ids`, or omit them to export everything.

invoice_ids.description: List of invoice IDs (UUID v7 values) to export. If omitted, exports the set matching the filters.

status.description: Invoice status to filter by (`draft`, `scheduled`, `issued`, `paid`, `cancelled`, `overdue`, `annulled`). `sent` is accepted as an alias of `issued` in every API version.

client_id.description: Client ID (UUID v7 value) to filter invoices by.

series_id.description: Series ID (UUID v7 value) to filter invoices by.

format.description: Content layout: SUMMARY (one row per invoice) or ITEMS (one row per line).

ExportInvoicesExcelV1Request.title: ExportInvoicesExcelV1Request

id.description: New attempts use UUIDv7; retained legacy identities are not rewritten.

invoice_id.description: UUID v7 of the submitted invoice.

status.description: FACe processing status. `prepared` and `transmission_uncertain` precede the FACe acknowledgement; afterwards `submitted`, `registered_rcf`, `accounted`, `paid`, `rejected`, `cancellation_requested`, `cancelled` or `error`. Kept up to date by the system polling — there is no refresh endpoint in v1.

registry_number.description: Registry number assigned by FACe on presentation. Synthetic `FACE-SANDBOX-*` for sandbox (test key) submissions.

dir3_proponent.description: Optional frozen role 04; not substituted by a live contact value.

error_code.description: Only error with confirmed_not_received authorizes a fresh attempt after audited reconciliation.

error_message.description: Safe public summary, never a raw SOAP or storage diagnostic.

status_updated_at.description: When the processing status last changed (ISO 8601).

last_polled_at.description: When the system last polled FACe for this submission, or `null` if never polled yet.

can_transmit.description: Only a prepared attempt with an intact retained artifact may continue; current actor send authority is also required.

requires_reconciliation.description: Uncertain transmission blocks new submissions, cancellation and automatic retry.

artifact_status.description: Legacy unverified bytes remain downloadable without inventing historical hashes or regenerating them.

FaceSubmission.description: Tenant-scoped durable FACe attempt. Frozen administrative and payment versions identify the prepared source independently of subsequent invoice or contact changes.

FindInvoiceByNumberRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/find-by-number.

Body: `number` (invoice number, required) plus TWO optional discriminators,
because a number repeats for two independent reasons:

- `year` — series recycle numbering across fiscal years.
- `series_id` — two series of the same company each issue their own
  `F-2026-001`; the year cannot tell them apart. Accepts the public UUID v7
  of a series of type `invoice` belonging to the caller's company.

Aligned with Supplier's `find-by-tax-id`.

series_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the series that issued the invoice; it tells apart two series that share a number.

FindInvoiceByNumberRequest.title: FindInvoiceByNumberRequest

rendimiento_neto_ejercicio_anterior_cent.description: Box [13]: net income of the PREVIOUS fiscal year, in cents (base of the reduction of art. 110.3.c RIRPF). It can be negative, because that year may have closed with a loss.

Holiday.description: A public holiday visible to your company: a global reference holiday (national or per autonomous community, seeded and read-only) or a custom local holiday you created. Used by the Control Horario (time tracking) module to exclude non-working days.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the holiday, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

scope.description: Territorial scope: `national` (all of Spain), `autonomic` (a single autonomous community) or `local` (a custom holiday of your company).

community_code.description: Autonomous community (comunidad autónoma) two-letter code (ISO 3166-2:ES) when `scope` is `autonomic`; `null` for `national` and `local` holidays.

date.description: Calendar date of the holiday, in `Y-m-d`.

year.description: Year the holiday falls on (derived from `date`).

name.description: Human-readable name of the holiday (e.g. `Año Nuevo`).

is_system.description: Whether this is a seeded reference holiday (`true`, read-only for your company) or a custom local holiday you created (`false`).

Holiday.title: Holiday

IbanString.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) in its canonical form: no spaces and uppercase (ISO 13616, total length 15..34). On input, spaces and lowercase letters are tolerated and normalized.
IbanString.title: IbanString

format.description: Format of the document: `factuarea.tasks.v1`, the format produced by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/tasks/export`. It may be omitted when the document is a `{project, tasks}` JSON file exported from another task manager, which is also accepted.

project.description: Data of the source project (`key`, `name`, `description` and `columns`), as they appear in the exported document.

tasks.description: Tasks to import: between 1 and 200 per request. Each element is an object describing one task. Problems inside a task never reject the request: they are reported per task, as warnings or as a failed entry, in the response.

IntegrationEvent.description: One event a payment gateway sent to Factuarea, with the outcome it produced and, when it produced none, the typed reason why. Read-only and scoped to your own company. The raw content of the event is NEVER exposed: it carries personal data of your end customers and payment details, is stored encrypted only for parked events so they can be reprocessed, and is purged 30 days after being parked.

id.description: UUID v7 of the event. Use it in `GET /v1/companies/{company}/integrations/events/{event}` and in the replay operation.

provider.description: Gateway or integration the event came from. Closed set, so it is safe to switch on it.

event_type.description: Event type as reported by the provider, matched EXACTLY when you filter by it. Free-form text, NOT a closed enum: the field deliberately mixes the raw provider type (`charge.refunded`, `invoice.paid`) with the internal semantic value some older branches recorded (`autoinvoice.*`). Do not model it as a fixed catalogue — for a filterable, closed axis use `discard_reason`.

direction.description: Direction of the exchange: `inbound` for something the provider sent us (all gateway webhooks), `outbound` for a call the platform made to the provider, `internal` for a state change of the integration itself. Free-form string rather than an enum: it is not backed by a closed catalogue in code.

status.description: Outcome of the event: `success` (it produced its effect), `skipped` (it was discarded on purpose — see `discard_reason`) or `failure` (it broke while being processed — see `error_message`).

discard_reason.description: Typed reason why the event was discarded, from a CLOSED catalogue, or `null` when it was not discarded. This is the axis to filter and group by. A value retired from the catalogue in a later version is still returned verbatim here, but its `discard_reason_label`, `is_actionable` and `is_replayable` degrade to neutral rather than breaking the page.

discard_reason_label.description: Human-readable label of `discard_reason`, in Spanish (the platform's end-user language). `null` when there is no discard reason, or when the stored reason is no longer part of the current catalogue.

is_actionable.description: `true` when the account owner can do something about this discard (turn a setting on, re-link an account). Only actionable discards notify the user; the informative ones are recorded but never interrupt anyone.

is_replayable.description: CONTRACT of the replay operation: when it is `true`, `POST /v1/companies/{company}/integrations/events/{event}/replay` does not answer 422. It is the conjunction of three conditions — the event is parked, it still holds its content, and its discard reason admits reprocessing — evaluated by the same check that guards the replay. It turns to `false` on its own once the 30-day retention window purges the content, even though the event stays parked.

error_message.description: Error raised while processing the event, or `null` when there was none. Relevant for `failure`; a `skipped` event carries its reason in `discard_reason`, not here.

duration_ms.description: Server-side processing time in milliseconds, or `null` when it was not measured.

recommended_action.example: Elige una de las dos salidas, no las dos: activa la auto-facturación en la configuración de la integración y reprocesa el evento, o crea la factura a mano. Si haces ambas, el cobro acabará con dos facturas.
recommended_action.description: Next step for this specific discard reason, in Spanish and in the imperative. Present ONLY in the detail and in the 202 of the replay — the listing omits it, because repeating the same sentence across 100 elements is noise. `null` when the reason is merely informative: if there is nothing to do, the contract does not invent an instruction. The sentence tells reproducible reasons ("… y reprocesa el evento") apart from the ones that are not ("… emítela a mano"), so it never points you at a call that would answer 422. When a reason admits BOTH ways out, they are worded as mutually exclusive and the sentence spells out the consequence of doing both: replay idempotency keys on the charge and only recognises invoices issued through that same automatic path, so an invoice created by hand does not stop it — doing both leaves two invoices for one charge, each numbered in its series and filed with VeriFactu.

IntegrationEvent.title: IntegrationEvent

IntegrationEventList.description: Cursor-paginated page of integration events (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`), most recent first.

data.description: Page of integration events, newest first. The elements do NOT carry `recommended_action`: fetch the detail of the one you care about.

has_more.description: `true` when more events exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `starting_after` for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`. Unlike the rest of the v1 listings it is a numeric string, not a UUID v7 — treat it as opaque and reuse it verbatim.

IntegrationEventList.title: IntegrationEventList

email.description: Email address the invitation is sent to.

role.description: Account role the person would join with: `admin` or `member`.

grants.description: Initial per-tax-ID grants of the invited person. Required, it can be empty; only a `member` carries grants.

company_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of a tax ID of your account.

level.description: Access level on that tax ID: `view` (read-only) or `operate`.

send_email.description: Send the invitation email (`true`, default) or only return the acceptance link (`false`).

Invoice.description: An invoice (compliant with Spanish AEAT VeriFactu).

number.description: Definitive invoice number, or `null` for drafts (where `is_number_assigned` is `false`).

is_number_assigned.description: Whether the invoice has a definitive number assigned. `false` for drafts (where `number` is `null`); becomes `true` after `POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/assign-real-number`, or automatically when the invoice is issued.

type.description: Document type: `F1` (ordinary invoice, *ordinaria*), `F2` (simplified invoice, *simplificada*), `F3` (invoice replacing simplified ones, *sustitutiva de simplificadas*) or `R5` (corrective of a simplified invoice). A corrective of an `F1`/`F3` keeps `F1` here; its AEAT corrective code (`R1`–`R5`) is `corrective.correction_aeat_type`, and `is_corrective` tells correctives apart.

status.description: Public invoice status. `issued` means the invoice has been ISSUED (definitive number, VeriFactu record); it says nothing about delivery, which lives in `is_sent`/`sent_at`/`sent_via`. `paid` and `partially_paid` are derived from the payment ledger. Before API version `2026-10-01` the issued status is published as `sent` (that contract called issuing "sending"), so `sent` only appears for integrations pinned to an earlier version.

price_list_id.description: UUID of the price list selected for this document.

price_list_name.description: Price-list name snapshot frozen on the document.

operation_on.description: Date the operation took place when it differs from `issued_on` (arts. 6.1.f and 7.1.c of Royal Decree 1619/2012), or `null` when both coincide. It cannot be later than `issued_on` unless the first line that declares a `regime_key` uses 14 or 15 (otherwise 422 `operation_date_after_issue_date`), and it is immutable once the invoice is issued. A corrective invoice inherits the date of the original. It is printed on the PDF and reported in the VeriFactu record (`FechaOperacion`).

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on an expense the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Output VAT (IVA repercutido) accrued by the document: sum of the VAT of its lines. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 303 declares, and it is NOT recoverable from `taxes_total`, which nets the withholding out.

total_retention.description: Withholding (retención de IRPF) applied to the document: sum of the withholding of its lines, as a POSITIVE amount that SUBTRACTS from the total. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 130/111 declares. It is ALREADY netted out inside `taxes_total`, so do not subtract it again.

total_surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) of the document: sum of the surcharge of its lines. It ADDS to the total exactly like VAT does, and is ALREADY included inside `taxes_total`.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

total_disbursements.description: Sum of the `SUPLIDO` (disbursement) lines of this invoice: amounts the issuer paid in the name and on behalf of the client and re-invoices at cost. Deliberately OUTSIDE `subtotal`, `taxes_total` and `total`, because a disbursement is not part of the issuer's taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA) and is not declared in the AEAT VeriFactu record. `0` on an invoice without disbursements.

total_to_pay.description: Amount the client actually has to pay: `total + total_disbursements`. DERIVED, never stored — one single formula computes it — and equal to `total` on an invoice without disbursements. Worked example: a 1,000.00 service line at 21% plus a 150.00 `SUPLIDO` line yields `subtotal` 1000.00, `taxes_total` 210.00, `total` 1210.00, `total_disbursements` 150.00 and `total_to_pay` 1360.00. Note that `paid_amount`/`pending_amount` are measured against `total`, not against `total_to_pay`.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

exemption_reason.description: VAT exemption cause per document (AEAT catalog E1..E6), or `null` when not exempt. Read-only: the public API derives the AEAT qualification from the regime/cause at issuance.

legal_mentions.description: Header legal mentions (includes the mention derived from the exemption cause). Read-only.

exclude_347.description: Read-only flag: whether this invoice is excluded from the annual Modelo 347 report. The public API cannot change it; the flag is managed from the Factuarea app.

verifactu_status.description: Status of the AEAT VeriFactu submission.

paid_amount.description: Amount already collected for this invoice (derived from the payment ledger). Satisfies the invariant `paid_amount + pending_amount === total`.

pending_amount.description: Outstanding balance pending collection for this invoice (derived from the payment ledger).

payments.description: Payment ledger summary, ALWAYS present (never `null`). `total` mirrors `paid_amount`, `pending` mirrors `pending_amount`. `detail` lists the individual payments and is materialized ONLY on the show endpoint (`GET /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}`); in list responses `detail` is `[]` (by cost) while `total`/`pending` stay populated. The detail is also available via `GET /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/payments`.

detail.description: List of individual payments. Empty `[]` in list responses or when there are no payments yet.

total.description: Total amount collected (mirrors `paid_amount`).

is_corrective.description: Whether this invoice is a corrective (rectificativa) of another invoice.

paid_recorded_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601 with offset) at which the collection that settled the invoice was RECORDED in the ledger. `null` while the invoice is not collected. Not the declared date: see `paid_date`.

paid_date.description: Declared collection date (YYYY-MM-DD). `null` while the invoice is not collected. The input field of `mark-paid` and `payments` keeps the name `paid_on`.

issued_at.description: When the invoice was issued (ISO 8601), or `null` while it is a draft or scheduled. Not present before API version `2026-10-01`: earlier versions publish this instant in `sent_at`.

sent_at.description: When the invoice was first delivered to the customer (ISO 8601): the moment the mail server accepted its delivery email, or the date of a manual mark. `null` while it has not been delivered. A resend never moves it. Before API version `2026-10-01` this field carries the ISSUANCE instant instead (that contract called issuing "sending").

sent_via.description: Channel of the first delivery: `email` (the mail server accepted the delivery email) or `manual` (marked with `POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/mark-sent`). `null` while the invoice has not been delivered. Not present before API version `2026-10-01`.

is_sent.description: Whether the invoice has been delivered to the customer, independently of its fiscal `status`: an issued or overdue invoice can be delivered or not. Derived from the delivery mark (`sent_at` + `sent_via`), never set directly. Not present before API version `2026-10-01`.

scheduled_for.description: Scheduled emission timestamp (ISO 8601), or `null` when the invoice is not scheduled. Populated only while `status` is `scheduled`.

scheduled_action.description: Action the scheduler runs when `scheduled_for` is reached: `issue` (issue without sending) or `issue_and_send` (issue and email it). `null` when the invoice is not scheduled. Before API version `2026-10-01` the `issue` action is published as `draft`, its previous name.

channel.description: Sales channel the invoice originated from (`woocommerce`, `shopify`, `prestashop`), or `null` when it was not created from a store order — which is the common case.

source_store_id.description: UUID v7 of the connected store whose order produced this invoice, or `null` when it was not created from a store order. A store order is not a resource of its own on this API, so `channel` and `source_store_id` are the traceability from the order to the invoice.

origin.description: Where the invoice comes from: `native` (issued in Factuarea) or `historical_import` (a historical invoice registered by import: literal number from the file, no series counter and no VeriFactu record).

payment_terms_version.description: 0 means no component row; a persisted row starts at 1. Calendar CAS is independent of administrative and visual versions.

payment_terms_source.description: none unknown; explicit business intent (including []); legacy an observed adaptation, not historical evidence.

payment_terms_frozen_at.description: Frozen once before issuance or internal legacy capture; no change on collection/reversal. Unknown none is not frozen or adapted automatically on issue.

lines.additional_description: Auditoría inicial e informe de mejoras

Invoice.title: Invoice

InvoiceActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of an invoice. Groups domain events originated by changes to the invoice itself (creation, sending, payment, correction, etc.), the result of every submission of its VeriFactu records to AEAT, emails that could not be delivered, the first visit of each day to its public link and the payments registered, edited or reversed on it.

event_type.description: Domain event type (e.g. `invoice.created`, `invoice.paid`). These types have an exact `metadata` contract (see `metadata`): `verifactu.record_accepted` (AEAT accepted a record of the invoice — the alta, a subsanation or the annulment —, with or without admissible errors), `verifactu.record_rejected` (AEAT rejected a record), `verifactu.transmission_failed` (the submission failed because of AEAT or the network and is retried automatically; ONE per incident, not one per attempt), `verifactu.transmission_blocked` (the submission is stopped with no automatic retry until someone fixes the cause), `invoice.email_failed` (the invoice email could not be delivered after its retries) and `invoice.public_link_viewed` (first visit of the day, Europe/Madrid, to the public link; later visits that day do not add another entry), `payment.payment_created` (a payment was registered), `payment.payment_reversed` (a payment was reversed) and `payment.payment_updated` (a payment was edited). Payment events also cover the payments recorded before they were published here.

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved. The event types listed in `event_type` publish EXACTLY these keys: `verifactu.record_accepted` → `record_type`, `csv`, `aeat_error_code`, `requires_subsanation`, `attempt`; `verifactu.record_rejected` → `record_type`, `aeat_error_code`, `aeat_error_message`, `attempt`; `verifactu.transmission_failed` → `record_type`, `reason`, `attempt`, `next_retry_at`; `verifactu.transmission_blocked` → `record_type`, `block_reason`; `invoice.email_failed` → `recipient`, `reason`; `invoice.public_link_viewed` → `views_today` and, only when known, `downloaded_pdf`; `payment.payment_created` → `amount`, `method`, `provider`; `payment.payment_reversed` → `amount`, `reason`, `provider`; `payment.payment_updated` → `changed_fields`, `provider`.

record_type.description: `verifactu.*` events: which record was submitted — the initial `alta`, a `subsanacion` (a new alta that corrects a previous one) or the `anulacion`.

csv.description: `verifactu.record_accepted`: secure verification code (CSV) AEAT returned. `null` when AEAT confirmed the record as a duplicate of an earlier submission (the CSV belongs to that one).

aeat_error_code.description: `verifactu.record_accepted`: code of the admissible error (`2xxx`) or warning AEAT accepted the record with, `null` when it was accepted without errors. `verifactu.record_rejected`: code of the rejection (`SCHEMA_INVALID` when the record was rejected without being sent because it breaks the AEAT XML schema).

requires_subsanation.description: `verifactu.record_accepted`: whether AEAT requires a subsanation of `aeat_error_code`. Every admissible error does except `2004` (FechaHoraHusoGenRegistro) and `2009` (ClaveRegimen with IPSI), which AEAT exempts (AEAT «Validaciones» v1.2.2, §4.3.1). `false` when there is no error.

aeat_error_message.description: `verifactu.record_rejected`: description of the rejection given by AEAT.

attempt.description: `verifactu.record_accepted`, `verifactu.record_rejected` and `verifactu.transmission_failed`: number of submission attempts of the record so far.

reason.description: `verifactu.transmission_failed`: why the submission failed — `AEAT_UNREACHABLE` (AEAT did not answer, timed out or the network failed), `UNMATCHED_RESPONSE_LINE` (the AEAT answer did not include this record) or `SYSTEM_CERTIFICATE_UNAVAILABLE` (the Factuarea certificate used in third-party remission is not available). `invoice.email_failed`: readable reason in Spanish, without sensitive data (never the raw text of the mail server). `payment.payment_reversed`: key of the reversal reason (e.g. `issued_in_error`, `direct_debit_return`, `card_dispute`).

next_retry_at.description: `verifactu.transmission_failed`: when the automatic retry is scheduled (ISO 8601), or `null`.

block_reason.description: `verifactu.transmission_blocked`: why the submission is stopped. It does not go out again until the cause is fixed and the record is reactivated (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/records/retry-blocked`).

recipient.description: `invoice.email_failed`: email address the invoice was sent to.

views_today.description: `invoice.public_link_viewed`: visits of that day when the entry was recorded. The entry is written on the first visit and not rewritten, so it is `1`.

amount.description: `payment.payment_created` and `payment.payment_reversed`: amount of the payment in euros as a 2-decimal string.

method.description: `payment.payment_created`: payment method key, from the catalog of `GET /v1/payment-methods` (e.g. `bank_transfer`, `cash`, `credit_card`).

provider.description: `payment.*`: origin of the payment when it was collected automatically — `stripe`, `gocardless`, `monei`, `woocommerce` or `shopify` — or `null` for a payment registered by hand. Read from the payment itself, so it is also present on events recorded before it existed. When `performed_by` is `null` and `provider` is set, the payment came from that gateway.

changed_fields.description: `payment.payment_updated`: names of the payment fields that changed (`amount`, `date`, `method`, `reference`, `notes`).

downloaded_pdf.description: `invoice.public_link_viewed`: `true` when the visit that opened the day was the PDF download. Absent when it is not known (a visit to the page).

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID v7 of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

role_code.description: 01 accounting office; 02 managing body; 03 processing unit; 04 proposing body.

code.description: DIR3: 9-10 alphanumeric characters starting with a letter after trim and uppercase normalization. Lowercase and surrounding whitespace are accepted; the normalized value is returned.

name.description: Optional label, preserved verbatim, at most 40 Unicode characters.

InvoiceAdministrativeCentres.description: At most one entry per role, returned sorted by role_code. [] explicitly selects no administrative centres; it never falls back to current contact defaults.
InvoiceAdministrativeCentres.title: InvoiceAdministrativeCentres

revisions.description: Append-only history in ascending version order.

InvoiceAdministrativeHistory.description: Version starts at 1. Snapshot null means unknown legacy capture; snapshot [] means known empty. Override null inherits the frozen snapshot, while override [] selects no centres.
InvoiceAdministrativeHistory.title: InvoiceAdministrativeHistory

InvoiceAdministrativeRevision.description: An immutable administrative routing revision. Actor and correlation identify the authorized write; it does not change fiscal parties, amounts, issuance or payment terms.
InvoiceAdministrativeRevision.title: InvoiceAdministrativeRevision

InvoiceCorrective.description: Correction data of a corrective invoice. Present (object) when `is_corrective=true`, `null` on ordinary invoices.

original_id.description: UUID v7 of the original corrected invoice.

original_number.description: Human-readable number of the original corrected invoice.

original_date.description: Issue date of the original invoice (YYYY-MM-DD).

correction_reason.description: Reason for the correction (AEAT code R1–R5).

correction_type.description: Scope of the correction: `total` (the whole invoice, `correction_type: full` on input) or `partial`.

correction_nature.description: Effective nature of the correction (art. 15.5 RD 1619/2012), the same one its VeriFactu record declares as `TipoRectificativa`: `I` by differences (the corrective carries the amount of the rectification, any sign) or `S` substitution (the invoice as it ends up). A corrective with a negative base is always `I`.

base_rectificada.description: Taxable base of the ORIGINAL invoice being corrected; reported to VeriFactu as `ImporteRectificacion.BaseRectificada` on a substitution (`S`).

cuota_rectificada.description: VAT amount of the ORIGINAL invoice being corrected; reported to VeriFactu as `ImporteRectificacion.CuotaRectificada` on a substitution (`S`).

correction_aeat_type.description: AEAT corrective invoice type code (`R1`–`R5`) frozen at issuance from the VeriFactu record. `null` if not resolved.

InvoiceCorrective.title: InvoiceCorrective

InvoiceDeliveryNoteReference.description: A delivery-note number of at most 30 Unicode characters and an optional real YYYY-MM-DD date.
InvoiceDeliveryNoteReference.title: InvoiceDeliveryNoteReference

receiver_contract_reference.description: At most 20 Unicode characters. Null clears the reference; whitespace-only text is invalid.

receiver_transaction_reference.description: At most 20 Unicode characters. Null clears the reference; whitespace-only text is invalid.

file_reference.description: At most 20 Unicode characters. Null clears the reference; whitespace-only text is invalid.

InvoiceHeaderReferences.description: Exactly three supported header keys. On update, omitted keys preserve their values, an empty object does nothing and null clears the whole object. Dates and issuer references are line-only.
InvoiceHeaderReferences.title: InvoiceHeaderReferences

id.description: Persisted public instalment UUID v7, always returned.

due_date.description: Real YYYY-MM-DD date, year 0001-9999. Rows preserve input order and their dates must be nondecreasing; equal dates are allowed. The date of the last row is the due date of the invoice (`due_on`).

amount.description: Signed EUR amount with exactly two decimals, never a JSON number. Every nonzero row has the sign of total_to_pay, and the exact sum equals total_to_pay including disbursements. No mixed-sign compensation, exponent, whitespace or implicit proration.

payment_means.description: Contractual payment code, independent of the operational payment_method: 01 cash; 02 direct debit; 04 bank transfer; 11 cheque; 19 card. BIC is never a payment code.

id.description: Optional by omission for a new instalment. If supplied, it must be a nonempty UUID v7 string; null is invalid. Omitted always creates a new identity, even when date/amount/position match a previous row. Active identities belong to this invoice; retired identities cannot be reused.

due_date.description: Real YYYY-MM-DD date, year 0001-9999. Rows preserve input order and their dates must be nondecreasing; equal dates are allowed. The date of the last row is the due date of the invoice (`due_on`).

amount.description: Signed EUR amount with exactly two decimals, never a JSON number. Every nonzero row has the sign of total_to_pay, and the exact sum equals total_to_pay including disbursements. No mixed-sign compensation, exponent, whitespace or implicit proration.

payment_means.description: Contractual payment code, independent of the operational payment_method: 01 cash; 02 direct debit; 04 bank transfer; 11 cheque; 19 card. BIC is never a payment code.

account.description: Omitted or null means no contractual account. Only codes 02 (debited) and 04 (credited) may carry one. Saving an incomplete draft is allowed; a new issue or legacy capture with 02/04 requires the account before commit. No live-bank fallback for an explicit row.

InvoiceInvoicingPeriod.description: Two real YYYY-MM-DD dates with start_date <= end_date; equal dates are valid. A supplied period replaces the whole period, null clears it.
InvoiceInvoicingPeriod.title: InvoiceInvoicingPeriod

InvoiceLegalLiterals.description: Ordered legal text supplied by the business. Each item has at most 250 Unicode characters. Order and duplicate items are preserved; null or [] clears the list. This is independent of calculated fiscal legal_mentions.
InvoiceLegalLiterals.title: InvoiceLegalLiterals

InvoiceLine.description: A line item on an invoice. `line_total` is NOT part of this response: it is a write-only checksum the client may send on create/update so a rounding mismatch with its own ERP is caught (see the create/update request body).

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.
additional_description.example: Auditoría inicial e informe de mejoras

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal STRING with the 4-decimal scale of its column (e.g. `"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): it is returned exactly as it was accepted and stored, so reading a line and sending it back never changes its price. Derived amounts (`subtotal`, `taxes`, `total`) keep 2 decimals.

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

counted_quantity.description: Pieces the customer asked for on a variable-weight line sold by count (decimal string, scale 4, greater than 0), e.g. `"4.0000"` for four pieces weighing `quantity` kg in total. Informational: the line is charged and the stock is discounted by `quantity` (the real weight), never by the pieces. `null` on any other line. Only accepted on a `variable_measure` presentation whose unit is a count unit.

counted_unit.description: UN/ECE code of the count unit of `counted_quantity` (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack…). `null` exactly when `counted_quantity` is `null`.

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the resolved price: `per_base_unit` (product/variant own price, converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (presentation, combination or price-list entry, never converted). `null` on a line with no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string. Informational when an exact price already absorbed them.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the resolved price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined — the assembler refuses such a line with 422 rather than risking charging the adjustments twice, so `null` only ever reaches a reader on a legacy line with no configurable options at all.

regime_key.description: VeriFactu special regime key (ClaveRegimen, AEAT L8.1) declared for this line, or null when the line inherits the regime from the invoice header.

exemption_reason.description: LIVA exemption cause (E1–E6) or non-subjection cause (N1/N2) declared for this line, or null when the line inherits the qualification from the invoice header.

aeat_tax_code.description: AEAT operation qualification code snapshot frozen at issuance. Read-only (derived).

line_type.description: Kind of line. `NORMAL` is an ordinary line of the issuer's own operation. `SUPLIDO` is a DISBURSEMENT: an amount the issuer paid in the name and on behalf of the client (an official fee, duty or registry charge) and now re-invoices at cost. Under art. 78.Tres.3 of the Spanish VAT Act (LIVA) a disbursement is not part of the issuer's taxable base, so a `SUPLIDO` line stays out of `subtotal`, `taxes_total` and `total`, is aggregated into `total_disbursements` instead, carries no VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount or product, and is never declared in the AEAT VeriFactu record. Always present and never `null` in a response (a line created before this field existed reads as `NORMAL`); optional on write, where it defaults to `NORMAL`.

source_invoice_reference.description: Reference of the supporting document that originated the disbursement — the receipt or fee number issued by the public body (≤100 chars). REQUIRED on a `SUPLIDO` line (a disbursement without its supporting reference is rejected with 422) and `null` on a normal line. Free text on purpose: the receipt of a public body is rarely a supplier invoice.

source_invoice_ids.description: Optional traceability of a `SUPLIDO` line: IDs (UUID v7) of your own expenses that back the disbursement. `null` when the line carries no traceability — never `[]`, so "no traceability" cannot be confused with "empty list". An expense of another company is rejected with 422.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the document (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), ≤20 chars, or `null` when not reported. Presentation only: free text with no closed catalog and no fiscal effect, since no AEAT catalog applies to the ordinary Spanish invoice.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of this line (≤255 chars), printed under the line description to satisfy the mention required by art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012 when the catalogued cause does not cover it. Orthogonal to `exemption_reason` and to the document-level exemption cause: no coherence is enforced between them and the automatic header legal mention is unchanged.

delivery_notes_references.description: Ordered delivery-note references; duplicates are preserved. A supplied list replaces the previous list.

sequence_number.description: Optional sequence. JSON integers only: 0 is valid; booleans, floats and numeric strings are rejected.

iban.description: A valid IBAN after removing ASCII spaces and uppercasing: 15-34 alphanumeric characters and MOD97 checksum. No ES-only restriction. Invalid input is reported by field without echoing the account.

bic.description: Optional BIC. Trim/uppercase normalization; 8 or 11 characters, pattern AAAABBCC or AAAABBCCDDD. An 8-character BIC remains 8 characters in this contract.

InvoicePaymentDetail.description: A single payment recorded against an invoice (partial payment ledger entry). Listed in `payments.detail[]` (materialized only on the show endpoint) and in the standalone sub-resource `GET /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/payments`.

id.description: Opaque UUID v7 of the payment.

object.description: String identifying the object type. Always `payment`.

invoice_id.description: UUID v7 of the invoice this payment belongs to.

payment_method.description: Payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

payment_method_text.description: Human-readable label of the payment method (Spanish).

reference.description: Payment reference/operation number. `null` if not provided.

notes.description: Internal notes for the payment. `null` if not provided.

is_reversed.description: Whether the payment has been reverted. A reverted payment stays in the ledger but stops counting towards `paid_amount`, `pending_amount` and every treasury aggregate — read this flag, do not infer the state from absence.

reversed_at.description: When the payment was reverted (ISO 8601), or `null` while it is in force.

reversal_reason.description: Reason the payment was reverted, from the closed catalog. `issued_in_error` appears only on payments reverted by annulling an invoice issued by mistake with `revert_collections`; it cannot be requested for a single payment. `null` while the payment is in force.

reversal_reason_text.description: Human-readable label of the reversal reason (Spanish), or `null`.

reversal_note.description: Free-text remark recorded with the reversal (up to 500 characters), or `null`.

created_at.description: When the payment was recorded (ISO 8601), or `null`.

updated_at.description: When the payment was last updated (ISO 8601), or `null`.

InvoicePaymentTerms.description: Contractual instalments, independent of payments and collection status. Order and persisted identities are preserved. Reading never captures legacy data or queries live bank accounts.
InvoicePaymentTerms.title: InvoicePaymentTerms

InvoicePaymentTermsInput.description: Create omitted/null means unknown; [] means explicitly no schedule, including a positive payable. Update omitted preserves, null removes the schedule only on a draft, [] explicitly selects none, and a list replaces all rows. No merge or automatic matching by index. A nonempty list must balance exactly; total zero allows only null/[]. With a nonempty list the invoice falls due on its last instalment: `due_on` must be that date when the invoice is issued (422 `invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment`), a draft keeps the date you send, and an update that replaces the list without `due_on` moves it to the last instalment.
InvoicePaymentTermsInput.title: InvoicePaymentTermsInput

corrective_count.description: Number of corrective invoices issued in the period.

number.description: Human-readable number of the replacement full invoice.

InvoiceSubstitutedBy.title: InvoiceSubstitutedBy

InvoiceWithCheckoutBlocks.description: The invoice returned by `POST /v1/companies/{company}/invoices` (an `Invoice` with every one of its keys) plus the three blocks a terminal needs, present ONLY when the request is a cashier checkout — `type: F2`, a `payment` block or `options.register_verifactu`. A request that is not a checkout returns the bare `Invoice`: the blocks are absent, not `null`. The same body is returned with `200` and the `Idempotent-Replayed: true` header when a late retry repeats the `external_id` of an invoice already issued.

verifactu.description: State of the VeriFactu registration (alta) generated by the issuance, ready to print on the receipt. `null` when the alta was not requested and the invoice has no record (an `F2` or a payment without `options.register_verifactu`): the terminal tells "no alta" apart from "alta failed". The alta is generated BEFORE responding; its transmission to AEAT follows its course in batches afterwards.

status.description: `registered`: the alta exists. `failed`: the invoice is issued but the alta could not be generated — `error_code` says why and a retry with the same `external_id` completes it.

error_code.description: Why the alta failed. `null` unless `status` is `failed`.

aeat_status.description: Status of the record before AEAT (`pending`, `submitted`, `accepted`, `rejected` or `error`), or `null` when there is no record.

huella.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the record (64 hexadecimal characters), or `null` while it does not exist.

qr_url.description: AEAT verification URL carried by the QR, with its four parameters (`nif`, `numserie`, `fecha`, `importe`), or `null`.

qr_png_base64.description: The QR as a PNG image, base64-encoded without a data-URI prefix (error-correction level M), ready to print, or `null`.

legend.description: Legend to print next to the QR, with the wording AEAT requires: `VERI*FACTU` when the platform operates in VERI*FACTU mode (the usual case) or `Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT` in NO VERI*FACTU mode. `null` when there is no QR to print (for example when the alta could not be generated).

csv.description: AEAT secure verification code (CSV). `null` until AEAT accepts the submission.

pdf.description: The PDF of the invoice. `null` while the invoice is still a draft (it has no PDF yet). Without revisioned document templates it is the A4 PDF; for another paper — 80 or 58 mm tickets — call `GET /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/pdf?format=ticket_80|ticket_58`, which renders in the request. With revisioned document templates it is the output retained for the presentation captured at issuance, in that presentation's paper (a simplified invoice may be retained as an 80 mm ticket), and `url` serves that paper.

status.description: `ready`: the PDF is already rendered and `url` serves it at once (only with `options.wait_for_pdf`, which enqueues the render and waits up to about 15 s). `pending`: the render was enqueued and `url` does not serve it yet — 404, or 503 `pdf_artifact_not_ready` with `Retry-After` for a retained output — until the worker renders it (seconds); it is also the state of a `wait_for_pdf` whose wait expired and of a retained output that could not be enqueued yet, which `GET /v1/companies/{company}/invoices/{invoice}/pdf-link` enqueues. It is never an error.

url.description: Signed, temporary URL to the PDF. It needs no API key, only opens this invoice and stops working at `expires_at`.

expires_at.description: Instant after which the signed `url` stops working.

public_url.description: Public link of the invoice (`/d/{id}`) from which the end customer downloads it — the same as `public_link.url`. `null` while the invoice is a draft or when its public link is disabled.

InvoiceWithCheckoutBlocks.title: InvoiceWithCheckoutBlocks

IssuingReadiness.description: Whether a NIF can issue documents right now, and what stands in the way when it cannot. `can_issue` is the verdict and `blockers` the reasons: an empty `blockers` with `can_issue` false would be a bug, because a refusal that cannot be named cannot be fixed.

can_issue.description: The verdict. `true` only when every condition below is met.

blockers.description: Machine-readable reasons the NIF cannot issue, in no particular order. Empty when `can_issue` is `true`. `verifactu_certificate_missing` means VeriFactu is enabled for the NIF but it has no valid certificate (none, revoked or expired). New reasons may be added over time: treat an unknown one as a blocker you cannot fix through the API.

census_status.description: State of the AEAT census check for this NIF.

has_default_series.description: Whether the NIF has a default document series to number with.

fiscal_profile_complete.description: Whether the fiscal profile (tax id, address, territorial regime) is complete.

operable.description: Whether the NIF is active and operable, as opposed to deactivated.

missing_modules.description: Modules the plan does not grant that issuing would need. Empty when nothing is missing.

checked_at.description: Instant the verdict was computed (ISO 8601). It is a reading of a moment, not a stored flag.

description.description: Optional description of the work.

ManagedAccount.description: An account your account provisioned for one of your clients: a SEPARATE account, with its own tax IDs and plan, that your account manages and pays until its holder claims it and takes over. Its pending claim voucher is read in `claim`, without secret or link: those are returned once, by the provisioning and by the reissue.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the managed account. It is the `{account}` of the managed account routes.

external_ref.description: Your own reference for this account, unique per provider. Provisioning it again returns this same account.

status.description: Status of the ACCOUNT: `provisioned` (created by you, not claimed yet), `claimed` (its holder took it) or `active`. The end of the management is read in `management`, not here.

environment.description: Environment of the account: always the one of the key that provisioned it. A test account is never charged and cannot be claimed.

plan.description: Current plan of the managed account. `enterprise` is only assigned by Factuarea by contract.

pending_plan.description: Plan requested by a downgrade that takes effect at the end of the current period, or `null`.

billing_interval.description: Billing interval of the managed account (managed accounts are billed monthly).

access_level.description: Access level of your account on this account: `none` (provisioning only), `view` (read-only) or `operate`.

language.description: Language of the account and of its claim voucher, or `null` when not recorded.

companies.description: Tax IDs of the managed account.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID, the `{company}` of the company axis.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. AEAT control-digit (checksum) validation is enforced when the request opts in via the `Factuarea-Version` header on or after the activation version; without that opt-in the legacy permissive behaviour is preserved.

name.description: Name of the tax ID.

claimed.description: Whether its holder already claimed the account.

claimed_at.description: When its holder claimed the account (ISO 8601), or `null`.

management.description: Management of the account by your account.

status.description: `active` while your account manages it; `ended` once the management ended.

paid_by_provider.description: Whether your account pays this account. `false` once its holder took over the payment.

claim.description: The PENDING claim voucher of the account, WITHOUT its secret or its link (those are returned once, by the provisioning and by the reissue). `null` when the account is already claimed, is a test account or has no pending voucher.

status.description: `valid` while the voucher has not expired; `expired` once `expires_at` passed (reissue it).

ttl_days.description: Days of validity the voucher was issued with.

masked_email.description: Email of the holder, masked, or `null` when the voucher was not sent by email.

payment_assumed_at.description: When the holder took over the payment of the account (ISO 8601), or `null` while your account still pays it (`paid_by_provider`).

ManagedAccountImport.description: Result of APPLYING a bulk import: every applicable row applied on its own (a row that fails does not undo the others), the statistics of the execution and, for every new live `managed_account` row, its claim voucher. The voucher (`claim_token`, `claim_url`) is returned ONCE, in this response only; it is `null` in every other row, when the link was emailed to the holder (`send_email: true`), for a test import and in an idempotent replay.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the execution.

status.description: Status of the execution. The response is returned once it ends: `completed`, or `failed` when it could not finish (the rows already applied stay applied).

stats.description: Statistics of the execution: rows by status, accounts created and reconciled, customers queued and amounts in cents.

created.description: Accounts and tax IDs created.

reconciled.description: Existing accounts and tax IDs reconciled.

monthly_amount_cents.description: Monthly net amount added to your subscription, in cents.

proration_amount_cents.description: Prorated net amount charged at once, in cents.

tax_amount_cents.description: VAT of the amount charged at once, in cents (already rounded per account). 0 in imports saved before VAT was charged and in test imports.

total_amount_cents.description: Amount actually charged at once with VAT (prorated amount plus `tax_amount_cents`), in cents. 0 in imports saved before VAT was charged and in test imports.

rows.description: Rows of the accounts file, in file order, with their claim voucher.

claim_token.description: Plaintext claim voucher of the managed account the row created, returned ONCE. Treat it as a credential. `null` when there is no voucher to deliver.

claim_url.description: Claim link carrying the voucher, to deliver to the holder yourself, returned ONCE. `null` when there is no voucher to deliver.

own_company_customers.description: Outcome of the `apply_customers_to_own_company` option: the customers of `customers_file` WITHOUT `account_ref`, imported into your own company in focus (the only tax ID of the credential scope, or the only tax ID of your account). `null` when the option is off. `ERROR` `own_company_focus_required` when your account has several tax IDs and none is in focus; `ERROR` `insufficient_scope` without `contacts:write`; `ERROR` `live_credential_required` with a test key; `BLOCKED` `account_admin_required` or `operate_access_required` when the person who issued the key cannot write in that company; `BLOCKED` `nif_not_in_key_scope` when that company is outside the tax ID scope of the key; `BLOCKED` `customers_import_failed` when the contact importer failed. `unmatched_customers` counts the customers whose `account_ref` matches no row of `accounts_file`: they are imported nowhere.

status.description: `VALID` (customers queued), `BLOCKED` or `ERROR`.

customers_queued.description: Customers queued for import into your own company.

unmatched_customers.description: Customers of `customers_file` whose `account_ref` matches no row of `accounts_file`, so they are not imported anywhere.

totals.description: Rows by status. The five statuses are always present (0 when there is none).

cost.description: Cost of the applicable rows by mode and in total. 0 for a test import, while your account is in trial and when your account is not charged.

managed_account.description: Cost of the new `managed_account` rows, charged on the `managed-accounts` subscription of your account. The VAT fields are additive: they are absent from the reports saved by earlier imports.

ManagedAccountImportRow.description: One row of the accounts file, as the preview classifies it and as the application reports it. The status of the tax ID (`status`) is reported apart from the status of its customers (`customers_status`).

line.description: Line of the row in the accounts file.

mode.description: `managed_account` provisions a separate account for a client; `own_nif` registers the tax ID as an additional tax ID of YOUR account. `null` when the row does not carry a valid `mode` (the row is `ERROR`).

external_ref.description: Your own reference of the managed account (`managed_account` rows), unique per provider: it is what makes a new import of the same file reconcile instead of duplicating. `null` in `own_nif` rows.

tax_id.description: Tax ID of the row as read from the file (one tax ID per row), or `null` when the row does not carry one.

status.description: `VALID` (it will be / was applied), `WARNING` (it will be / was applied with a remark in `code`), `ALREADY_EXISTS` (the account or the tax ID already exists: it is reconciled, never duplicated nor charged twice), `BLOCKED` (a business rule prevents applying it; the reason is in `code`) or `ERROR` (the row is wrong; the columns are in `errors`, or the reason in `code`). Only `VALID`, `WARNING` and `ALREADY_EXISTS` rows are applied.

code.description: Reason of a `WARNING`, `BLOCKED` or `ERROR`, or `null`. Report codes: `managed_account_claimed`, `access_level_below_relation`, `plan_change_not_confirmed`, `plan_change_failed` (`WARNING`; an existing account whose profile was updated but whose confirmed plan change failed is `WARNING` with the reason of that failure in `errors.plan`); `managed_account_plan_not_self_serve`, `managed_account_provider_in_trial`, `managed_accounts_limit_reached`, `billing_not_current`, `payment_method_required`, `nif_transfer_required`, `additional_nif_not_in_plan`, `additional_nif_limit_reached`, `managed_account_external_ref_in_other_environment`, `managed_account_no_longer_managed`, `management_ended`, `access_level_raise_forbidden`, `access_level_above_relation`, `plan_change_not_paid_by_provider`, `plan_change_requires_operate`, `forbidden_action` (`BLOCKED`); `live_credential_required`, `insufficient_scope`, `row_apply_failed` (`ERROR`). A row the domain rejects while being applied is `BLOCKED` with the public code (or subcode) of that rejection, so treat unknown values as a `BLOCKED` reason. A column error is reported in `errors` (and its code in `error_codes`), with `code` `null`; so is a value the account or tax ID rejects while the row is applied (`ERROR`, message in `errors.row`), which never stops the rest of the import.

errors.description: Errors by column: the key is the column of the file (or `row` for an error of the whole row) and the value its message, in Spanish. Always an object, `{}` when there is none.

error_codes.description: Stable code of each error of `errors`, with the SAME keys (the column of the file, or `row` / `plan` for an error of the whole row or of its plan change): `required`, `invalid_mode`, `invalid_plan`, `plan_not_allowed`, `invalid_tax_id`, `invalid_email`, `invalid_language`, `invalid_access_level`, `too_long`, `too_short`, `duplicate_in_file`, `tax_id_mismatch`, `unknown_column`, `duplicate_column`, `unnamed_column` and `column_count_mismatch` (column errors), `invalid_value`, `row_rejected` and `row_apply_failed` (`row`), `plan_change_rejected` (`plan`; the concrete reason of `row_rejected` and `plan_change_rejected` is the row `code`). Language-independent: use it, not the Spanish message of `errors`, to react to or translate an error. Always an object, `{}` when there is none.

plan.description: Plan of a `managed_account` row (`emprendedor`, `empresario` or `integral`), or `null`. An `own_nif` row inherits the plan of your account and carries no plan, and a row of status `ERROR` rejected while reading the file (it carries `errors` per column) carries `null` too; an `ERROR` raised while applying keeps the plan requested.

monthly_amount_cents.description: Monthly net amount the row adds to your subscription, in cents (0 when it is not charged: test import, row not applicable, already existing, trial).

proration_amount_cents.description: Net amount prorated to the end of your current billing period that applying the row charges at once, in cents.

account_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the managed account the row created or reconciled, or `null`.

customers_status.description: Status of the customers of `customers_file` for this row: `none` (no customers for it), `queued` (queued for import into its tax ID) or `blocked` (reason in `customers_code`).

customers_queued.description: Customers queued for import into the tax ID of the row.

name.description: Name of the tax ID read from the file, or `null` when the row carries none. The columns read from the file (`values`) are never published.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID the row registered or reconciled, only for `own_nif` rows (the tax ID of a `managed_account` row belongs to ANOTHER account, so it is not published); `null` otherwise.

customers_code.description: Reason of `customers_status: blocked`: the row itself was not applied (`nif_not_applied`), your account does not `operate` the managed account, the issuer is not an owner or admin of your own tax ID, your own tax ID is outside the tax ID scope of the key and was not registered by this import (`nif_not_in_key_scope`), the key lacks `contacts:write`, or the contact importer failed.

ManagedAccountImportV1Request.description: Multipart body (`multipart/form-data`) of the bulk import, shared by its preview and its application: the accounts file, the optional customers file and the `options`. Both files are CSV in UTF-8 (a BOM is accepted), separated by commas, semicolons or tabs, with up to 20 lines of preamble before the header row, and up to 5 MB each. Size and row limits are checked before reading any row: 413 `import_file_too_large`, 422 `import_row_limit_exceeded`, and 422 `import_file_invalid` for an unreadable file or a missing column.

accounts_file.description: Accounts file (required), up to 100 rows, with the columns of the template. `mode` is required on every row: `managed_account` provisions a separate account for a client (with `external_ref` and its `plan`) and `own_nif` registers the tax ID as an additional tax ID of your account (without `plan`). One tax ID per row.

customers_file.description: Customers file (optional), up to 1,000 rows. Each customer goes to the tax ID of the row named by its `account_ref`; the customers without `account_ref` only go to your own company with `apply_customers_to_own_company`.

options.description: Options of the import, sent as form fields (`options[send_email]=true`) or as one JSON field. Only the three below are accepted, all `false` by default; any other key is rejected with 422.

send_email.description: Email the claim link to the holder of every new managed account (`true`) instead of returning the voucher once in the response (`false`, default).

apply_customers_to_own_company.description: Import the customers without `account_ref` into your own company in focus (the only tax ID of the credential scope, or the only tax ID of your account). Requires `contacts:write`.

confirm_plan_changes.description: Apply the plan changes that rows ask for existing managed accounts your account pays. Without it those rows are `WARNING` and the plan does not change.

ManagedAccountList.description: Cursor-paginated list of your managed accounts in the environment of the key (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`). Without `status` it lists only the managements in force; with `status=ended` each item is an `EndedManagedAccount`. No item carries a claim voucher.

data.description: Page of managed accounts: a `ManagedAccount` while the management is in force, an `EndedManagedAccount` once it ended.

has_more.description: `true` when more managed accounts exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (pass it as `starting_after`), or `null` when `has_more` is `false`.

ManagedAccountPlanChangePreview.description: Preview, with no effect, of changing the plan of a managed account your account pays. Amounts are integer CENTS, taxable base without VAT; the key names the unit (`*_cents`). A managed account that is not charged to your account has no real charge: both amounts are 0 and the change is immediate.

from_plan.description: Current plan of the managed account.

effective.description: `immediate` for an upgrade, no change or no real charge; `period_end` for a charged downgrade, pending until `effective_at`.

effective_at.description: End of the current period, when a `period_end` change takes effect (ISO 8601); `null` for an immediate change.

prorated_amount_cents.description: Prorated net amount charged to your account at once, in cents (upgrade only; 0 otherwise).

next_invoice_amount_cents.description: Monthly fee of the requested plan on the next periodic invoice, in cents (0 when not charged to your account).

renews_at.description: End of the current billing period (ISO 8601), also for an upgrade; `null` when the managed account is not charged to your account.

deactivates.description: Active additional tax IDs that a downgrade would deactivate. Empty when it deactivates none.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID.

name.description: Name of the tax ID.

tax_id.description: Tax ID (NIF/CIF/NIE).

ManagedAccountProvisioningPreview.description: Preview, with no effect, of provisioning a new managed account of the requested plan for your account. A computed object with no identity. Amounts are integer CENTS and the key names the unit (`*_cents`): `amount_cents` is the taxable base charged today, `tax_amount_cents` its VAT and `total_cents` what is charged. When something is charged but the VAT could not be computed (the payment gateway returned no rate), `tax_rate`, `tax_amount_cents` and `total_cents` are all `null`: the base is never published as the total. With a test key every amount is 0.

amount_cents.description: Taxable base (without VAT) charged today, in cents.

tax_amount_cents.description: VAT of `amount_cents`, in cents. `null` when something is charged but no rate could be computed.

total_cents.description: `amount_cents` plus `tax_amount_cents`: what is charged, in cents. `null` when the VAT could not be computed: do not present `amount_cents` as the total.

tax_rate.description: Whole-number VAT percentage, or `null` when no rate can be computed.

next_invoice_date.description: Date of the next periodic invoice of your subscription (ISO 8601), or `null`.

unit_amount_cents.description: Monthly price of the requested plan, without VAT, in cents, or `null`.

is_first_seat.description: `true` when this provisioning creates the subscription and anchors the monthly billing day today.

recurring_quantity.description: Units of the joint monthly fee that follows (your whole book plus the requested plan), or `null`.

recurring_base_cents.description: Joint monthly fee that follows, taxable base, in cents, or `null`.

recurring_total_cents.description: Joint monthly fee that follows with VAT, in cents; `null` without a VAT rate.

requires_payment_method.description: `true` when the charge is real and your account has no payment method; the amounts are then 0.

zero_reason.description: Why nothing is charged today: `no_immediate_charge` (test key or no real charge). `null` when something is charged.

ManagedAccountWithClaim.description: The response of provisioning a managed account: the fields of `ManagedAccount` PLUS its claim voucher. `claim_token` and `claim_url` are returned ONCE, only for a new live account provisioned with `send_email: false`. They are `null` when the link was emailed to the holder (`send_email: true`), for a test account, when the `external_ref` was already provisioned (200) and in an idempotent replay: the voucher is never stored in the clear, not even in the idempotency cache. `claim_expires_at` is not a secret: it is returned also when the link was emailed and in an idempotent replay of that request. `reactivated` tells that the call reactivated a management that had ended before the holder claimed the account.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the managed account. It is the `{account}` of the managed account routes.

external_ref.description: Your own reference for this account, unique per provider. Provisioning it again returns this same account.

status.description: Status of the ACCOUNT: `provisioned` (created by you, not claimed yet), `claimed` (its holder took it) or `active`. The end of the management is read in `management`, not here.

environment.description: Environment of the account: always the one of the key that provisioned it. A test account is never charged and cannot be claimed.

plan.description: Current plan of the managed account. `enterprise` is only assigned by Factuarea by contract.

pending_plan.description: Plan requested by a downgrade that takes effect at the end of the current period, or `null`.

billing_interval.description: Billing interval of the managed account (managed accounts are billed monthly).

access_level.description: Access level of your account on this account: `none` (provisioning only), `view` (read-only) or `operate`.

language.description: Language of the account and of its claim voucher, or `null` when not recorded.

companies.description: Tax IDs of the managed account.

id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID, the `{company}` of the company axis.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. AEAT control-digit (checksum) validation is enforced when the request opts in via the `Factuarea-Version` header on or after the activation version; without that opt-in the legacy permissive behaviour is preserved.

name.description: Name of the tax ID.

claimed.description: Whether its holder already claimed the account.

claimed_at.description: When its holder claimed the account (ISO 8601), or `null`.

management.description: Management of the account by your account.

status.description: `active` while your account manages it; `ended` once the management ended.

paid_by_provider.description: Whether your account pays this account. `false` once its holder took over the payment.

claim.description: The PENDING claim voucher of the account, WITHOUT its secret or its link (those are returned once, by the provisioning and by the reissue). `null` when the account is already claimed, is a test account or has no pending voucher.

status.description: `valid` while the voucher has not expired; `expired` once `expires_at` passed (reissue it).

ttl_days.description: Days of validity the voucher was issued with.

sent_by_email.description: Whether the voucher left by email to the holder.

masked_email.description: Email of the holder, masked, or `null` when the voucher was not sent by email.

payment_assumed_at.description: When the holder took over the payment of the account (ISO 8601), or `null` while your account still pays it (`paid_by_provider`).

plan_renews_at.description: End of the current billing period of the plan (ISO 8601): when a pending downgrade takes effect and the next periodic invoice is issued. `null` when the account is not charged to your account.

claim_token.description: Plaintext claim voucher, returned ONCE. Treat it as a credential: whoever holds it can claim the account. `null` when there is no voucher to deliver (see the schema description).

claim_url.description: Claim link carrying the voucher, to deliver to the holder yourself, returned ONCE. `null` when there is no voucher to deliver.

claim_expires_at.description: Expiry of the voucher (ISO 8601). It is returned also when the link was emailed to the holder (`send_email: true`): the expiry is not a secret. `null` only when no voucher was issued (test account, idempotent retry or reactivated management).

reactivated.description: `true` only when provisioning REACTIVATED a management that had ended before the holder claimed the account (it carries no voucher, so `claim_expires_at` is `null`); `false` for a new account or one already in force.
