Me.description: Introspection of the credential authenticating the request: who it is, the account it belongs to, what it can actually do, and which tax IDs it reaches. Use it to validate a credential and discover its scope in a single call. It never carries per-tax-ID settings, nor any pricing, quota or usage field.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `me` for this resource.

account.description: The account the credential belongs to. Its opaque identifier is the one that goes in the `{account}` path segment of the account axis.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the account (UUID v7). The internal persistence identifier is never published.

name.description: Name of the account.

is_provider.description: Whether the account provisions managed accounts for its clients (it holds the account provider privilege).

privileged_scopes.description: Privileged scopes Factuarea granted to the account. `*` never covers them: a key can only carry them when they are listed here.

api_key.description: Metadata of the credential used to authenticate the request. The secret is never returned, neither whole nor in derived form (it is only shown once, at creation or rotation).

name.description: Human-friendly label assigned at creation time.

prefix.description: First chars of the key (e.g. `fact_live_1N0Fnyhh`) — safe to log.

scopes.description: EFFECTIVE scopes, not the ones requested at issuance: a scope the plan of the scoped tax IDs does not allow is not listed. `*` means super scope (full access).

tier.description: Rate-limit tier (`free`, `starter`, `pro`, `scale`). Derived from the plan (or preserved by historical grandfathering).

environment.description: Environment of the authenticated key: `live` (`fact_live_` prefix, real side effects) or `test` (`fact_test_` prefix, sandbox company, no real-world effects). Always matches the real prefix of the credential.

scope.description: Tax IDs this credential reaches, each with its opaque identifier and its fiscal identifier. Always enumerated, also when there is exactly one: that is how the holder of a single tax ID discovers its opaque identifier without building it by hand. A company outside the credential scope never appears here, not even one its holder can reach by another route.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the company (UUID v7) — the one the company axis expects in the path.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. AEAT control-digit (checksum) validation is enforced when the request opts in via the `Factuarea-Version` header on or after the activation version; without that opt-in the legacy permissive behaviour is preserved.

client_accounts.description: Accounts of your clients that the credential account reaches through a relation, ordered by `id`: accounts that granted it access (`granted`) and accounts it provisioned and still manages (`provisioned`). Only accounts of the environment of the key are listed, and at most 100 (`client_accounts_has_more` tells whether more exist; list them with `GET /v1/accounts`). Listed ONLY when the credential has the `accounts:read` scope in effect (the same one `GET /v1/accounts` requires): without it the list is empty and `client_accounts_visible` is `false`. Empty as well when there is none.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the client account (UUID v7).

name.description: Name of the client account.

origin.description: `granted` when the client account gave your account access; `provisioned` when your account provisioned it and manages it.

access_level.description: Access level of your account on the client account.

status.description: Status of the client ACCOUNT (not of the relation).

paid_by_provider.description: Whether your account pays the client account.

client_accounts_visible.description: `true` when the credential has the `accounts:read` scope in effect and `client_accounts` is the real list; `false` when it is empty because that scope is missing.

client_accounts_has_more.description: `true` when more client accounts exist beyond the 100 listed in `client_accounts`.

Me.title: Me

MemberModuleAccess.description: The module access level of an account member in one tax ID. `restrictions` is a DENY list: it states what has been WITHDRAWN, not what the person can do, so an empty object means no restriction at all and never no access. `grants` lists the administrator-only sections that were GRANTED on top.

member_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the account member (the `id` of `AccountMember`).

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the tax ID the level applies to.

restrictions.description: Section to withdrawn capabilities. A section absent from the map has nothing withdrawn; an empty object means the member has no restriction at all. `access` is the root capability: withdrawing it makes the others irrelevant for that section.

grants.description: Administrator-only sections GRANTED to the member in this tax ID, on top of the User group. Never contains an Administrator key (user management, plan and subscription, API and developers, digital certificate). Empty when nothing was granted, and always empty for an `owner` or `admin`, who hold every permission of their plan. The capabilities inside a granted section are still governed by `restrictions`.

MemberModuleAccess.title: MemberModuleAccess

Metadata.description:
A free map of up to 50 key→value pairs for storing arbitrary structured data (values are strings up to 500 characters). Unlike `custom_fields` — an ordered list of typed `{field, value}` pairs with display semantics, present on the six document resources — `metadata` is an unordered map for opaque integration data; a document may carry both. The master resources (Client, Supplier) have no `custom_fields`, so their `metadata` doubles as the custom-fields store.

**Reserved keys (read-only).** When the system auto-issues an invoice from a payment correlation (Stripe/GoCardless/MONEI), it writes `stripe_subscription_id`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `billing_reason`, `period_start` and `period_end` into that invoice metadata automatically. Do not set or overwrite them by hand — the platform owns them and a manual value may be replaced when the correlation runs.
Metadata.title: Metadata

ModifyTransportDocumentRequest.description: Modify an issued transport document. Required: `reason` (3-500 characters) and `data_origin` (`company` or `carrier_reported`). Send only the data that changes (vehicle, special authorization, dates, observations or the whole `shipments` list); the parties cannot change. Inside `shipments`, `id` only identifies a shipment of this document (any other returns 422 on `shipments.N.id`).
ModifyTransportDocumentRequest.title: ModifyTransportDocumentRequest

Money.description: Monetary amount as a string with two decimal places (Stripe-style), e.g. "1234.56".

MonthlyCloseAbsenceBalance.description: One available absence balance by type of an employee, frozen at closing time in the monthly close report.

available_days.description: Available days of that absence type, frozen at closing. Rounded up to a whole day, like `AbsenceBalance.available_days` (decimal string).

MonthlyCloseAbsenceBalance.title: MonthlyCloseAbsenceBalance

MonthlyCloseAbsenceTaken.description: One line of the taken-absence breakdown of an employee in the monthly close report: the absence type and the days taken of that type in the closed period.

days_taken.description: Days taken of that absence type in the closed period (decimal string).

MonthlyCloseAbsenceTaken.title: MonthlyCloseAbsenceTaken

MonthlyCloseReport.description: The monthly report over a closed period for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is composed from the frozen snapshot of the close, so it references the close by `close_id` (UUID v7) and never an `id` of its own. The totals never drift from the sheet at the moment of closing. Totals are in minutes.

close_id.description: UUID v7 of the monthly close the report belongs to.

status.description: State of the close (`closed`/`reopened`), so a reopened close is not mistaken for immutable.

total_expected_minutes.description: Company aggregate expected minutes in the period.

total_worked_minutes.description: Company aggregate worked minutes in the period.

total_balance_minutes.description: Company aggregate balance in the period (worked − expected).

total_overtime_minutes.description: Company aggregate overtime minutes in the period.

employees.description: One row per employee of the closed period.

MonthlyCloseReport.title: MonthlyCloseReport

MonthlyCloseReportRow.description: One employee’s row in the monthly close report, read from the frozen snapshot: the period totals in minutes, the approved absence days, the taken-absence breakdown, the frozen available balances and the daily detail.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the employee in the period.

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the employee in the period.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the employee in the period.

approved_absence_days.description: Approved absence days of the employee in the period (decimal string).

absence_breakdown.description: Taken absences broken down by type.

absence_balances.description: Available absence balances by type, frozen at closing.

days.description: Daily detail of the closed period.

MonthlyCloseReportRow.title: MonthlyCloseReportRow

MonthlyRegisterSignature.description: The digital seal (signature) of a closed monthly time record register for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Sealing a `closed` period freezes a canonical SHA-256 digest of its snapshot and a detached RSA-SHA256 signature made with the company certificate, so the register is tamper-evident and independently verifiable by a third party (labour inspectorate, auditor). There is exactly one seal per close, and it is not re-sealable. The `verified`/`verification_reason` fields are recomputed live on every read against the current snapshot: reopening and re-closing the period with different data yields `verified: false` with reason `snapshot_mismatch`.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the seal, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

monthly_time_record_close_id.description: UUID v7 of the monthly close this seal belongs to.

digest.description: The canonical digest of the close snapshot at sealing time.

value.description: The snapshot digest, 64 uppercase hexadecimal characters.

signature.description: The detached digital signature of the digest.

value.description: The signature of the digest, base64-encoded.

certificate.description: The company certificate the seal was made with, kept for traceability.

serial_number.description: Serial number of the signing certificate.

subject_name.description: Subject (holder) name of the signing certificate.

thumbprint.description: SHA-256 thumbprint of the certificate, 64 hexadecimal characters.

valid_to.description: End of validity of the certificate (ISO 8601).

sealed_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who sealed the register.

verified.description: Live verification: `true` if the current snapshot and the signature are intact.

verification_reason.description: Reason of the live verification: `verified` (intact), `snapshot_mismatch` (the snapshot changed since sealing), `signature_invalid` (the signature no longer validates) or `certificate_unreadable` (the certificate could not be read).

MonthlyRegisterSignature.title: MonthlyRegisterSignature

MonthlyTimeRecordClose.description: An immutable monthly close of the time record register for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Closing a finished `(year, month)` freezes each active employee’s balance snapshot and locks the period against retroactive entries and corrections. The close can be reopened for an audited correction (state `closed ⇄ reopened`).

id.description: Opaque identifier of the monthly close, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

status.description: State of the close: `closed` (immutable, period locked) or `reopened` (writes re-enabled for a correction).

period_start.description: First day of the closed period (YYYY-MM-DD).

period_end.description: Last day of the closed period (YYYY-MM-DD).

closed_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who closed the period.

reopened_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who reopened the close; `null` while it is still `closed`.

reopened_at.description: When the close was reopened (ISO 8601); `null` while it is still `closed`.

employee_count.description: Number of employees included in the close.

is_sealed.description: Whether a digital seal exists for this close (mere presence; integrity verification is served by `GET /companies/{company}/monthly-time-record-closes/{monthly_time_record_close}/seal`).

MonthlyTimeRecordClose.title: MonthlyTimeRecordClose

MonthlyTimeSheet.description: The live monthly time sheet of an employee for the open (in-progress) period of the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by employee + month, so it exposes `employee_id` (UUID v7) and never an `id`. Totals are in minutes; `days` is the daily breakdown. It is recomputed on every request, so a just-recorded clock entry is reflected without closing the month. The `total_*` fields cover the whole month and, in the current month, are a projection; `to_date` holds the actual accumulation of the closed days (every day before today).

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the sheet belongs to.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the whole month, including today and the remaining days (holidays, approved absences, days without a schedule and days outside the employment period already count as 0).

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the month so far, today included.

total_balance_minutes.description: Month balance in minutes as the sum of the daily balances. In the current month it is a projection that already subtracts the expected minutes of today and of the remaining days; use `to_date.balance_minutes` for the actual balance.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the month.

days.description: Daily breakdown of the month. Each day includes `is_unscheduled` and `is_outside_employment`.

MonthlyTimeSheet.title: MonthlyTimeSheet

index.description: 0-based position within the target scope. Mutually exclusive with `before_task_id` and `after_task_id`.

before_task_id.description: `id` of the task the moved task is placed before.

after_task_id.description: `id` of the task the moved task is placed after.

project_id.description: `id` of the destination project.

column_id.description: `id` of the destination column within the project. Mutually exclusive with `status`.

status.description: Destination virtual status (`planned` or `archived`). Mutually exclusive with `column_id`.

NifTransfer.description: A voucher that hands ONE NIF of an account over to another account. Issuing one is already giving away control of that NIF: whoever accepts the secret gets the NIF, and taking it back requires the OTHER party to act. The plaintext secret is NOT part of this representation and cannot be: only its irreversible fingerprint is stored, so no later read can return it.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the tax ID transfer, a UUID v7.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the NIF this transfer gives away.

status.description: DERIVED state, read against the clock: the table has no status column. `revoked` means the issuing account withdrew it before anyone accepted it. A consumed or revoked transfer and one that never existed are deliberately indistinguishable on acceptance.

recipient_account_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the ONLY account that can accept this transfer, or `null` when whoever holds the secret can accept it.

issued_at.description: When the transfer was issued (ISO 8601), or `null` when the instant is not recorded.

consumed_at.description: When the transfer was accepted (ISO 8601), or `null` while nobody accepted it. It does not say WHICH account accepted it.

revoked_at.description: When the issuing account revoked the transfer (ISO 8601), or `null` if it was not revoked.

NifTransfer.title: NifTransfer

NifTransferList.description: Cursor-paginated list of tax ID transfers (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`). The plaintext secret never appears here.

data.description: Page of tax ID transfers.

has_more.description: `true` when more tax ID transfers exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`.

NifTransferList.title: NifTransferList

NifTransferWithSecret.description: The issuance response of a tax ID transfer: the fields of `NifTransfer` PLUS the plaintext `secret`. This is the ONLY representation that carries it, and the only time it is ever returned — it is not stored in the clear, not even in the idempotency cache, so an idempotent replay of the issuance returns `secret: null`. If it is lost, revoke the transfer and issue another one.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the tax ID transfer, a UUID v7.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the NIF this transfer gives away.

status.description: Derived state against the clock.

recipient_account_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the ONLY account that can accept this transfer, or `null` when whoever holds the secret can accept it.

issued_at.description: When the transfer was issued (ISO 8601), or `null` when the instant is not recorded.

consumed_at.description: When the transfer was accepted (ISO 8601), or `null` while nobody accepted it. It does not say WHICH account accepted it.

revoked_at.description: When the issuing account revoked the transfer (ISO 8601), or `null` if it was not revoked.

secret.description: The plaintext secret, returned ONCE and never again. Treat it as a credential: anyone holding it can take the NIF (or only the recipient account, when one is set). `null` only in an idempotent replay of the issuance, because the secret is never stored.

NifTransferWithSecret.title: NifTransferWithSecret

NonInvoicedCharge.description: A Stripe charge that a charge rule left out of invoicing. No invoice or VERI*FACTU record is generated, but the charge is kept with its reason. The public `id` is the UUID v7; `transaction_id` (`pi_xxx`) is the external Stripe id.

id.description: UUID v7 of the record. Public identity (KEY `id`).

connected_account_id.description: UUID v7 of the connected account.

transaction_id.description: External Stripe id of the charge (`pi_xxx`). NOT an internal UUID nor a foreign key.

amount.description: Decimal string in major units of `currency`, at Stripe's decimal scale for that currency (3,000 JPY → `"3000"`, 30.00 EUR → `"30.00"`, 5.124 KWD → `"5.124"`), like every other v1 amount.

refunded_amount.description: Cumulative amount refunded by Stripe for this charge (succeeded and pending refunds), in the same format as `amount`. `0` if nothing has been refunded. It never exceeds `amount`, and it goes down if a pending refund later fails or is canceled.

net_amount.description: Net amount of the charge, what the merchant keeps: `amount` minus `refunded_amount`, in the same format as `amount`.

description.description: Charge description reported by Stripe, or `null`.

reason.description: Why the charge was not invoiced.

charge_rule_id.description: UUID v7 of the rule that decided it, or `null` if the rule was deleted afterwards.

refunded_at.description: When the most recent refund of the charge was recorded (ISO 8601), or `null` if nothing has been refunded.

NonInvoicedCharge.title: NonInvoicedCharge

Notification.description: An in-app notification of the member who owns the API key.

id.description: UUID v7 of the notification.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `notification` for this resource.

title.example: Te han asignado la tarea DEV-12

examples: Se te ha asignado la tarea DEV-12 «Integrar la pasarela de pago en el checkout».

status.description: Read status. Archived notifications are never returned.

entity_type.description: Type of the related resource, or `null`.

Notification.title: Notification

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `notification_counts` for this resource.

total.description: Notifications that are not archived.

NotificationCounts.title: NotificationCounts

NotificationList.description: Page of notifications (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`).

has_more.description: `true` when there are more objects after this page.

PaginatedList.description: Cursor-paginated list envelope shared by every v1 listing endpoint. `data` holds the page items; `has_more` signals whether another page exists; `next_cursor` is the cursor to pass back for the following page. Treat it as strictly opaque: send it through verbatim, never parse it and never assume a format — it is not the same across listings, and each listing documents its own cursor parameter. Concrete listings narrow `data` to their resource type via `allOf`.

data.description: Items on the current page.

has_more.description: Whether more pages are available after this one.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`. The example below shows the shape used by most listings; others return a different one, so pass the value back verbatim instead of validating it.

PaymentPreferences.description: Client payment preferences: preferred method and payment term in days.

method.description: Preferred payment method. If `direct_debit` or `sepa_direct_debit`, the client must have at least one bank account marked as default.

terms_days.description: Payment term in days (Net X). Valid range: 0-365.

PaymentPreferences.title: PaymentPreferences

PayrollExportFormat.description: A supported payroll software export format for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed catalog entry with no entity identity: it exposes the stable `value` and its commercial `label`, never an `id`.

value.description: Stable identifier of the payroll software (`a3`, `sage` or `nominasol`).

label.description: Human-readable commercial name of the payroll software (Spanish).

PayrollExportFormat.title: PayrollExportFormat

code.description: Stable error code of the retained output. A `failed` output carries `pdf_generation_failed`, `pdf_engine_profile_unavailable`, `pdf_image_resource_unavailable` or `pdf_payload_resource_unavailable`; an output erased for privacy carries `pdf_signature_personal_data_forgotten`. `pdf_generation_failed` is also the code of the 503 error returned by direct PDF download endpoints.

PdfArtifact.description: Closed 24-key artifact metadata. A preparation is not a published original. READY bytes are verified and privately read from this exact artifact. Privacy erasure preserves only safe retained metadata: state=unavailable, unavailable_reason=privacy_erased, error.code=pdf_signature_personal_data_forgotten, error.retryable=false and sensitive tokens/digests/download_url null. No public privacy_erased state, readiness flag, storage path, plan, HTML, engine identity or credentials.
PdfArtifact.title: PdfArtifact

PdfCapabilities.description: Read-only document branding capabilities of the effective account.
PdfCapabilities.title: PdfCapabilities

logo_dark_asset_id.description: Version of the logo for dark backgrounds (asset of kind `logo`); requires `logo_asset_id`.

brand_image_dark_asset_id.description: Version of the brand image for dark backgrounds (asset of kind `imago`); requires `brand_image_asset_id`.

dark_background_fallback.description: On a dark background, without a dark version and when the brand does not contrast: a white silhouette (`silhouette`, default) or the light plate (`plate`).

brand_size.description: Default brand size, used by templates whose `branding.size` is `inherit` (default `medium`).

logo_dark_asset_id.description: Optional. Logo version for dark backgrounds; requires `logo_asset_id`.

brand_image_dark_asset_id.description: Optional. Brand image version for dark backgrounds; requires `brand_image_asset_id`.

PdfPreviewCommercialIdentitySelector.description: Only example supports this closed selector. Omitted or null means inherit; inherit has no IDs. exact_revision requires both retained IDs. draft requires all seven nullable keys and library administrator authority; it never saves or publishes a brand or asserts continuity.
PdfPreviewCommercialIdentitySelector.title: PdfPreviewCommercialIdentitySelector

exemption_reason.description: Invoice exemption cause of the header (`GET /v1/tax-catalog` publishes the catalogue). Optional: omitting it or sending `null` previews the invoice without a cause. When set, its legal mention opens the automatic legal mentions of the preview, exactly as it does when the invoice is saved. Only for `document_type` `invoice`. The preview does not reject a cause that contradicts the VAT of the lines; saving the invoice does (422 `exemption_cause_contradicts_taxed_lines`).

line_type.description: Kind of line. Null is treated as NORMAL.

base_unit_code.description: Optional. UN/ECE code of the measure unit the line is based on (`KGM`, `LTR`, …), shown next to `base_quantity`. Omit it or send null when the line has none.

base_quantity.description: Optional. Quantity of the line expressed in its base unit: a decimal string with at most 4 decimals and the same sign as the line quantity (negative only on a corrective invoice that is not a substitution). Omit it or send null when the line has none.

counted_quantity.description: Optional. Informative pieces of a variable-measure line counted in pieces: a decimal string greater than 0 with at most 4 decimals. It never changes the amounts of the line. Omit it or send null when the line is not counted in pieces.

counted_unit_code.description: Optional. UN/ECE code of the count unit of `counted_quantity` (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack, …). Omit it or send null when `counted_quantity` is not sent.

transport_weight.description: Gross weight of the line for a delivery note; accepted only when the previewed document is a delivery note. Omit it or send null when the line carries no transport weight.

unit_gross_weight_kg.description: Gross weight in kilograms of one unit: greater than zero, at most 9999999999.9999, and only for a physical product. Null when it is unknown.

PdfPreviewForm.description: Unsaved closed form. No owner, line or instalment identity is created; row_key is only local UI identity. Currency strings are exact decimals, never JSON numbers. Null is known absence; ordered custom fields retain duplicates.
PdfPreviewForm.title: PdfPreviewForm

line_uuids.description: Same length and order as `source_invoice_uuids`; values must be unique, so at most one entry may be null.

PdfPreviewInvoiceSubstitutionSource.description: Detached preview of a simplified-invoice substitution. Only valid with `document_type: invoice`, `purpose: complete` and `format: a4`; the visual triple (`base_preset`, `layout_version`, `configuration`) must be omitted entirely, otherwise the request returns 422 `pdf_presentation_invalid`. Nothing is persisted or substituted.
PdfPreviewInvoiceSubstitutionSource.title: PdfPreviewInvoiceSubstitutionSource

PdfPreviewPresentationRevisionSource.description: Exact retained parent, authentic current owner UUID, explicit nullable target, captured/current_legal policy and positive integer CAS. The returned revision_precondition token authorizes only an explicit Revise; it cannot authorize issue, send, accept or sign.
PdfPreviewPresentationRevisionSource.title: PdfPreviewPresentationRevisionSource

size.description: Brand size. `inherit` (default for new templates) uses the `brand_size` of the commercial identity; without one, `medium`. Sizes are optical areas of the ink. `xl` (schema_version 2 only) is the largest size, for wide logos.

body.description: Text size of the document body (parties, fields, notes): `s` = 0.9x, `m` = 1x (default), `l` = 1.1x of the base font size.

lines.description: Text size of the lines table: `s` = 0.9x, `m` = 1x (default), `l` = 1.1x.

legal.description: Text size of the legal footer, register text and fiscal QR captions: `s` = 0.9x, `m` = 1x (default), `l` = 1.1x.

zone_scale.description: Schema_version 2 only. Text size per zone of the document, relative to `font_size`.

highlight.description: Schema_version 2 only. Color of the highlighted texts (document title and number, section labels and total): `brand` (default) uses `colors.primary` and `ink` uses `colors.text`. It does not require the advanced editor: the Essential plan can change it, like `colors.primary`.

primary.description: Brand color. Together with `typography.highlight` it is the only color option the Essential plan can change without the advanced editor; changing any other color (`secondary`, `text`, `line`, `table_header_bg`, `table_border`, `alternate_row`, `surface`) returns 403 `feature_not_available_in_plan` there, and the server never derives them from `primary`.

surface.description: Schema_version 2 only. Color of the decorative surface of the design, `null` by default: the side strip of `premium` (`null` follows `colors.primary`) and the dark frame of `corporative` (`null` uses its dark `#0c111d`). The other designs ignore it. Secondary texts always use the neutral gray `colors.secondary`. Layout option: it requires the advanced editor.

density.description: Schema_version 2 only. `compact` reduces vertical spacing so that short documents fit on one page; `standard` (default) keeps the template spacing.

titles.description: Document subtitle per document type and language. Besides plain text it may use the tokens `{status}`, `{reference}`, `{title}` and `{number}`, replaced when the document is rendered; a token with no value is removed together with its orphan separators and an unknown brace expression is kept literally. Any language key is accepted and tokens are not validated.

columns.description: Columns of the lines table, in print order; the list is replaced as a whole. `description` cannot be hidden. The `sku` column is only printed on the pro forma (catalog code); on the other documents it is not printed even when visible, and the SKU appears only with `table.concept_mode` `combined`.

notes_mode.description: Document notes: `auto` prints them when the document has notes and `no` hides them. `yes` is still accepted and behaves exactly like `auto`.

footer_text.description: Text per language; the document language is used and, when it is empty, `es`.

conditions_text.description: Text per language; the document language is used and, when it is empty, `es`.

commercial_register_text.description: Text per language; the document language is used and, when it is empty, `es`.

privacy_text.description: Schema_version 2 only. Data protection text per language (plain text, up to 5000 characters), printed in small type after the notes and conditions and just before the commercial register text; only the document language is used, with no fallback to another language, so when that language is empty nothing is printed.

general_terms.description: Schema_version 2 only. General terms and conditions per language (plain text, up to 20000 characters; line breaks are kept), printed in two columns after the totals or on an annex page according to `general_terms_placement`; only the document language is used, with no fallback to another language, so when that language is empty no general terms are printed.

general_terms_placement.description: Schema_version 2 only. Where the general terms are printed: `after_totals` (default) right after the totals and `annex_page` on their own page at the end.

show_generic_privacy_notice.description: Schema_version 2 only. Whether the generic RGPD notice that an invoice to a natural person adds to its legal mentions is printed in the PDF and on the public link. It is not mandatory on the invoice. It is never printed when the template has its own `privacy_text` for the document language. Default `false` in a new template; `true` in a template imported from the previous settings and when a stored revision does not carry the key. Fiscal mentions (exemption, reverse charge, cash-basis regime) and the user's own literals are always printed. Available on every plan.

notes.description: Whether the «Notes» title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

conditions.description: Whether the «Conditions» title (both the document conditions and the template conditions) is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

payment.description: Whether the «Payment information» title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

custom_fields.description: Whether the «Additional information» (custom fields) title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

references.description: Whether the «Business references» and administrative-centres titles is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

general_terms.description: Whether the «General terms and conditions of the invoice» title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

legal_mentions.description: Whether the «Legal mentions» title is printed (default false in a new template; a stored revision without the key reads as true). `false` prints the mentions without their title; the mentions themselves are always printed.

section_titles.description: Schema_version 2 only. Hides the title of the optional blocks and leaves only their text; all `true` by default except `legal_mentions` (`false` in a new template). It never hides legal or fiscal notices (corrective and simplified invoice notices, the tax QR block, the ticket «Register»). Changing it requires the advanced template editor: without it the call answers 403 `feature_not_available_in_plan`, and an unedited plan prints every title.

layout.description: Header layout. `preset` (default) keeps the header of the base template; `executive` splits issuer and document data; `beside_logo` places the document title and dates to the left, next to the logo; `centered` centers logo, title and dates.

logo_side.description: Side of the logo in the header (default `left`). `right` mirrors the layout: the logo goes to the other side and the title and dates to the opposite one. Ignored when `layout` is `centered`. Layout option: it requires the advanced editor, like the rest of the `header` keys.

row_style.description: Row style of the lines table: `preset` (default) keeps the one of the base template, `rules` draws a rule under each row, `zebra` alternates the row background and `none` draws no separators.

concept_mode.description: Concept column: `separate` (default) shows SKU and description in their own columns; `combined` prints the SKU in bold above the description.

show_line_descriptions.description: Whether the additional description of each line (the grey line under the concept) is printed. Default `true`; `false` hides it in the PDF while the concept, variant, presentation and catalog detail stay. Part of the advanced editor: changing it requires a plan that includes it (403 `feature_not_available_in_plan` otherwise).

mode.description: Where the register and footer texts are printed: `last_page` (default) after the general terms at the bottom of the last page, `every_page` in a footer repeated on every page and `body` at the end of the document body.

notices_placement.description: Schema_version 2 only. Where the legal mentions and the data protection text are printed: `after_content` (default) right after the lines and totals, `page_bottom` anchored to the bottom of the last page of the document, before the general terms annex when they are on their own page. When the anchored block would exceed about 60 mm it is printed after the content instead and the editor preview reports `legal_notices_not_anchored`; the ticket never anchors. The footer and register texts keep following `mode`. Available on every plan.

PdfTemplateConfiguration.description: Structured template configuration. A schema_version 1 revision carries only the original keys; a schema_version 2 revision adds `header`, `table`, `legal_footer`, `page.density`, `typography.zone_scale`, `sections.privacy_text`, `sections.general_terms`, `sections.general_terms_placement`, `sections.section_titles`, `sections.show_generic_privacy_notice` and `legal_footer.notices_placement`, plus the `xl` brand size and the `total_with_tax` column. The new keys are absent from a schema_version 1 revision when read. Plain text only; description column remains visible. Fiscal content is enforced by the document renderer.
PdfTemplateConfiguration.title: PdfTemplateConfiguration

size.description: Brand size. `inherit` (default for new templates) uses the `brand_size` of the commercial identity; without one, `medium`. Sizes are optical areas of the ink. `xl` (schema_version 2 only) is the largest size, for wide logos.

body.description: Text size of the document body (parties, fields, notes): `s` = 0.9x, `m` = 1x (default), `l` = 1.1x of the base font size.

lines.description: Text size of the lines table: `s` = 0.9x, `m` = 1x (default), `l` = 1.1x.

legal.description: Text size of the legal footer, register text and fiscal QR captions: `s` = 0.9x, `m` = 1x (default), `l` = 1.1x.

zone_scale.description: Schema_version 2 only. Text size per zone of the document, relative to `font_size`.

highlight.description: Schema_version 2 only. Color of the highlighted texts (document title and number, section labels and total): `brand` (default) uses `colors.primary` and `ink` uses `colors.text`. It does not require the advanced editor: the Essential plan can change it, like `colors.primary`.

primary.description: Brand color. Together with `typography.highlight` it is the only color option the Essential plan can change without the advanced editor; changing any other color (`secondary`, `text`, `line`, `table_header_bg`, `table_border`, `alternate_row`, `surface`) returns 403 `feature_not_available_in_plan` there, and the server never derives them from `primary`.

surface.description: Schema_version 2 only. Color of the decorative surface of the design, `null` by default: the side strip of `premium` (`null` follows `colors.primary`) and the dark frame of `corporative` (`null` uses its dark `#0c111d`). The other designs ignore it. Secondary texts always use the neutral gray `colors.secondary`. Layout option: it requires the advanced editor.

density.description: Schema_version 2 only. `compact` reduces vertical spacing so that short documents fit on one page; `standard` (default) keeps the template spacing.

titles.description: Document subtitle per document type and language. Besides plain text it may use the tokens `{status}`, `{reference}`, `{title}` and `{number}`, replaced when the document is rendered; a token with no value is removed together with its orphan separators and an unknown brace expression is kept literally. Any language key is accepted and tokens are not validated.

columns.description: Columns of the lines table, in print order; the list is replaced as a whole. `description` cannot be hidden. The `sku` column is only printed on the pro forma (catalog code); on the other documents it is not printed even when visible, and the SKU appears only with `table.concept_mode` `combined`.

notes_mode.description: Document notes: `auto` prints them when the document has notes and `no` hides them. `yes` is still accepted and behaves exactly like `auto`.

oneOf.description: Legacy form: a plain string is equivalent to `{"es": "<text>", "en": null, "ca": null}`.
Text per language (partial object; omitted languages are kept).
Legacy form: a plain string is equivalent to `{"es": "<text>", "en": null, "ca": null}`.
Text per language (partial object; omitted languages are kept).
Legacy form: a plain string is equivalent to `{"es": "<text>", "en": null, "ca": null}`.
Text per language (partial object; omitted languages are kept).

privacy_text.description: Schema_version 2 only. Data protection text per language (plain text, up to 5000 characters), printed in small type after the notes and conditions and just before the commercial register text; only the document language is used, with no fallback to another language, so when that language is empty nothing is printed.

general_terms.description: Schema_version 2 only. General terms and conditions per language (plain text, up to 20000 characters; line breaks are kept), printed in two columns after the totals or on an annex page according to `general_terms_placement`; only the document language is used, with no fallback to another language, so when that language is empty no general terms are printed.

general_terms_placement.description: Schema_version 2 only. Where the general terms are printed: `after_totals` (default) right after the totals and `annex_page` on their own page at the end.

show_generic_privacy_notice.description: Schema_version 2 only. Whether the generic RGPD notice that an invoice to a natural person adds to its legal mentions is printed in the PDF and on the public link. It is not mandatory on the invoice. It is never printed when the template has its own `privacy_text` for the document language. Default `false` in a new template; `true` in a template imported from the previous settings and when a stored revision does not carry the key. Fiscal mentions (exemption, reverse charge, cash-basis regime) and the user's own literals are always printed. Available on every plan.

notes.description: Whether the «Notes» title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

conditions.description: Whether the «Conditions» title (both the document conditions and the template conditions) is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

payment.description: Whether the «Payment information» title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

custom_fields.description: Whether the «Additional information» (custom fields) title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

references.description: Whether the «Business references» and administrative-centres titles is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

general_terms.description: Whether the «General terms and conditions of the invoice» title is printed (default true). `false` prints the block without its title and keeps its text or rows.

legal_mentions.description: Whether the «Legal mentions» title is printed (default false in a new template; a stored revision without the key reads as true). `false` prints the mentions without their title; the mentions themselves are always printed.

logo_side.description: Side of the logo in the header (default `left`). `right` mirrors the layout: the logo goes to the other side and the title and dates to the opposite one. Ignored when `layout` is `centered`. Layout option: it requires the advanced editor, like the rest of the `header` keys.

PdfTemplateConfigurationChanges.description: Partial structured template configuration: only the sections and fields to change, merged over the stored configuration. A write always stores the revision as schema_version 2: the new keys you omit take their default values (`preset`, `separate`, `body`, `standard`, `m`, empty texts, `after_totals`), which render exactly like a schema_version 1 configuration. Plain text only; description column remains visible. Fiscal content is enforced by the document renderer.
PdfTemplateConfigurationChanges.title: PdfTemplateConfigurationChanges

render_activation.description: Returns `legacy` while revisioned presentation is disabled for the company. Effective activation is projected at rollout; never accepted in PATCH.

schema_version.description: `1` for configurations saved before the layout options, `2` for those that carry `header`, `table` and `legal_footer`.

document_kind.description: Template kind: `commercial` (invoice, quote, pro forma and delivery note) or `transport-document` (transport control document, DeCA). It is fixed at creation and never changes. Defaults to `commercial` when omitted on create and returned on every template and revision.

PhoneString.description: Permissive international phone number: optional `+`, digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses (6..20 characters).
PhoneString.title: PhoneString

PreparePdfArtifactRequest.description: Prepare this exact authorized capture using its owner, document and presentation UUIDs. `official` follows that capture; `alternative` changes only an authorized output format and never changes publication or head. The closed body accepts no caller-supplied company or actor and no write `If-Match`. Keep the raw body and idempotency key for an exact replay; a changed body under the same key returns 409. Preparation rechecks current source authority and CAS and does not import templates or substitute the latest presentation. Retained exact prepared/READY artifacts remain readable under their existing guards.
PreparePdfArtifactRequest.title: PreparePdfArtifactRequest

PreviewProductBaseUnitReplacementRequest.description:
Body of the base unit replacement preview: the new base unit, the equivalence between both units, an optional
price to confirm and one `keep` or `retire` decision per presentation of the product being replaced.

target_base_unit.description: Base unit of the new product. Only the nine measure units are accepted: a packaging unit (`XPK`, `XBX`…) can only be a presentation unit.

equivalence.description:
Units of the CURRENT base that equal ONE unit of the NEW base (moving from kg to g,
1 g = 0.001 kg, so `0.001`; from kg to count units, 1 unit = 0.5 kg gives `0.5`). Required
between a count unit and a measure unit; inside the same measure family it is calculated
and between two different measure families there is none.

base_price.description:
Base price of the new product per its base unit. Confirm it when the conversion loses
precision or there is no equivalence.

presentations.description: Decision per presentation of the product being replaced. Presentations you omit get the proposed decision.

id.description: Id (UUID v7) of a presentation of the product being replaced.

decision.description: `keep` moves the presentation to the new product; `retire` withdraws it.

PreviewProductBaseUnitReplacementRequest.title: PreviewProductBaseUnitReplacementRequest

entry_ids.description: Concrete time entries to invoice (mutually exclusive with `period`).

period.description: Period, by the start date of the entries (mutually exclusive with `entry_ids`).

grouping.description: How the invoice lines are grouped.

PreviewTaxReportV1Request.description: Compute the breakdown of a tax report without persisting any generation or file. Useful to show what is about to be declared before confirming. `303` and `347` are accepted as aliases of `modelo_303` and `modelo_347`, consistent with `POST /v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/303` and `POST /v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/347`.
PreviewTaxReportV1Request.title: PreviewTaxReportV1Request

PriceListItem.description: A price entry of a price list. Listing endpoints accept `?search=`, which filters and paginates server-side over the visible names of the target: product, variant, presentation, commercial combination and option values.

configuration_id.description: The stored commercial combination the entry is priced for. `null` when the entry targets the legacy product/variant/presentation crossing or a selection signature: the three ways of naming a target are mutually exclusive. On a withdrawn entry it is read from the frozen snapshot, never from the live catalog.

selection_signature.description: Canonical 64-hex signature of the normalized selection the entry is priced for, when it targets the selection itself instead of a stored combination. `null` otherwise. On a withdrawn entry it is read from the frozen snapshot, never from the live catalog.

status.description: Lifecycle of the entry. `retired` means a confirmed catalog deletion withdrew it: it keeps its price as history, is excluded from price resolution, client assignment and every statistic, and is never reactivated.

retirement_reason.description: Why the entry was withdrawn. `product_replaced` means the product was replaced by another one with a different base unit (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/base-unit-replacement`): the entry keeps its price as history and, when it was transferred, a new entry for the new product carries the converted price. `null` while the entry is active.

retirement_reason_label.description: Human-readable label of `retirement_reason`, in Spanish. `null` while the entry is active.

retired_target_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the target taken when the entry was withdrawn. It is read from the entry itself, never from the live catalog, so it still describes the entry after the product is gone. `null` while the entry is active.

PriceListItem.title: PriceListItem

PriceListItemCollection.description: Cursor-paginated price entries. `has_more` and `next_cursor` are computed over the FILTERED set when `?search=` is supplied, not over the whole price list.
PriceListItemCollection.title: PriceListItemCollection

stock.description: Available stock quantity with four-decimal scale.

base_unit.description: UNECE base unit code. Only the nine measure units can be a base unit (`C62`, `KGM`, `GRM`, `LTR`, `MLT`, `MTR`, `MTK`, `HUR`, `DAY`); a packaging or count unit (`H87`, `XPK`, `XBX`…) can only be the unit of a presentation or a supplier offer. It cannot be edited once the product has history: see `base_unit_change` and `POST /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/base-unit-replacement`.

gross_weight_kg.description: Gross transport weight in kg per BASE unit (decimal string, up to 4 decimals, greater than 0), packaging included; `null` when unknown. Rejected with 422 `gross_weight_not_allowed` for services and for products whose base unit is a mass unit (`KGM`, `GRM`), where the weight is the quantity itself. A variant weight replaces it for that variant; a fixed presentation may declare its own weight per commercial unit.

manage_stock.description: Whether the product participates in document-driven stock movements (invoices, delivery notes). Requires the company `stock_management` module to be enabled. Defaults to `false`.

index.description: Position of the image in the gallery (0-based).

video.description: Product attached video, or `null` if there is none.

description.description: Free-text description of the product.
description.example: Vino tinto con Denominación de Origen Rioja, servido a granel en garrafa de 5 o 15 litros.
examples: Vino tinto con Denominación de Origen Rioja, servido a granel en garrafa de 5 o 15 litros.

tags.description: Product classification tags.

low_stock_threshold.description: Threshold below which stock is considered low, or `null` if not configured.

option_group_count.description: Number of option groups the product declares (active and inactive). Always reported, so a listing that omits `option_groups` for brevity never reads as a plain product.

configuration_count.description: Number of commercial combinations the product declares (active and inactive). Matches the size of `configurations` returned by the product detail.

catalog_availability_mode.description: `open` keeps the Cartesian product of active axes sellable; only configurations with `restricts_availability=true` constrain their own variant. `closed` treats all active configurations as the exact allow-list.

option_groups.description: Sellable option groups (finish, flavour, quality) with their values. Always an array; `[]` when the product declares none. Populated only when the caller asks for the configurable catalog.

configurations.description: Commercial configurations used for exact pricing and, depending on `catalog_availability_mode`, availability. In `open`, they do not restrict unless a row explicitly opts in. In `closed`, active rows form the exact allow-list; an empty active list means nothing is sellable.

is_low_stock.description: Indicates whether the current stock is below the configured threshold.

specifications.description: Structured technical specifications of the product (free key-value pairs). Empty object `{}` when there are no specifications.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this product to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, orthogonal to the catalog `sku` (a product may have both, neither, or either).

ProductActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a product. Groups domain events originated by changes to the product itself and by documents whose lines reference it (invoices, quotes, etc.).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: Se actualizó el precio base del producto.
examples: Se actualizó el precio base del producto.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID v7 of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

ProductActivity.title: ProductActivity

ProductConfiguration.description: A valid commercial combination of a product: an optional variant, an optional presentation and a canonical set of option values.

name.description: Visible label composed from variant + presentation + values. It is not a stored column: the historical name is frozen by the document line, not by the catalog. It is also the text the price-list `search` filter matches.
name.example: Superior · Garrafa de 5 L · Calidad: Superior
examples: Superior · Garrafa de 5 L · Calidad: Superior

signature.description: Canonical, order-independent signature of variant + presentation + option values. Unique per product.

commercial_price.description: FINAL price per commercial unit. When set it ALREADY absorbs the adjustments of its option values: they are not added again.

restricts_availability.description: Only used in `open` mode. When true, this row constrains the named variant; omitted presentation/options are wildcards. False means the row is pricing/identity only.

ProductConfiguration.title: ProductConfiguration

ProductConfigurationOption.description: One chosen option inside a commercial combination.
ProductConfigurationOption.title: ProductConfigurationOption

ProductOptionGroup.description: A group of sellable options of a product (finish, flavour, quality). Each group accepts a single value per line; multiple selection is out of scope.

required.description: Whether a value of this group must be chosen to confirm a line.

scope_id.description: Scope of the group: `null` means it applies to the whole product; when set, it is the id of a variant or a presentation of the same product and the group only takes part in selections including it.

ProductOptionGroup.title: ProductOptionGroup

ProductOptionValue.description: A selectable value inside an option group.

price_adjustment.description: Additive adjustment PER COMMERCIAL UNIT. `null` means "this value does not change the price", which is NOT the same as `"0.0000"`.

active.description: Whether the value is still selectable. An inactive value keeps naming historical document lines.

ProductOptionValue.title: ProductOptionValue

unit.description: UN/ECE code of the commercial unit of the presentation. The nine measure units can also be a base unit; the thirteen count and packaging units (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack, `XBX` box, …) are valid only here and in supplier offers. It must be expressible over the base unit of the product: a packaging unit needs a declared equivalence (`conversion_factor` or `nominal_base_quantity`), a measure unit must belong to the same family as the base; otherwise 422 `unit_not_expressible`.

gross_weight_kg.description: Own gross transport weight in kg per COMMERCIAL unit (decimal string, up to 4 decimals, greater than 0), packaging included; it overrides any derivation from the product or variant weight. `null` when the presentation declares none. Rejected with 422 `gross_weight_not_allowed` on `variable_measure` presentations.

commercial_price_override.description: Own price PER COMMERCIAL UNIT, or `null` when the presentation declares none. Orthogonal to `conversion_factor`, which converts QUANTITY and is never reused as a price multiplier: a 3.5 kg tub priced at 50.00 is worth 50.00 per tub.

specifications.description: Technical specifications OWN to this presentation (informational, not selectable). Empty object `{}` when there are none. The effective sheet combines product < variant < presentation and is composed by the aggregate.

ProductReplacementLink.description: The OTHER end of a base unit replacement: on `replaces`, the old product the current one replaced; on `replaced_by`, the new product that replaced the current one.

id.description: Id of the other product.

base_unit.description: Base unit of the other product.

equivalence.description: Old base units per ONE new base unit, decimal string with scale 6. `null` between measure families with no declared equivalence.

stock_transferred.description: Stock moved to the new product, decimal string with scale 4, ALWAYS in the unit of the NEW product.

ProductReplacementLink.title: ProductReplacementLink

units_sold.description: Exact quantity sold, represented as a decimal string.

total_revenue.description: Revenue of the product (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

ProductStats.description: Aggregated summary of the product catalog of the authenticated company: total, active, out of stock and low stock. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/products/stats`.

total_products.description: Total number of products registered in the company.

low_stock_count.description: Products whose stock is below the configured threshold.

ProductStats.title: ProductStats

gross_weight_kg.description: Own gross transport weight in kg per BASE unit (decimal string, up to 4 decimals, greater than 0) that replaces the product weight for this variant; `null` inherits the product weight. Rejected with 422 `gross_weight_not_allowed` when the product base unit is a mass unit.

specifications.description: Technical specifications OWN to this variant (informational, not selectable). Empty object `{}` when there are none. `base_price_override` stays PER BASE UNIT, unlike a presentation price, which is per commercial unit.

Proforma.description: A proforma invoice that can be converted to a final invoice.

status.description: Proforma lifecycle status (draft, accepted, rejected, cancelled, expired, converted).

price_list_id.description: UUID of the price list selected for this document.

price_list_name.description: Price-list name snapshot frozen on the document.

validity_days.description: Number of validity days of the proforma since its issuance. `null` if not applicable.

reference.description: Free reference of the document (e.g. the customer order number).

operation_regime.description: VAT operation regime of the proforma (`general`, `intracomunitaria`, `importacion_exportacion`, `isp`).

converted_to_id.description: UUID v7 of the invoice this proforma was converted into, if applicable.

converted_invoice_number.description: Human-readable number of the invoice this proforma was converted into (e.g. "F-2026-00042"). `null` if not converted.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on an expense the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

shipping_cost.description: Shipping cost, expressed WITH VAT INCLUDED, added to the amount to pay. It is not part of `subtotal`, `total_vat` or `total`. When the proforma is converted to an invoice it becomes a "Gastos de envío" line whose base is `shipping_cost / (1 + r)` with VAT `r`, so the invoice total equals `total_with_shipping`.

total_with_shipping.description: Final total including the shipping cost (= total + shipping_cost). The invoice generated from the proforma has exactly this total.

payment_method.description: Preferred payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

payment_terms_days.description: Payment term in days (Net X). Valid range: 0-365.

delivery_terms.example: Entrega en 5 dias habiles, portes incluidos
examples: Entrega en 5 dias habiles, portes incluidos

terms_and_conditions.description: Terms and conditions rendered in the proforma PDF.
terms_and_conditions.example: Validez 30 dias. Proforma sin valor fiscal hasta su conversion en factura.
examples: Validez 30 dias. Proforma sin valor fiscal hasta su conversion en factura.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

ProformaLine.description: A line item on a proforma.

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.
additional_description.example: Auditoría inicial e informe de mejoras

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal STRING with the 4-decimal scale of its column (e.g. `"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): it is returned exactly as it was accepted and stored, so reading a line and sending it back never changes its price. Derived amounts (`subtotal`, `taxes`, `total`) keep 2 decimals.

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

counted_quantity.description: Pieces the customer asked for on a variable-weight line sold by count (decimal string, scale 4, greater than 0), e.g. `"4.0000"` for four pieces weighing `quantity` kg in total. Informational: the line is charged and the stock is discounted by `quantity` (the real weight), never by the pieces. `null` on any other line. Only accepted on a `variable_measure` presentation whose unit is a count unit.

counted_unit.description: UN/ECE code of the count unit of `counted_quantity` (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack…). `null` exactly when `counted_quantity` is `null`.

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the resolved price: `per_base_unit` (product/variant own price, converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (presentation, combination or price-list entry, never converted). `null` on a line with no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string. Informational when an exact price already absorbed them.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the resolved price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined — the assembler refuses such a line with 422 rather than risking charging the adjustments twice, so `null` only ever reaches a reader on a legacy line with no configurable options at all.

ProvisionManagedAccountV1Request.description: Provision a managed account for one of your clients. Required: `external_ref` (your own reference, unique per provider: repeating it returns the same account), `plan` (`emprendedor`, `empresario` or `integral`), `tax_id` (Spanish tax ID) and `legal_name`. `access_level` is the level your account keeps on it (`none` by default). `owner_email` is required with a live key and whenever `send_email` is `true`; `send_email` is `false` by default, so the claim voucher comes back ONCE in the response for you to deliver. The rest of the fiscal profile (`display_name`, address, `language`) is optional. The provider is always the account of the key and never comes from the body; the environment of the new account is the one of the key.

expires_at.description: Expiration date/time of the link, or `null` if it does not expire.

Always returned (possibly `null`) by the `public-link` sub-resource; the `public_link` embedded in an invoice omits it.

PurchaseInvoice.description: An invoice received from a supplier.

external_invoice_number.description: The number assigned by the supplier on their invoice. `null` for a simplified expense ticket (`is_simplified`) with no supplier number.

is_simplified.description: Whether this is a simplified supplier invoice (expense ticket). When `true`, `supplier` and `external_invoice_number` may be `null`.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

internal_code.description: Optional internal code assigned by the company for its own classification.

received_on.description: Reception date of the invoice, or `null`.

taxes_total.description: VAT BORNE (IVA soportado) of this expense, WITHOUT surcharge and WITHOUT withholding. Careful: on the sales-side documents (invoice, delivery note, quote, proforma) the SAME field name carries the NET aggregate `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention` instead. Header invariant here (except for self-assessed `operation_class` `intracomunitaria` and `isp`, see `total`): `total === subtotal + taxes_total + total_surcharge − total_retention`. Read `total_vat` for a VAT figure whose meaning does not depend on the document family.

total_vat.description: Same VAT amount as `taxes_total`, published under the name the concept carries in the other four document families, so that the explicit identity `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention` holds across all five without knowing which resource produced the body.

total_retention.description: Aggregated IRPF withholding of the lines (Σ retention_amount). Header invariant: `total === subtotal + taxes_total + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_surcharge.description: Aggregated equivalence surcharge of the lines (Σ surcharge_amount). It adds to the total exactly like VAT does, so it is part of the header invariant above.

total.description: Total of the expense. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the one specific to this family, where `taxes_total` is the VAT alone - `total = subtotal + taxes_total + total_surcharge - total_retention`. Note that the aggregate shortcut of the sales-side families (`subtotal + taxes_total`) does NOT apply here: the same field name carries a different meaning on each side. Exception: when `operation_class` is `intracomunitaria` or `isp` the VAT is self-assessed (the supplier does not charge it), so it is NOT part of the total: `total = subtotal - total_retention + total_surcharge`, and `total_vat` / `taxes_total` still publish the self-assessed VAT amount.

paid_amount.description: Amount already paid against this expense (derived from the payment ledger). Satisfies the invariant `paid_amount + pending_amount === total`.

pending_amount.description: Outstanding balance pending payment for this expense (derived from the payment ledger).

payment_status.description: Derived payment status, NOT a persisted domain state (the model keeps 4 statuses). `overdue` derives from `pending` + `due_date < today` and prevails in presentation.

paid_recorded_at.description: Instant (ISO 8601 with offset) at which the payment that settled the purchase invoice was RECORDED in the ledger. `null` while it is not paid. Not the declared date: see `paid_date`.

paid_date.description: Declared payment date (YYYY-MM-DD). `null` while the purchase invoice is not paid. The input field of `mark-paid` and `payments` keeps the name `paid_on`.

payment_terms_days.description: Payment term days agreed with the supplier, or `null`.

bank_account.description: Supplier bank account. Always `null` in this version (accounts live embedded as JSON in `suppliers` without a stable identity). Follow-up `bridge-bank-account-cross-bc-supplier` will expose it as an object once Supplier promotes a read port.

expense_category_id.description: UUID v7 of the associated expense category, or `null`.

deductible_percentage.description: Deductible percentage of the input VAT (0–100), or `null` when not set.

operation_class.description: Operation class for the input VAT of Modelo 303. Defaults to `corriente`. `isp` (domestic reverse charge, Art. 84.Uno.2 LIVA) and `intracomunitaria` are self-assessed: the buyer declares both the output VAT and the deductible input VAT.

exclude_347.description: Declarative per-document flag: whether this expense is excluded from the annual Modelo 347 report.

is_reverse_charge.description: Indicates whether the invoice is subject to reverse charge.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

internal_notes.description: Internal notes not visible to the supplier, or `null`.

PurchaseInvoiceLine.description: A line item on an expense.

source_line_index.description: Zero-based ordinal of the line within this expense, in the stable read order. Send it back on create/update to keep a line matched to its historical counterpart (measures, units and frozen cost are preserved when the physical selection and the supplier do not change). It is NOT a primary key and it grants no access to any other document.

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.

quantity.description: Billed quantity. A measured purchase line (one carrying `purchase_measurement`) returns it as a 4-decimal STRING so no precision is lost; a legacy line keeps the numeric type it has always published.

unit_price.description: Cost per billed unit, always a decimal STRING with the 4-decimal scale of its column (e.g. `"7.4000"`, `"100.0000"`), on measured (carrying `purchase_measurement`), legacy and manual lines alike: it is returned exactly as it was accepted and stored, so reading a line and sending it back never changes its cost. Derived amounts keep 2 decimals.

discount_percent.description: Discount percentage applied to the line (0-100) BEFORE any tax. `subtotal` is already net of it, so `unit_price` multiplied by `quantity` does NOT equal `subtotal` on a discounted line. Default 0.

confirmed_base_quantity.description: Real measured quantity in the base unit, as a decimal string, for a variable-measure presentation (weighed goods). `null` when the line does not require one. It is reconstructed from the stored base quantity, never recomputed against the live catalog.

purchase_measurement.description: Measured-purchase block. `null` on a legacy or manual line, which keeps its previous `quantity` × `unit_price` semantics. On write only `package_quantity` and `cost_basis` are accepted; the remaining fields are DERIVED by the server and are never taken from the client.

package_quantity.description: Physical number of packages/presentations received, as a decimal string (e.g. `"3.0000"` boxes). `null` when the purchase is not counted in packages — it means neither one nor zero.

billing_quantity.description: Derived. Billed quantity expressed in `billing_unit_code` (e.g. `"6.0000"` kg for three 2 kg boxes).

billing_unit_code.description: Derived. UN/ECE code of the unit the cost applies to (`KGM`, `LTR`, `C62`, …).

billing_conversion_factor.description: Derived. Factor, at scale 6, between the billing unit and the base unit of the product.

unit_cost.description: Derived. Cost per billing unit, as a decimal string (e.g. `"7.4000"` per kg). A confirmed `"0.0000"` is a free line, not an unknown cost.

cost_basis.description: Which unit the cost is quoted in: the supplier offer unit (requires an applicable offer), the product base unit (factor 1, manual cost) or a fixed presentation (manual cost per presentation).

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the supplier (0–100). Default 0.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage paid to the retail supplier (0–100). Default 0. Only the legal VAT-surcharge pairs are accepted (21→5.2, 10→1.4, 4→0.5).

retention_amount.description: Withholding amount of the line (`subtotal * retention_rate / 100`). The line total follows `subtotal + taxes − retention_amount + surcharge_amount`.

surcharge_amount.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line (`subtotal * surcharge_rate / 100`). Default 0.

vat_deductible.description: Whether the line VAT is deductible. It does not change the amount paid, but a `false` line is excluded from the deductible input VAT of Modelo 303 (boxes [28]-[37]).

exemption_reason.description: LIVA exemption cause (E1–E6) or non-subjection cause (N1/N2) declared for this line, or null when the line does not declare one.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime override of the supplier line: `iva`/`igic`/`ipsi` when set per-document (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null`. Writable on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the frozen price: `per_base_unit` (converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (never converted). `null` when the line carries no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the frozen price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined.
