PurchaseInvoicePayment.description: A single payment recorded against a purchase invoice (payment ledger entry). Listed by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/purchase-invoices/{purchase_invoice}/payments` and returned by `POST` on the same path.

id.description: Opaque UUID v7 of the payment.

object.description: String identifying the object type. Always `purchase_invoice_payment`.

amount.description: Payment amount as a string with two decimal places (Stripe-style).

paid_date.description: Payment date (YYYY-MM-DD). Renamed from `paid_on`, which is no longer emitted; the INPUT field of `POST` keeps the old name on purpose.

payment_method.description: Payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

bank_account_id.description: Internal bank account the payment was settled into, or `null`.

reference.description: Payment reference/operation number. `null` if not provided.

notes.description: Internal notes for the payment. `null` if not provided.

is_reversed.description: Whether the payment has been reverted. A reverted payment stays in the ledger but stops counting towards `paid_amount`/`pending_amount` — read this flag, do not infer the state from absence.

reversed_at.description: When the payment was reverted (ISO 8601), or `null` while it is in force.

reversal_reason.description: Reason the payment was reverted, from the closed catalog. `null` while the payment is in force.

reversal_reason_text.description: Human-readable label of the reversal reason (Spanish), or `null`.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on an expense the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Sum of VAT (IVA) across all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of withholding (IRPF/retention) across all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) across all lines.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal STRING with the 4-decimal scale of its column (e.g. `"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): it is returned exactly as it was accepted and stored, so reading a line and sending it back never changes its price. Derived amounts (`subtotal`, `taxes`, `total`) keep 2 decimals.

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

counted_quantity.description: Pieces the customer asked for on a variable-weight line sold by count (decimal string, scale 4, greater than 0), e.g. `"4.0000"` for four pieces weighing `quantity` kg in total. Informational: the line is charged and the stock is discounted by `quantity` (the real weight), never by the pieces. `null` on any other line. Only accepted on a `variable_measure` presentation whose unit is a count unit.

counted_unit.description: UN/ECE code of the count unit of `counted_quantity` (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack…). `null` exactly when `counted_quantity` is `null`.

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the resolved price: `per_base_unit` (product/variant own price, converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (presentation, combination or price-list entry, never converted). `null` on a line with no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string. Informational when an exact price already absorbed them.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the resolved price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined — the assembler refuses such a line with 422 rather than risking charging the adjustments twice, so `null` only ever reaches a reader on a legacy line with no configurable options at all.

send_automatically.description: Compatibility field DERIVED from `generation_mode`: `true` if and only if `generation_mode` is `issue_and_send` (each generated invoice is issued and emailed to `email_to`). On write, without an explicit `generation_mode`, `true` still means `issue_and_send` and `false` means `draft`; when both are sent and contradict each other the request is rejected with 422.

generation_mode.description: What each run of the recurrence does with the invoice it generates: `draft` leaves it as a draft (no definitive number); `issue` issues it (definitive number, VeriFactu record, stock movements) without emailing it, so it stays `is_sent = false`; `issue_and_send` issues it and emails it to the configured recipients, and it is marked as sent once the mail server accepts the email (if the delivery fails the invoice stays issued and not sent). Available in every API version. `send_automatically` is derived from it.

occurrences_count.description: Number of invoices already generated by this recurrence.

remaining_occurrences.description: Invoices remaining until `max_occurrences` is reached. `null` when there is no limit.

holiday_handling.description: Adjustment policy when the run date falls on a holiday/weekend (e.g. `none`, `next_business_day`, `previous_business_day`).

cancelled_at.description: When the recurrence was cancelled (irreversible terminal state). `null` if not cancelled.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total. It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 - read `total_vat` for that. These amounts are a PREVIEW aggregated from the template lines (the recurrence persists no header totals), rounded per line exactly as the invoice it will issue stores them.

total_vat.description: Output VAT (IVA repercutido) the recurrence will accrue: sum of the VAT of its template lines. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 303 declares, and it is NOT recoverable from `taxes_total`, which nets the withholding out.

total_retention.description: Withholding (retencion de IRPF) the recurrence will apply: sum of the withholding of its template lines, as a POSITIVE amount that SUBTRACTS from the total. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 130/111 declares. It is ALREADY netted out inside `taxes_total`, so do not subtract it again.

total_surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) of the template lines. It ADDS to the total exactly like VAT does, and is ALREADY included inside `taxes_total`.

total.description: Total the recurrence will invoice. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the six document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

send_automatically.description: Compatibility field DERIVED from `generation_mode`: `true` if and only if `generation_mode` is `issue_and_send`, in which case each generated invoice is emailed to `recipients`.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the frozen price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined.

RegisterCompanyRepresentationV1Request.description: Register the representation that authorizes Factuarea to remit your VeriFactu records to AEAT on your behalf. Send `multipart/form-data`: `kind`, `signer_name`, `signer_tax_id` and `granted_on` are required, plus the evidence — `document` (PDF, up to 5 MB) for the signed annex I, and `document` or `power_of_attorney_reference` for a power of attorney. The optional `valid_until` sets the last day of validity: without it the representation does not expire. An active representation that already exists is revoked and kept in the history.

kind.description: Kind of representation: `social_collaboration_annex_i` (social collaboration, with the signed annex I of the Resolution of 18-12-2024) or `aeat_power_of_attorney` (a power of attorney registered with AEAT).

signer_name.description: Name of the person who signed the authorization.

granted_on.description: Date on which the authorization was granted (YYYY-MM-DD). It cannot be in the future.

valid_until.description: Last day of validity of the representation (YYYY-MM-DD), optional: without it the representation does not expire. It cannot be earlier than `granted_on` nor more than 5 years after it (power of attorney registered in the AEAT register, art. 6.4 of Law 39/2015); otherwise 422 with `param=valid_until`. Once the day has passed the representation is reported with `is_expired: true` and stops enabling third-party remission.

power_of_attorney_reference.description: Reference of the power of attorney in the AEAT register. For a power of attorney, send this or the `document`.

document.description: Signed evidence as a PDF (up to 5 MB, validated by magic bytes): required for the annex I, and for a power of attorney when no `power_of_attorney_reference` is sent. It is custodied encrypted, counts against your storage quota and is never returned.

ReviseDocumentPresentationRequest.description: Create a new retained capture only from an authentic `presentation_revision` preview of the exact parent. Use that preview source token, fingerprint, owner identity and positive expected-version CAS; a token is valid only for explicit Revise and never issues, sends, accepts or signs. `captured` preserves the parent's legal source and QR; `current_legal` refreshes only the authorized invoice legal source. A null target template inherits the parent's selection. Omitted locale, purpose and format inherit from the parent. If-Match cannot replace revision context. The body accepts no arbitrary parties, visual configuration, tenant or document type. Preview visual input for persisted documents and revisions must be fully omitted or provide all three root fields; partial or explicit-null triples fail 422 and a different supplied root fails the exact-root guard. Source, purpose, format and locale are required on preview, not on this revision action. Initialization pending returns recoverable 422 `pdf_presentation_not_ready` (`invalid_request_error`): preserve data and complete authorized tenant initialization; GET/preview never import. A CLI is optional for the owner, not a manual client step.

If the client has no email and `to` is absent, it returns 422 `missing_required_param`. Presentation precondition fields (`expected_selection_version`, `expected_source_token`, `expected_preview_context_fingerprint`, `expected_template_revision_id`, `expected_commercial_identity_revision_id`, `purpose`, `format`) only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored. Series.description: A document numbering series. It can be edited with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/series/{series}` under the fiscal guards of the numbering (code, mask and purpose are fixed once documents exist) and it is never deleted: archive it instead.

id.description: Public series UUID v7.

document_type.description: Document type the series numbers: `invoice`, `quote`, `delivery_note`, `proforma` or `transport_document` (transport control documents, default code `DC`, created on the first issuance).

invoice_kind.description: Fixed purpose of an invoice series (RD 1619/2012 arts. 6.1.a, 7.1.a and 15): `complete` (complete invoices `F1` and the `F3` that replaces simplified invoices — the usual series), `simplified` (simplified invoices `F2`), `corrective` (corrective invoices `R1`–`R4`) or `simplified_corrective` (corrective invoices of simplified invoices `R5`). An invoice can only be issued in a series of its own purpose, otherwise issuing fails with `series_invoice_kind_mismatch`. Set on creation (default `complete`), editable with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/series/{series}` until the series has any invoice (`series_invoice_kind_locked`) and never on the default series of its purpose (`series_default_kind_change`). `null` for series of other document types.

pdf_template_id.description: Saved tenant-template UUID v7, or null to inherit. Kept even if the saved template later becomes unavailable.

pdf_template_version.description: Independent visual association version; fiscal-only edits do not increment it.

prefix.description: Legacy alias for code. Use code field. Will be removed in v2.

number_format.description: Canonical numbering mask describing how the document number is rendered: padding (the block of zeros), year token (`{YYYY}` 4 digits / `{YY}` 2 digits / omitted for no year), optional month token (`{MM}` 2 digits) and separator. Example: `{code}-{YYYY}-{000}` (default) or `{code}-{YYYY}-{00000}` for 5-digit padding. When `counter_reset` is `monthly`, the mask must include the `{MM}` token (e.g. `F-{YYYY}-{MM}-{000}`) so the rendered number stays unique across months; otherwise two months would both start at `1`. Set on creation and editable with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/series/{series}` until the first document is issued; fixed afterwards (`series_format_immutable_with_documents`). Mirrors Holded's `format`.

next_number.description: Next correlative that will be assigned on the next real emission.

current_number.description: Last correlative actually emitted in the current fiscal year (0 for a brand-new series).

initial_number.description: Number the counter starts from. Set on creation to continue an existing numbering when migrating (e.g. 235). Defaults to 1. It can be changed with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/series/{series}` as long as it does not open a gap after documents of the current year (`series_initial_number_creates_gap`) and no record of the series has been accepted by AEAT.

counter_reset.description: Counter reset policy (source of truth): `never` (the counter never resets), `annual` (resets on January 1st) or `monthly` (resets on the 1st of each month). `monthly` requires the `number_format` mask to include the `{MM}` token to keep rendered numbers unique across months.

year_reset.description: Deprecated alias of `counter_reset`. `true` is equivalent to `counter_reset: "annual"`, `false` to `counter_reset: "never"`. Use `counter_reset` instead; this field will be removed in v2.

ShopifyConnectionCheck.description: The outcome of testing the connection with one of your connected Shopify stores. The public `id` is the UUID v7 of the STORE that was tested, so you can tell which shop this diagnosis is about. Nothing is stored: this resource is a diagnosis, not a record. Read `reachable` and `credential_accepted` together — `reachable: false` means the shop did not answer, while `reachable: true` with `credential_accepted: false` means it answered and rejected the access token — and read `failure_code` for the concrete cause, which is what tells «your token is no longer valid» apart from «the Admin API version we speak has expired».

id.description: UUID v7 of the store that was tested. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `shopify_connection_check` for this resource.

reachable.description: Whether the shop answered at all. `false` covers a timeout, a transport failure, a 5xx from Shopify, an exhausted query cost budget and a destination your company has not authorised for outbound traffic.

credential_accepted.description: Whether the shop accepted the stored access token. Always `false` when `reachable` is `false`: we never got to ask.

store_version.description: The Shopify plan the shop reports, or `null` when it does not report one. Shopify publishes no «store version»; the plan display name is the closest equivalent it exposes. Informational: nothing is gated on it.

api_version.description: The pinned Admin API version this connector talked to the shop with (`YYYY-MM`), or `null` when it could not be resolved. It is OUR pin, not something the shop reports: Shopify serves whatever version you ask for and, once yours expires, silently falls forward to the oldest stable one with HTTP 200. Read it together with `supported_until`.

supported_until.description: The date the pinned Admin API version is supported until (ISO 8601 date), or `null` when there is no version to ask about or the version is not in our calendar. This is the field to watch: when an Admin API version expires Shopify does not fail, it answers 200 with the fields of another version, so the breakage is silent and shows up as data quietly going missing.

failure_code.description: Code naming the concrete cause when the check did not succeed, or `null` when it did. Today `shopify_store_unreachable` (the shop did not answer, or the query cost budget was exhausted — the only one worth retrying), `shopify_credentials_rejected` (the shop rejected the access token, or there was none to use), `shopify_api_version_expired` (the pinned Admin API version is no longer served) and `store_url_not_allowed` (your company has not authorised that destination for outbound traffic). Not an exhaustive enumeration: new causes may appear without a breaking change, so treat an unknown value as a failure you cannot classify.

checked_at.description: When the check ran (ISO 8601). Nothing is cached: every call tests the shop again.

SignDeliveryNoteRequest.description: Sign a delivery note on receipt. Required: `signed_by` (name of the person who receives it, at most 120 characters), `recipient_dni` (Spanish DNI/NIE of the signer) and `signature_image_base64` (the signature as a raw base64 PNG, without the `data:` prefix). Optional: `signed_at` (ISO 8601) is deprecated and ignored: it is still accepted so existing clients keep working, but the signature date is always set by the server. A signature image that cannot be decoded or is too large returns 422 `invalid_param_format` or `payload_too_large`.

signed_by.description: Name of the person who receives the delivery note (at most 120 characters).

signed_at.description: Deprecated and ignored: accepted only for compatibility with existing clients. The signature date is always set by the server.

expected_presentation_id.description: UUID of the retained presentation of the delivery note that the signature is bound to. Part of the exact presentation context, which is all-or-nothing: when any of the five `expected_*` fields is sent, all except `expected_publication_id` are required, and the request must carry an `Idempotency-Key` header with a UUID v7. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

expected_publication_id.description: UUID of the publication the signature is bound to, or null when the presentation has none. Optional member of the exact presentation context (all-or-nothing with the other `expected_*` fields). It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

expected_external_version.description: Positive external version of the presentation the signature is bound to. Required together with the rest of the exact presentation context. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

expected_source_token.description: Source token of the reviewed presentation: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Required together with the rest of the exact presentation context. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

expected_artifact_id.description: UUID of the exact PDF artifact the recipient reviewed before signing. Required together with the rest of the exact presentation context. It only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

SignDeliveryNoteRequest.title: SignDeliveryNoteRequest

StartConnectedAccountAuthorizationV1Requ.description: Start the Stripe Connect authorization of a company. `return_url` is required: an absolute `https` URL (up to 2048 characters, no credentials, no fragment, port 443 or none) whose host is one of the return domains of the account of the credential. Any other key in the body or the query returns 400 `parameter_unknown`.

return_url.description: HTTPS URL the person is sent back to when Stripe finishes (up to 2048 characters). Its host must be one of the return domains of the account of the credential, otherwise the request returns 422 `connect_return_url_not_allowed`. Factuarea appends these query parameters on the way back: `status` (`success` or `error`), `provider` (always `stripe`) and `authorization_id` always; on success also `company_id` (the company `id`, UUID v7), `connected_account_id` and `account`; on error also `error` and, when there is one, `error_subcode`.

StockMovement.description: One row of the append-only stock ledger of a product, from the most recently applied movement to the oldest. Lets an integration audit and reconcile inventory instead of only seeing the current balance.

delta.description: Signed change in BASE units, decimal string with scale 4. Positive = stock in, negative = stock out. Never zero.

stock_after.description: Balance right after this movement was applied, decimal string with scale 4. Derived from the COMPLETE ledger, so it does not change when `direction` hides the interleaved rows.

reason.description: Why the movement happened. Closed catalog: `invoice_sent`, `invoice_annulled`, `invoice_unsent`, `corrective_created`, `delivery_note_delivered`, `delivery_note_cancelled`, `purchase_invoice_registered`, `purchase_invoice_reverted`, `manual_adjustment`, `initial`, `base_unit_replacement_out`, `base_unit_replacement_in`. The last two are the pair a base unit replacement writes: `_out` empties the old product (in its unit) and `_in` fills the new one (in its unit).

source_type.description: Kind of document that caused the movement. `manual` for an adjustment with no source document; `base_unit_replacement` for the transfer of a base unit replacement.

source_id.description: Id of the source document, `null` for a manual adjustment or when the document is no longer reachable. For `base_unit_replacement` it is the id of the OTHER product of the replacement: the new one on the `_out` row and the old one on the `_in` row.

source_label.description: Human-readable number of the source document. For `base_unit_replacement`, the name of the other product.

performed_by.description: Name of the user who caused the movement. `null` means the system did.

base_unit_code.description: UN/ECE code of the unit `delta` and `stock_after` are measured in. Always present.

commercial_quantity.description: Commercial magnitude the delta came from, decimal string with scale 4. All-or-nothing with `commercial_unit_code` and `conversion_factor`.

commercial_unit_code.description: UN/ECE code of the commercial unit. All-or-nothing with `commercial_quantity` and `conversion_factor`.

conversion_factor.description: Base units per commercial unit, decimal string with scale 6. All-or-nothing with the other two. Informational: it is NOT applied again here.

variant_id.description: Managing variant the balance belongs to, `null` when it is the base product.

Store.description: A connected e-commerce store of your company. The public `id` is the store UUID v7. `integration_id` is the UUID of the provider connection that backs it, and `external_store_id` is the identifier the provider gives to the shop — an opaque string, not a foreign key of ours. The settings decide how the orders of the store become invoices.

id.description: UUID v7 of the store. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `store` for this resource.

integration_id.description: UUID of the provider connection (integration) that backs the store. Several stores of the same provider may hang from one connection.

external_store_id.description: Identifier the provider gives to the shop. Unique per provider within your company; an opaque string, NOT a foreign key of ours.

name.description: Editable display name of the store.

simplified_threshold.description: Order total, in EUROS, up to which the store issues a simplified invoice (F2). Capped at 3000.00, the legal maximum. Defaults to 400.00, the general legal limit.

require_tax_id.description: Whether the buyer tax ID is required for an order to be invoiced. Defaults to `false`: a retail store sells to consumers who do not provide one.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices of the store already include taxes. Defaults to `true`, which is how Spanish retail displays prices.

autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether paid orders are invoiced automatically. Defaults to `false`: a freshly connected store does not invoice on its own until you turn it on.

autosend_enabled.description: Whether the invoice is emailed to the buyer automatically. Defaults to `false`.

remote_base_url.description: Base address of the remote shop, or `null` when none is declared. Credentials embedded in the address are removed before it is returned.

environment.description: Environment the store reports as. `live` invoices for real; `test` discards its events with a typed reason. Defaults to `test`.

status.description: Store status. `active` while connected; `disconnected` after disconnecting.

connected_at.description: When the store was connected (ISO 8601), or `null` if unknown.

invoice_note.example: Pedido pagado en la tienda online. Gracias por su compra.
invoice_note.description: Optional note written in the notes of the invoices auto-created from this store's orders, or `null` when none is configured (the default: invoices carry no note). When an order needed a currency conversion to EUR, the conversion trace is appended to the note. Editable with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/stores/{store}`; `null` or an empty string clears it.

StripeAutoinvoicingConfig.description: Stripe Connect integration status and auto-invoicing configuration for your company. Singleton resource (one configuration per company), so it exposes `object` but no navigable `id`.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoicing_config` for this resource.

connected.description: Whether the Stripe Connect integration is connected (active) for the company.

enabled.description: Whether auto-invoicing of Stripe charges is enabled. Defaults to `false`.

series_id.description: UUID v7 of the document series used for auto-created invoices. `null` means the company default series is used.

available_for_current_plan.description: Whether the current plan includes auto-invoicing (effective plan gating, derived from config — not hardcoded).

required_plans.description: Plans that unlock auto-invoicing (derived from config, not hardcoded).

simplified_threshold_cents.description: Simplified invoice (F2) threshold in cents, range `[0, 300000]` (0–3,000 €). Charges without a tax ID at or below this amount are auto-issued as simplified invoices; above it they are routed to manual review. Defaults to 40000 (400 €).

require_nif.description: Whether a Spanish tax ID (NIF) is required for auto-invoicing. When enabled, Factuarea-created Checkouts mark the tax ID as required and charges without a tax ID are never auto-issued as simplified invoices (they go to manual review). Defaults to `false`.

refunds_enabled.description: Whether a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`) automatically generates a linked corrective invoice (with the original invoice and the VeriFactu R record). Only acts while auto-invoicing is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether Stripe subscription cycles (`invoice.paid` with a standard `billing_reason`) are auto-invoiced. Both this toggle and the general `enabled` flag must be on for a cycle to be invoiced. Defaults to `false`.

StripePayout.description: A Stripe payout ingested from `payout.paid`, together with its bank-reconciliation state. The public `id` is the payout UUID v7. `connected_account_id` (`acct_xxx`) and `stripe_payout_id` (`po_xxx`) are external Stripe ids, not foreign keys. `bank_transaction_ref` is the UUID v7 of the reconciled bank statement transaction (`null` while `status` is `ingested`). `composition` is the informative breakdown reported by Stripe (component charges + fees), referencing opaque Stripe ids — payouts are read-only on the public API; reconciliation happens in the dashboard.

id.description: UUID v7 of the payout. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_payout` for this resource.

connected_account_id.description: External Stripe connected account id (`acct_xxx`) the payout was paid out from. NOT an internal UUID nor a foreign key.

stripe_payout_id.description: Opaque Stripe payout identifier (`po_xxx`), unique in Stripe.

amount_net.description: Net amount transferred to the bank account (gross minus fees), in the payout currency.

fee_total.description: Total Stripe fees deducted from the payout.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the payout.

arrival_date.description: Expected arrival date of the payout in the bank account (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Reconciliation state. `ingested` once persisted; `reconciled` (terminal) once matched against a bank statement transaction.

reconciled_at.description: When the payout was reconciled against the bank statement (ISO 8601), or `null` while `ingested`.

bank_transaction_ref.description: UUID v7 of the reconciled bank statement transaction, or `null` while `ingested`.

composition.description: Informative breakdown of the payout reported by Stripe (component charges and fees). Component references are opaque Stripe ids (`payment_intent` = `pi_xxx`, `charge_id` = `ch_xxx`), NOT internal payment UUIDs. May be empty when the breakdown could not be read.

amount.description: Amount of the component charge, as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency.

fee.description: Fee of the component charge, as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency.

fee_total.description: Sum of the component fees, plus the standalone fees and the fees of the refunds, as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency.

gross_total.description: Sum of the component amounts, as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency.

refunds_total.description: Sum of the refunds settled in the payout (negative), as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency. `"0.00"` when there are none.

standalone_fee_total.description: Sum of the Stripe fees charged on their own, not attached to a charge (such as monthly or currency conversion fees), as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency. Already included in `fee_total`. `"0.00"` when there are none.

other_total.description: Sum of the remaining movements settled in the payout (adjustments, disputes and similar; signed), as a 2-decimal string in the payout currency. `"0.00"` when there are none.

Tax.description: A tax rate configuration. Catalog partially global (`is_system=true` for system taxes, without `company_id`) and partially custom per company.

name.description: Human-readable name of the tax (e.g. "IVA 21%").

rate.description: Applied tax rate, e.g. `21` for 21% VAT.

applies_to.description: Scope where it applies: `sales` (sales only), `purchases` (purchases only), `both` (both).

is_default.description: true if this is the default tax for its `type` (independent of the `default_for_documents` map).

is_active.description: Indicates whether the tax is enabled for use on new documents.

is_system.description: true if the tax is from the global system catalog (not editable, without `company_id`).

ownership.description: Who owns the tax: `global` (Factuarea catalog, read-only for companies) or `company` (a tax created by your company, which only your company sees and can edit or delete).

description.description: Free-text description of the tax.
description.example: IVA general aplicable en territorio peninsular y Baleares.
examples: IVA general aplicable en territorio peninsular y Baleares.

default_for_documents.description: Map `DocumentType -> bool` indicating for which document types this tax is default. Replaces the 5 legacy booleans `is_default_invoice/quote/delivery_note/proforma/purchase_invoice`.

customer_visible_label.description: Tax label shown to the end customer on documents (PDF, public link, email).

external_reference.description: AEAT-SII / VeriFactu key (closed catalog: S1..S3 subject, E1..E6 exempt, N1..N2 not subject).

valid_from.description: Legal effective start date of the rate (BOE). Format `YYYY-MM-DD`.

valid_until.description: Legal effective end date of the rate. Invariant: `valid_until >= valid_from` when both are non-null.

country_aeat_zone.description: AEAT tax zone: `peninsula` (including the Balearic Islands), `canarias` (IGIC), `ceuta` (IPSI) or `melilla` (IPSI).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime DERIVED from the AEAT zone, read-only: `iva` (Península), `igic` (Canarias), `ipsi` (Ceuta/Melilla). Only set for `type=vat`; `null` otherwise.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: Identity (UUID v7) of the linked equivalence-surcharge tax. Foreign key to the global `taxes` table (key suffix `_taxes_id` per the UUID policy). `null` when there is no link.

Tax.title: Tax

TaxCalculation.description: Result of applying a tax to a base amount. Returned by `POST /v1/companies/{company}/taxes/calculate`.

base.description: Base amount the tax is applied to (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

tax_rate.description: Applied tax rate, e.g. `21` for 21% VAT.

tax_amount.description: Tax amount (base × tax_rate / 100), as a 2-decimal string.

total_amount.description: Resulting total amount (base + tax_amount), as a 2-decimal string.

TaxCatalog.description: The Spanish tax catalog as a single document: indirect tax regimes with their legal rates and VeriFactu code, header-level operation regimes, exemption causes with their article and legal wording, system withholding rates, and the legal VAT/equivalence-surcharge pairs. It carries no data of the authenticated company, so two different companies receive byte-identical bodies for the same language, and it is not an entity: it has no `id` and no `object`.

primary_language.description: Language resolved from `Accept-Language` (`es`, `en` or `ca`; `es` when the header is absent or names no supported language). It declares the primary language of the document; it does not filter it — every entry always carries all three translations. It travels inside the body on purpose, which is why two languages yield different `ETag`s.

indirect_tax_regimes.description: Indirect tax regimes (IVA, IGIC, IPSI) with their legal rates, standard rate, VeriFactu L1 code and the AEAT zones that determine each one.

operation_regimes.description: Header-level operation regimes with the legal wording each one requires and whether it forces a zero VAT amount.

exemption_causes.description: Exemption, non-subjection and special-regime causes with their AEAT codes, legal wording, applicable article and whether they can be declared per line.

retention_rates.description: System withholding rates, expressed in positive. Mostly IRPF withholdings, plus one contractual retainer that is not a tax and one IRNR rate (see the entry schema). The catalog of what the platform offers, not an exhaustive list of every rate Spanish law defines.

equivalence_surcharge_pairs.description: Closed matrix of the legal VAT/equivalence-surcharge pairs of article 161 of the Spanish VAT Act.

TaxCatalog.title: TaxCatalog

TaxCatalogExemptionCause.description: An exemption, non-subjection or special-regime cause, with the AEAT code it projects to, the legal wording the invoice must carry and the article of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) it relies on. The three AEAT codes are mutually exclusive: every cause derives at most one of them, and the other two are `null`.

calificacion_operacion.description: Code of the AEAT L9 list (transaction qualification): `S2` for reverse charge, `N1`/`N2` for the two non-subjection cases. `null` when the cause is an exemption or a special regime.

causa_exencion.description: Code of the AEAT L10 list (exemption reason), `E1` to `E6`. `null` when the cause is not an exemption.

clave_regimen.description: Code of the AEAT L8A/L8B list (special regime key): `19` farming, `03` second-hand goods, `05` travel agencies, `51` equivalence surcharge, `07` cash accounting. `null` when no special regime applies.

legal_mention.example: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta conforme al artículo 25 de la Ley 37/1992.
legal_mention.description: Full legal wording (in Spanish) that the invoice must carry when this cause is declared.

article.description: Article of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) the cause relies on. `null` only for `otro`, whose wording is written by hand and has no determined article — `null` means "no article", never "not mapped".

line_level.description: `true` when the cause can be declared per invoice line (its projected code is one of `E1`-`E6`, `N1`, `N2`). `false` for the special regimes, `otro` and reverse charge, which can only be declared in the document header.

TaxCatalogExemptionCause.title: TaxCatalogExemptionCause

TaxCatalogIndirectRegime.description: An indirect tax regime determined by the territory the issuer operates from (IVA on the mainland and the Balearic Islands, IGIC in the Canary Islands, IPSI in Ceuta and Melilla). This is the "which tax applies" axis; it is orthogonal to the operation regime, which answers "how is this transaction taxed".

aeat_code.description: Code of the AEAT L1 list used by VeriFactu: `01` for IVA, `02` for IPSI, `03` for IGIC. Send this value, not the `code`, when a VeriFactu field expects the L1 list.

valid_rates.description: Every legal rate of the regime, in percentage points. Any other rate is rejected when the invoice line is created.

general_rate.description: Standard rate of the regime, the sensible default when the line has no explicit rate.

aeat_zones.description: AEAT territorial zones that determine this regime. A company whose zone is listed here charges this tax.

TaxCatalogIndirectRegime.title: TaxCatalogIndirectRegime

TaxCatalogLocalizedText.description: A catalog text in the three languages the API supports. All three are always present: the negotiated `Accept-Language` picks the primary language of the document, it never filters the payload, so a client rendering a multilingual selector does not need three requests.
TaxCatalogLocalizedText.title: TaxCatalogLocalizedText

TaxCatalogOperationRegime.description: A header-level operation regime: how a transaction is taxed regardless of which indirect tax applies. Three of the four require the invoice to be issued with no VAT amount and to carry a legal wording; sending a rate above zero on those is a fiscal error, not a formatting one.

code.description: Stable identifier of the operation regime.

legal_mention.example: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta - Art. 25 LIVA
legal_mention.description: Legal wording (in Spanish) that the invoice must carry for this regime. `null` for `general`, the ordinary domestic transaction, which requires none.

requires_zero_vat.description: `true` when the regime forces a zero VAT amount on every line of the document.

TaxCatalogOperationRegime.title: TaxCatalogOperationRegime

TaxCatalogRetentionRate.description: A system withholding rate offered by the platform. Most entries are IRPF withholdings, but not all of them, and the `IRPF_` prefix of the `code` is no proof otherwise — codes are stable identifiers, not a tax classification. Two entries are not IRPF: `IRPF_5_GARANTIA` is contractual retention money on a construction contract, with no tax nature at all (it is not reported on form 111 and nothing is paid over to AEAT), and `IRPF_24` belongs to IRNR (RDL 5/2004), the non-resident income tax. Read each `label` for the nature of its own rate instead of assuming every entry is an IRPF withholding. This block is the catalog of what Factuarea ships, NOT an exhaustive list of every rate Spanish law defines, and it never includes the custom taxes a company creates in the application, which `GET /v1/companies/{company}/taxes` lists.

code.description: Stable identifier of the withholding type. It is the key, not the `rate`: two different types can share the same percentage and `applies_to` and differ only in the case they cover.

rate.description: Withholding percentage, always POSITIVE. Apply it as a deduction from the taxable base; the sign convention of the contract is positive regardless of how the rate is stored internally.

applies_to.description: `sale` for withholdings you apply on your own invoices, `purchase` for withholdings a supplier applies on theirs.

TaxCatalogRetentionRate.title: TaxCatalogRetentionRate

TaxCatalogSurchargePair.description: A legal pairing of a VAT rate with its equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia). The rates are the ones article 161 of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) fixes; article 154, which anchors the special regime, governs its content and not its rates. The matrix is closed: any other combination is rejected when the invoice line is created. It pairs a surcharge with a VAT rate, so it cannot express the 1.75% rate article 161 reserves for supplies of manufactured tobacco, which depends on the product and not on the VAT rate.

vat.description: VAT rate of the pair, in percentage points.

surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge that legally accompanies that VAT rate.

TaxCatalogSurchargePair.title: TaxCatalogSurchargePair

TaxDefaultsForDocuments.description: Defaults grouped by tax category for a given document type. Each key contains the (possibly empty) list of taxes marked as default for that `docType` within its `type`.

vat.description: Taxes with `type=vat` that are default for the requested docType.

TaxDefaultsForDocuments.title: TaxDefaultsForDocuments

TaxReport.description: A generated Spanish tax declaration (Modelo 303 quarterly VAT, or Modelo 347 yearly informational). Downloadable via `GET /v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/{tax_report}/download`.

id.description: Opaque UUID v7 of the generated report.

period_year.description: Fiscal year covered by the declaration (backward compat, also available in `period.year`).

period_quarter.description: Quarter (1-4) for Modelo 303; null for Modelo 347 (yearly). Backward compat, also available in `period.quarter`.

period.description: Fiscal period covered by the declaration (nested form).

format.description: Output format. `txt_aeat` is the official format accepted by the AEAT submission portal.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the generated file (audit trail).

generated_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who generated the declaration (audit trail).

download_url.description: Relative download URL of the generated resource (`/v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/{tax_report}/download`).

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings emitted during generation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

warning_codes.description: Stable machine-readable codes paired one-to-one (same index) with `warnings`. Branch on these instead of matching the Spanish text; unknown codes should fall back to the corresponding `warnings` entry.

TaxReport.title: TaxReport

TaxReportActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a tax report generation (creation, download, etc.). The `metadata` is sanitized (internal PKs removed) before being exposed.

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: Se generó la declaración Modelo 303 del segundo trimestre de 2026.
examples: Se generó la declaración Modelo 303 del segundo trimestre de 2026.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID v7 of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

TaxReportActivity.title: TaxReportActivity

TaxReportPreview.description: Preview (dry-run computation, without persisting any file) of a Modelo 303/347 for a period. Lets the integrator validate the amounts before generating the final report. Amounts are expressed in euro cents (integers).

base.description: Accumulated taxable base for that VAT rate, in cents.

cuota.description: Accumulated VAT amount for that rate, in cents.

breakdown_303.description: Breakdown by VAT rate (Modelo 303 only). Map indexed by tax rate → `{base, cuota}` in cents. Empty for Modelo 347.

totals.description: Aggregated totals of the declaration (amounts in cents).

clients_347.description: Operations with clients that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the client.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

suppliers_347.description: Operations with suppliers that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the supplier.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

invoice_count.description: Number of issued invoices considered in the period.

purchase_invoice_count.description: Number of expenses considered in the period.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings detected during the computation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

warning_codes.description: Stable machine-readable codes paired one-to-one (same index) with `warnings`. Branch on these instead of matching the Spanish text; unknown codes should fall back to the corresponding `warnings` entry.

TaxReportPreview.title: TaxReportPreview

TaxReportStats.description: Aggregated summary of the history of tax reports generated by the authenticated company: totals by type, by format, accumulated size and current fiscal period. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/stats`.

by_type.description: Report count by type. Covers every declaration type, so the three values add up to `total_reports`.

txt_aeat.description: Files in the official AEAT format.

total_size_bytes.description: Accumulated size (bytes) of all generated files.

TaxReportStats.title: TaxReportStats

TaxStats.description: Aggregated KPIs over the company tax catalog (includes global system taxes). Broken down by `type` and by AEAT `external_reference`.

total.description: Total taxes visible to the company (system + custom).

system_count.description: Taxes from the global system catalog (`is_system=true`).

custom_count.description: Visible taxes with `is_system=false` (usually your company's own taxes).

by_aeat_code.description: Tax count by AEAT `external_reference`. The `"(null)"` key groups taxes without an assigned AEAT code.

TaxStats.title: TaxStats

TaxTotals.description: Aggregated totals of a set of lines. Returned by `POST /v1/companies/{company}/taxes/calculate-totals`. Total formula: `subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

subtotal.description: Sum of the taxable bases of all lines (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines, as a 2-decimal string.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines, as a 2-decimal string.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines, as a 2-decimal string.

total.description: Grand total, as a 2-decimal string.

lines.description: Calculated breakdown for each received line, in the same order.

TaxTotals.title: TaxTotals

TaxTotalsLine.description: Calculated breakdown of a single line within `POST /v1/companies/{company}/taxes/calculate-totals`.

subtotal.description: Taxable base of the line (quantity × price − discount), as a 2-decimal string.

vat_amount.description: VAT amount of the line, as a 2-decimal string.

surcharge_amount.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line, as a 2-decimal string.

retention_amount.description: Withholding (IRPF) amount of the line, as a 2-decimal string.

total.description: Total of the line (subtotal + vat + surcharge − retention), as a 2-decimal string.

TaxTotalsLine.title: TaxTotalsLine

TaxUsage.description: Where a tax is used across your catalog and documents. It lets you decide whether it is safe to delete or deactivate the tax (`in_use=false` means it is safe to delete).

taxes_id.description: UUID v7 of the requested tax.

used_by.description: Number of references by kind of resource. Purchase invoice lines (they store a rate, not a tax reference) are not counted.

suppliers.description: Suppliers that use the tax as their default tax.

supplier_profiles.description: Supplier contact profiles that use the tax as their default tax and are not already counted in `suppliers` (a supplier is never counted twice).

invoice_lines.description: Invoice lines that reference the tax as VAT, withholding, surcharge or generic tax.

recurring_invoices.description: Recurring invoice templates with at least one line that references the tax (each template counts once).

company_tax_defaults.description: Document and category slots of your company tax configuration that use the tax as the default.

TaxUsage.title: TaxUsage

TeamAbsenceCalendar.description: The monthly team absence calendar for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: for a given year and month, every active employee with their approved absences of that month (each coloured by its absence type) plus the public holidays that apply, kept separate from the absences. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by company + year/month and never exposes an `id`.

members.description: Active employees of the team, each with their approved absences overlapping the month.

absences.description: Approved absences of the employee overlapping the month.

color.description: Hex color `#RRGGBB` of the absence type, used to render it on the calendar.

status.description: Status of the absence (always `approved` on the calendar).

holidays.description: Public holidays that apply to the team during the month.

name.description: Name of the holiday.

scope.description: Scope of the holiday: national, regional (autonomous community) or local.

TeamAbsenceCalendar.title: TeamAbsenceCalendar

TeamTimeBalanceRow.description: A single row of the team time balance summary: the monthly totals of one active employee for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. The `total_*` fields project the whole month; `to_date` holds the accumulation of the closed days.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the whole month, including today and the remaining days (projection).

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the month so far, today included.

total_balance_minutes.description: Month balance in minutes as the sum of the daily balances. In the current month it is a projection that already subtracts the expected minutes of today and of the remaining days; use `to_date.balance_minutes` for the actual balance.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the month.

TeamTimeBalanceRow.title: TeamTimeBalanceRow

TeamTimeBalanceSummary.description: The team time balance summary (manager view) for a month for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by company + month and holds one row per active employee with their monthly totals and their accumulation of the closed days (`to_date`). Totals are in minutes.

employees.description: One row per active employee with their monthly totals.

TeamTimeBalanceSummary.title: TeamTimeBalanceSummary

document_kind.description: Template kind: `commercial` (invoice, quote, pro forma and delivery note) or `transport-document` (transport control document, DeCA). It is fixed at creation and never changes. Defaults to `commercial` when omitted on create and returned on every template and revision.

TimeBalance.description: The time balance of an arbitrary period (`from`/`to`) of an employee for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by employee + period, so it exposes `employee_id` (UUID v7) and never an `id`. It is the same contract the monthly close reuses over closed periods. Totals are in minutes; `days` is the daily breakdown.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the balance belongs to.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the period (holidays and approved absences already discounted).

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the period.

total_balance_minutes.description: Period balance in minutes as the sum of the daily balances. Days without a schedule in effect or outside the employment period add 0, so it can differ from worked − expected when minutes were clocked on those days.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the period.

days.description: Daily breakdown of the period. Each day includes `is_unscheduled` and `is_outside_employment`.

TimeBalance.title: TimeBalance

TimeBalanceToDate.description: The month-to-date accumulation of the closed days (every day before today) for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. It is computed from the same daily breakdown as the `total_*` fields, which instead cover the whole month and are a projection: in the current month they already subtract the expected minutes of today and of the remaining days. Today is left out because its workday is still in progress. In a finished month it equals the `total_*` fields; when no day of the month has closed yet (its first day, or a future month), `through_date` is `null` and the four figures are 0.

through_date.description: Last closed day included in the accumulation (YYYY-MM-DD), normally yesterday; `null` when no day of the month has closed yet.

expected_minutes.description: Expected working minutes of the closed days.

worked_minutes.description: Worked minutes of the closed days.

balance_minutes.description: Balance of the closed days in minutes: the sum of the daily `balance_minutes`, so days without a schedule or outside the employment period add 0.

overtime_minutes.description: Overtime minutes of the closed days.

TimeBalanceToDate.title: TimeBalanceToDate

TimeCorrection.description: A time entry correction request for the Control Horario (time tracking) module (RD-ley 8/2019). A correction is an append-only entry that references the original time entry without mutating it (analogous to a corrective invoice); its status is derived from the ledger — there is no status column. The workflow is request → approve/reject, always resolved by a manager and never self-approved.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the correction request, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

status.description: Derived workflow state: `pending` (awaiting resolution), `approved` or `rejected`.

time_entry_id.description: UUID v7 of the original time entry the correction refers to.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the corrected entry belongs to.

requested_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who requested the correction.

resolved_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who approved or rejected the request; `null` while it is still pending.

reason.description: Reason supplied with the request (or the rejection); `null` if none.
reason.example: El fichaje de salida se registró con 30 minutos de retraso.
examples: El fichaje de salida se registró con 30 minutos de retraso.

proposed.description: Map of the proposed values of the correction (shape depends on `kind`).

resolved_at.description: When the request was resolved (ISO 8601); `null` while it is still pending.

TimeCorrection.title: TimeCorrection

TimeEntry.description: A single entry of the immutable time record ledger (a clock event) for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Every clock-in, pause, resume and clock-out — live or retroactive — is an entry chained by fingerprint. The workday state is derived from these entries; there is no session table. Fingerprints are never exposed.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the time entry, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the entry belongs to.

entry_type.description: Type of clock event: `clock_in` (opens a work span), `pause_start`, `pause_end` or `clock_out` (closes the span).

occurred_at.description: When the clock event happened (ISO 8601). For retroactive entries this is the past instant supplied by the manager.

recorded_at.description: When the entry was appended to the ledger (ISO 8601).

source.description: Origin of the entry: `web` or `mobile` (live self-service) or `manual` (retroactive entry recorded by a manager).

is_retroactive.description: Whether the entry was recorded retroactively (a manual entry by a manager) rather than clocked live.

reason.description: Reason for the retroactive entry; `null` for live entries.

TimeEntry.title: TimeEntry

TimeRecordChainValidation.description: Result of recomputing and verifying the SHA-256 hash chain (`huella`) of your company time record ledger without mutating data. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/time-entries/chain/validate`. Fingerprints are never exposed.

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the hash chain is intact.

total_records.description: Total number of time record entries considered.

first_invalid_record_id.description: UUID v7 of the first invalid entry, or `null` if the chain is intact.

TimeTrackingSettings.description: The per-company time tracking configuration for the Control Horario module: the overtime computation basis and thresholds, the rounding tolerance and the forgotten-clock-in reminder settings. UpdateConnectedAccountRequest.description: Update a connected Stripe account (multi-store). All fields are optional with merge semantics (an omitted field is left unchanged): `name`, `series_id` (auto-invoicing series UUID; `null` clears it back to the company default), `simplified_threshold_cents` (0-300000), `autoinvoicing_enabled`, `require_nif`, `refunds_enabled`, `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled`, `invoice_note` (up to 500 characters, written in the notes of the auto-created invoices; `null` clears it) and the Stripe fee expense settings `fee_expenses_enabled`, `fee_expenses_tax_treatment` and `fee_expenses_since`. Turning fee expenses on requires the purchases module of the plan (403 `feature_not_available_in_plan`) and a tax treatment and a first month, sent or already stored (400 `parameter_missing`). A treatment or month outside the catalog is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value`. The company platform account does not accept `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled`: its subscriptions are invoiced by Factuarea (422 `parameter_invalid_value`, subcode `platform_account_subscriptions_owned_by_billing`).

fee_expenses_enabled.description: Turns on or off the monthly purchase expense that records the Stripe fees of this account (Stripe accounts only). Turning it on requires the purchases module of the plan and, once on, a `fee_expenses_tax_treatment` and a `fee_expenses_since` (sent in the same request or already stored). Turning it off keeps the stored treatment and month and the expenses already created.

fee_expenses_tax_treatment.description: Tax treatment of the fee expense: `reverse_charge_eu` (intra-community purchase at 21 %, self-assessed) or `exempt` (0 %, exemption cause E1). Any other value is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value`.

fee_expenses_since.description: First month to record as a fee expense, as `YYYY-MM`. It cannot be later than the current month, and only closed months are recorded. A malformed or future month is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value`.

UpdateDeliveryNoteRequest.description: Partial update of a delivery note: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed while the delivery note is in `draft` status (otherwise 422 `invalid_status_transition`).

vehicle_plate.description: Licence plate of the vehicle used for the delivery (up to 20 characters).

pdf_template_id.description: Optional nullable tenant-template UUID. Omission preserves current intent; null clears manual intent and inherits; a UUID selects a compatible manual template. Send expected_selection_version whenever this field is present. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

expected_selection_version.description: Positive current selection version used as the body CAS. It is required exactly when pdf_template_id is present; omit both fields to leave the current presentation intent unchanged. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Send a JSON number or a decimal string with up to 4 decimals (`"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): the string is the exact form the response returns, so a line read from the API can be sent back unchanged. Derived amounts are computed from it and keep 2 decimals.

tax_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the VAT-class tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `tax_rate`, the rate (and the indirect-tax regime, the AEAT qualification and, for an exempt or not-subject tax, the exemption cause) comes from that tax. A tax that is not a VAT-class tax, or a `tax_rate` that differs from the rate of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line). Send only the id, or a `tax_rate` equal to the tax's own rate.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate of the line (0–100). Optional, and it matters whenever `lines` is sent, because a `PUT` replaces the whole set of lines: a line that omits it (or sends `null`) takes the tax it references or the tax assigned to its product and otherwise the DEFAULT TAX of your company for this kind of document, inherited as a whole: its rate, its indirect-tax regime (IVA, IGIC or IPSI) and its AEAT qualification; an exempt or not-subject default also declares its cause (`exemption_reason`) on the line unless the line sends its own. If none of them exists the request is rejected with 422 `missing_required_param`, with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line); a rate already stored on a line is NOT kept if you resend the line without it. A `0` you send is honoured as a real 0 % rate.

retention_rate.description: Withholding (IRPF) percentage of the line, 0–100 (the magnitude: a catalog withholding stored with a negative sign is declared here without it). Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) and the line carries `retention_rate_id`, it is taken from that tax. If you send both and the percentage differs from the one of the chosen tax, the request is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.retention_rate` and `error.line_index` = N.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence-surcharge percentage of the line, 0–100. Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) and the line carries `surcharge_rate_id`, it is taken from that tax. If you send both and the percentage differs from the one of the chosen tax, the request is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.surcharge_rate` and `error.line_index` = N.

retention_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the withholding (IRPF) tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `retention_rate`, the percentage of the line is taken from that tax (its magnitude, 0–100): sending only the id never computes the withholding at 0 %. A tax of another class (for example a VAT or an equivalence-surcharge tax), or a `retention_rate` that differs from the percentage of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.retention_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line).

surcharge_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the equivalence-surcharge tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `surcharge_rate`, the percentage of the line is taken from that tax: sending only the id never computes the surcharge at 0 %. A tax of another class (for example a VAT or a withholding tax), or a `surcharge_rate` that differs from the percentage of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.surcharge_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line).

hire_date.description: Hire date of the employee (`Y-m-d`). Must not be later than the termination date; changing it keeps existing time entries and schedule assignments.

ccaa.description: Spanish autonomous community or city (ISO 3166-2:ES) used to localise public holidays.

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description: Update a draft invoice. Omitted commercial fields preserve their values; null clears, reference objects merge by key and lists replace while preserving order and duplicates. Retain lines.N.id (UUID v7) to keep a line when reordering; omit it for a new line. Repeated, retired or foreign identities reject the whole update. A non-null reference date requires its paired reference after merging. Header references have only three supported keys (20 characters); line references have five pairs, delivery-note numbers have 30 characters, literals 250 and sequence_number accepts only JSON integers 0-2147483647. Administrative centres null inherits the frozen snapshot; [] selects none. Source line ids, source trees and administrative snapshot/version fields are read-only. payment_terms omitted preserves; null removes only in draft, [] explicitly selects none, list replaces the whole schedule. A nonempty replacement sent without `due_on` moves `due_on` to its last instalment, the date on which the invoice falls due. Every supplied calendar requires raw JSON-integer expected_payment_terms_version >= 0, including no-op/null/[]. If total_to_pay changes with a nonempty current calendar, provide a balanced replacement in the same request. Missing version=428, stale=409 with current_version after authorization; no partial line/fiscal-tree/calendar save. Optional row id is non-null UUID v7; omission always makes a new identity and excluded old identities retire. Versions/source/currency/timestamps/legacy_context are server-owned. Explicit row accounts never use a live fallback; reads do not adapt legacy.

line_type.description: Kind of line: `NORMAL` (default) for an ordinary line of your own operation, or `SUPLIDO` for a DISBURSEMENT — an amount you paid in the name and on behalf of the client and now re-invoice at cost, which stays out of the taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA). Replacing the lines of a draft re-applies the same rules, so keep the field when you resend a line you read from the invoice: sending it as `NORMAL` (or omitting it) turns the disbursement into an ordinary taxable line and changes the invoice amount.

source_invoice_reference.description: Reference of the supporting document that originated the disbursement — the receipt or fee number issued by the public body (up to 100 characters). REQUIRED when `line_type` is `SUPLIDO`; leave it out on a normal line.

source_invoice_ids.description: Optional traceability of a disbursement: list of IDs (UUID v7) of your own expenses that back it. An expense of another company is rejected with 422.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the document (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), up to 20 characters. Presentation only: free text, no closed catalog and no fiscal effect.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of this line (up to 255 characters), printed under the line description to satisfy the mention required by art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012 when the catalogued cause does not cover it.

line_total.description: Optional CHECKSUM of the line total. When sent, it is compared against the total this API computes and the request is rejected with 422 (`line_total_checksum_mismatch`, with the expected and received values in `error.details`) when they differ by more than one cent. Never stored and never returned.

anyOf.description: Ordered delivery-note references; duplicates are preserved. A supplied list replaces the previous list.

sequence_number.description: Optional sequence. JSON integers only: 0 is valid; booleans, floats and numeric strings are rejected.

id.description: Existing active UUID v7 of a line of THIS invoice. Omit for a new line. Reordering preserves commercial data by identity, not index; repeated or foreign identities are rejected.

pdf_template_id.description: Optional nullable tenant-template UUID. Omission preserves current intent; null clears manual intent and inherits; a UUID selects a compatible manual template. expected_selection_version.description: Positive current selection version used as the body CAS. due_on.description: New due date (YYYY-MM-DD), only while the invoice is a draft. With a nonempty schedule the invoice falls due on its last instalment: when you replace `payment_terms` and leave `due_on` out, it moves to that date; when you send both and they differ, the draft keeps them and issuing it returns 422 `invoice_due_date_not_last_instalment`.

operation_on.description: Date the operation took place (YYYY-MM-DD) when it differs from the issue date. It can only be changed while the invoice is a draft, and it cannot be later than `issued_on` (422 `operation_date_after_issue_date`) unless the first line that declares a `regime_key` uses 14 or 15.

packaging included: up to four decimal places, greater than zero.

derived from `conversion_factor`. Omit it to keep the current

manage_stock.description: Whether this product takes part in document-driven stock movements: with `true`, issuing or receiving a document that includes it moves its stock automatically and the movement is recorded in the stock ledger. It only takes effect if your company also has stock management enabled; absent or `null` means `false`.

currency.description: Product amounts are read-only EUR: only `EUR` (or absence/null) is accepted.

external_id.description: Third-party integration key from your ERP/CRM. Partial update: an absent value is preserved. Free-form, up to 100 characters; unique per company.

id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the option group. A new group must be a UUID v7 (422 otherwise); an existing one keeps its identifier.
Public identifier (UUID v7) of the option value. A new value must be a UUID v7 (422 otherwise); an existing one keeps its identifier.
Public identifier (UUID v7) of the configuration. A new configuration must be a UUID v7 (422 otherwise); an existing one keeps its identifier.

stock.description: Quantity for the operation, in the product base unit (up to 4 decimals).

operation.description: How `stock` applies: `set` replaces the balance (default), `increase` adds, `decrease` subtracts. `add`/`subtract` are accepted aliases. A manual decrease below zero fails with 422.

variant_id.description: Optional variant of this product whose OWN balance receives the adjustment (the variant must belong to the product and manage its own stock). Absent → the product base stock.

base_price_override.description: Own price of the variant PER BASE UNIT; `null` keeps the price of the product.

unit_cost_override.description: Own cost of the variant PER BASE UNIT.

stock.description: Own balance of the variant, in the product base unit (up to 4 decimals). Any other value is a manual set and must be `>= 0` (422 otherwise); to move the balance use `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/stock` with `variant_id`.

gross_weight_kg.description:

UNIT: up to four decimal places, greater than zero. It overrides

UpdateProformaRequest.description: Partial update of a proforma: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed while the proforma is in `draft` status (otherwise 422 `invalid_status_transition`).

pdf_template_id.description: Optional nullable tenant-template UUID. Omission preserves current intent; null clears manual intent and inherits; a UUID selects a compatible manual template.
