expected_selection_version.description: Positive current selection version used as the body CAS. It is required exactly when pdf_template_id is present; omit both fields to leave the current presentation intent unchanged. Both fields only take effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise they are ignored.

unit_price.description: Unit price. Send a JSON number or a decimal string with up to 4 decimals (`"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): the string is the exact form the response returns, so a line read from the API can be sent back unchanged. Derived amounts are computed from it and keep 2 decimals.

tax_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the VAT-class tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `tax_rate`, the rate (and the indirect-tax regime, the AEAT qualification and, for an exempt or not-subject tax, the exemption cause) comes from that tax. A tax that is not a VAT-class tax, or a `tax_rate` that differs from the rate of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line). Send only the id, or a `tax_rate` equal to the tax's own rate.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate of the line (0–100). Optional, and it matters whenever `lines` is sent, because a `PUT` replaces the whole set of lines: a line that omits it (or sends `null`) takes the tax it references or the tax assigned to its product and otherwise the DEFAULT TAX of your company for this kind of document, inherited as a whole: its rate, its indirect-tax regime (IVA, IGIC or IPSI) and its AEAT qualification; an exempt or not-subject default also declares its cause (`exemption_reason`) on the line unless the line sends its own. If none of them exists the request is rejected with 422 `missing_required_param`, with `error.param` = `lines.N.tax_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line); a rate already stored on a line is NOT kept if you resend the line without it. A `0` you send is honoured as a real 0 % rate.

retention_rate.description: Withholding (IRPF) percentage of the line, 0–100 (the magnitude: a catalog withholding stored with a negative sign is declared here without it). Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) and the line carries `retention_rate_id`, it is taken from that tax. If you send both and the percentage differs from the one of the chosen tax, the request is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.retention_rate` and `error.line_index` = N.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence-surcharge percentage of the line, 0–100. Optional: when you omit it (or send `null`) and the line carries `surcharge_rate_id`, it is taken from that tax. If you send both and the percentage differs from the one of the chosen tax, the request is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.surcharge_rate` and `error.line_index` = N.

retention_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the withholding (IRPF) tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `retention_rate`, the percentage of the line is taken from that tax (its magnitude, 0–100): sending only the id never computes the withholding at 0 %. A tax of another class (for example a VAT or an equivalence-surcharge tax), or a `retention_rate` that differs from the percentage of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.retention_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line).

surcharge_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the equivalence-surcharge tax of the catalog chosen for the line. Optional. Without `surcharge_rate`, the percentage of the line is taken from that tax: sending only the id never computes the surcharge at 0 %. A tax of another class (for example a VAT or a withholding tax), or a `surcharge_rate` that differs from the percentage of the chosen tax, is rejected with 422 `parameter_invalid_value` (subcode `tax_rate_mismatch`), with `error.param` = `lines.N.surcharge_rate` and `error.line_index` = N (the zero-based index of the line).

Writable fields mirror creation (`client_id`, `series_id`, `name`, `description`, `frequency`, `holiday_handling`, `start_on`, `end_on`, `notes`, `metadata`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences`, `email_to`, `send_automatically`, `generation_mode`, `auto_delivery`, `lines[]`). presentation_policy.description: Create omitted/null means latest inherited. This field only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

This field only takes effect when revisioned presentation is enabled for the company; otherwise it is ignored.

send_automatically.description: Compatibility flag derived from `generation_mode`. Without `generation_mode`, `true` selects `issue_and_send` and `false` selects `draft`. Together with `generation_mode` it must agree with it (`true` only with `issue_and_send`), otherwise the request is rejected with 422. Prefer sending `generation_mode`.

When sent, it takes precedence and `send_automatically` becomes a derived field (`true` only with `issue_and_send`); sending a `send_automatically` (top-level or inside `auto_delivery`) that contradicts it is rejected with 422. Optional pdf_template_id preserves on omission, clears on null and assigns a compatible tenant template on UUID. If the selector is provided, even null or the current UUID, supply pdf_template_expected_version (integer >=1). A purpose change with a saved preference also requires this body CAS. A parent-series ETag does not replace it: missing CAS 428, stale CAS 409; invalid or incompatible input 422 rolls back the complete fiscal and visual edit. Empty strings, the other transport selector and two selectors are invalid. number_format is the fiscal mask, not PDF paper.

name.description: Series name (1-100 characters).

UpdateStoreV1Request.description:
Public REST API v1 — PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/stores/{store}.

Partial update of the settings of a connected store: every field is optional
and a field you do not send keeps its current value. The identity of the
store —its provider connection, its provider and the identifier of the remote
shop— cannot be changed here: pointing an existing store at a different shop
would keep the invoicing history of the old one.

Three fields accept an explicit `null` and it means something: `series_id: null`
goes back to the default series of your company, `remote_base_url: null`
removes the declared address, and `invoice_note: null` removes the note of the
automatic invoices. Omitting either one leaves it untouched.
`simplified_threshold` is expressed in EUROS and capped at the legal maximum
for a simplified invoice.

name.description: Display name of the store.

series_id.description: Series (UUID v7, type invoice) the store numbers into; send `null` to go back to the default series of your company.

simplified_threshold.description: Order total, in euros, up to which the store issues a simplified invoice. Maximum 3000.00.

require_tax_id.description: Whether the buyer tax ID is required for the order to be invoiced.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices of the store already include taxes.

autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether paid orders are invoiced automatically.

autosend_enabled.description: Whether the invoice is emailed to the buyer automatically.

remote_base_url.description: Base address of the remote shop; send `null` to remove it. Checked against the outbound policy of your company.

environment.description: Environment the store reports as: `live` invoices for real, `test` discards with a typed reason.

invoice_note.description: Note written in the notes of every invoice issued automatically from this store (up to 500 characters). Send `null` or an empty string to remove it: invoices then carry no note.

authorize_remote_host.description: Authorize the host of `remote_base_url` as an outbound destination in the same call.

clock_in_reminder_enabled.description: Whether the missed clock-in reminder is enabled. Optional: when omitted it keeps its current value.

clock_in_reminder_grace_minutes.description: Grace minutes after the scheduled time before reminding. Optional: when omitted it keeps its current value.

UpdateTransportDocumentRequest.description: Partial update of a draft transport document: an absent field is kept, an explicit `null` clears it and `shipments` replaces the whole list. Same fields and rules as the creation body, without `delivery_note_ids`. Inside `shipments`, `id` only identifies a shipment of THIS document (any other identifier returns 422 `parameter_invalid_value` on `shipments.N.id`) and a new shipment goes without `id`; an explicit `origin: null` clears the origin of that shipment.
UpdateTransportDocumentRequest.title: UpdateTransportDocumentRequest

remission_mode.description: Who remits your records to AEAT: `own_certificate` (your own certificate, the default), `social_collaborator` or `power_of_attorney` (Factuarea remits with its certificate). A third-party mode requires an active representation of the kind it asks for — register it first with `POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/representation` — otherwise 422 with subcode `representation_required`.

api_version.description: New payload version (date-based, `YYYY-MM-DD`) pinned for the events delivered to this endpoint. Supported values: `2026-05-22`, `2026-10-01` and `2026-10-05`. Omit the field to keep the current value; send `null` to unpin the endpoint, which then receives the payload version of the default REST version (currently `2026-05-22`), never the latest one. Endpoints that existed before version `2026-10-01` was released were pinned to `2026-05-22`, so they keep receiving invoices in the previous vocabulary until you change this value. A value that is not a `YYYY-MM-DD` date returns 422 (subcode `api_version_invalid_format`), and an unsupported one 422 (subcode `api_version_unsupported`).

status.description: Optional endpoint status: `active` re-enables the endpoint and `disabled` pauses it; omit it to leave the status unchanged. `degraded` cannot be set by hand. Re-enabling an endpoint that was paused because its company tax ID was transferred to another account makes the caller its new owner, so the degraded-endpoint email reaches that person from then on.

name.description: Weekly schedule name. Optional: when omitted it keeps its current value.

mode.description: Schedule mode: `validated` (assumed fulfilled) or `real_clocking` (computed from real clock entries). Optional: when omitted it keeps its current value.

week_pattern.description: Full weekly pattern: list of days with their time ranges. Optional: when omitted the current pattern is kept; when sent it replaces the whole pattern.

day.description: Day of the week in ISO 8601 format (1 Monday .. 7 Sunday).

ranges.description: Time ranges for the day (empty = rest day).

end.description: Range end time (HH:MM; 24:00 is allowed as end of workday).

certificate_file.description: The digital certificate file in PKCS#12 format (`.p12` or `.pfx`).

UploadProductVideoRequest.description: Upload the product video as `multipart/form-data`: the `video` field — mp4, mov, avi or webm, max 50 MB.

file.description: Attachment file (multipart). The type is detected from the content, never from the extension.

target.description: Target: `comment` (default, creates a comment with the note and the attachment) or `description`.

note.description: Note of the comment that accompanies the attachment; only used with `target=comment`.

VeriFactuConfig.description: VeriFactu configuration of your company (mode, environment, enrollment). Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/config` and `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/settings`. The certificate password is never exposed.

enabled.description: Indicates whether VeriFactu is enabled for the company.

auto_transmit.description: Indicates whether transmissions to AEAT are sent automatically.

is_locked_until.description: Date until which the mode change is locked, or `null` if not locked.

has_active_certificate.description: Whether there is an active certificate configured.

active_certificate_id.description: UUID v7 of the active certificate, or `null` if there is none.

remission_mode.description: Who remits your records to AEAT: `own_certificate` (the default: your own certificate), `social_collaborator` (Factuarea remits with its certificate as social collaborator, annex I of the Resolution of 18-12-2024) or `power_of_attorney` (Factuarea remits under a power of attorney registered with AEAT). A third-party mode requires an active representation of the kind it asks for (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/representation`); change it with `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/settings`.

has_active_representation.description: Whether the company has a current representation that has NOT expired — the one that enables third-party remission — regardless of the mode. A representation that has expired keeps `active_representation_id` and `_kind` but this field is `false` (see `active_representation_is_expired`).

active_representation_id.description: UUID v7 of the current (not revoked) representation, even if it has expired, or `null` if there is none.

active_representation_kind.description: Kind of the current (not revoked) representation, even if it has expired, or `null` if there is none.

active_representation_valid_until.description: Last day of validity (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Madrid) of the current representation, or `null` when there is none or it does not expire.

active_representation_is_expired.description: Whether the current representation has expired. `false` when there is none.

social_collaborator_available.description: Whether this instance offers the `social_collaborator` remission mode (the social-collaboration agreement with AEAT is in force). It is a fact of the instance, the same for every company: while it is `false`, `PATCH /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/settings` with that mode returns 422 `social_collaborator_unavailable` and `power_of_attorney` covers the same use case.

presenter_certificate_status.description: State of the certificate that the remission would present given `remission_mode`: yours in `own_certificate`, the one of Factuarea in a third-party mode. `valid`: usable; `invalid`: configured but expired, revoked or for another tax ID; `not_configured`: there is none. The certificate of Factuarea never exposes its holder, tax ID, serial number or identifier.

example.description: Transmisión de alta aceptada por AEAT.

examples.description: Transmisión de alta aceptada por AEAT.

VeriFactuEventSummary.title: VeriFactuEventSummary

VeriFactuRecord.description: A VeriFactu (Spanish AEAT SIF) record (alta/anulación) associated with an invoice. Includes the hash chain (`huella`), AEAT CSV and transmission status for reconciliation.

id.description: UUID v7 of the VeriFactu record.

invoice_type.description: AEAT invoice type (F1, F2, F3, R1-R5, …).

amount.description: Total amount of the associated invoice.

status.description: Transmission status (pending, submitted, accepted, rejected, error).

huella.description: Chained SHA-256 fingerprint of the record (VeriFactu fingerprint).

aeat_submission_id.description: Submission identifier assigned by AEAT (column `aeat_submission_id`). `null` until AEAT returns it. Never the internal PK of the record.

aeat_csv.description: Secure Verification Code (Código Seguro de Verificación) returned by AEAT on acceptance. `null` until AEAT assigns it.

transmitted_at.description: ISO 8601 date of the last transmission that reached AEAT. `null` in PENDING/REJECTED/ERROR states.

is_substitute_for_simplified.description: Whether it substitutes one or more simplified invoices (F3).

aeat_error_code.description: Error code of the last AEAT rejection or failure (for example `1110` or `4112`), the internal code of a record that is stopped (`MISSING_CERTIFICATE`, `MISSING_REPRESENTATION`, `SYSTEM_CERTIFICATE_UNAVAILABLE`), `SCHEMA_INVALID` on a `rejected` record that was never sent because it does not meet the AEAT XML schema (fix it with a subsanation), or the warning code of a record accepted with errors; `null` when there is none. Without it you cannot tell a `4112` (presenter not enabled by AEAT) from a network failure.

is_blocked.description: Whether the record is BLOCKED: it is in `error` with NO automatic retry, so it does not go out again until someone reactivates it (fix the cause, then `POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/records/retry-blocked`, or `POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/records/{record}/retry` one by one), and it holds back the rest of the chain of the company. `false` for a record that retries by itself, with a backoff of at most one hour (art. 16.4 of Order HAC/1177/2024).

block_reason.description: Why the remission of the record is stopped, or `null`. `MISSING_CERTIFICATE`: your company has no usable certificate (missing, expired, revoked or for another tax ID). `MISSING_REPRESENTATION`: the remission mode is a third-party one and there is no current representation of the kind it asks for. `PRESENTER_NOT_ENABLED`: AEAT says the presenter is not enabled (`4112` or `3003`). `SUBMISSION_REJECTED`: AEAT rejected the submission for a client-side fault. These four need an action from you and make `is_blocked` true. `SYSTEM_CERTIFICATE_UNAVAILABLE`: the certificate of Factuarea that remits in the third-party modes is not available; it is on our side, does NOT block (`is_blocked` stays `false`) and the record retries by itself.

can_subsanar.description: Whether the record admits `POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/records/{record}/subsanar`: an `alta` that is ACCEPTED (or accepted with errors) or REJECTED by AEAT and is the last one of its invoice, which has not been annulled. It is the very rule that endpoint applies, so `true` guarantees it will not refuse the record by its state; whether there is something to correct and whether it changes a field of the hash (`requires_annulment`) is only known when you subsanar.

aeat_warning_requires_subsanation.description: For a record AEAT accepted with errors (`status` `accepted` with an `aeat_error_code`), whether AEAT requires a subsanation of that admissible error: every `2xxx` code does except `2004` (FechaHoraHusoGenRegistro) and `2009` (ClaveRegimen with IPSI), which AEAT exempts (AEAT «Validaciones» v1.2.2, §4.3.1). `false` for a warning that is not an AEAT code (`duplicate_annulled`: review the invoice instead). `null` when the record is not accepted with a warning.

VeriFactuRecord.title: VeriFactuRecord

VeriFactuStats.description: Aggregated summary of the VeriFactu records of the authenticated company: counts by status and breakdown by type. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/stats`.

submitted.description: Records submitted to AEAT (without a final response yet).

by_invoice_type.description: Count by AEAT invoice type (F1, F2, F3, …).

last_transmission_at.description: Date of the last transmission to AEAT, or `null` if there is none.

pending_incident_count.description: Records still waiting to be remitted to AEAT: `pending` (or without a state yet), `error` of ANY kind (those that retry by themselves and the blocked ones), `submitted` (in flight, or orphaned until the next sweep) and `rejected` records that have already been subsanados. NOT counted: `accepted`, `rejected` records still waiting for your correction, and sandbox (test mode) companies. The query filters never affect it. Art. 16 of Order HAC/1177/2024 requires the taxpayer to see how many records are pending.

blocked_incident_count.description: Of the pending records, the BLOCKED ones: `error` with NO automatic retry (missing certificate or representation, presenter not enabled by AEAT, or a client-side rejection). They do not go out until someone reactivates them (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/verifactu/records/retry-blocked`) and they hold back the chain of the company. It is a subset of `pending_incident_count`; the query filters never affect it.

oldest_pending_at.description: Generation timestamp of the oldest of the pending records counted by `pending_incident_count`, or `null` when there is none. The query filters never affect it.

VeriFactuStats.title: VeriFactuStats

status.description: Delivery status. `pending` (queued / in-flight), `delivered` (2xx received), `failed` (recoverable failure, will retry), `failed_permanently` (all attempts exhausted), `cancelled` (delivery aborted, terminal).

WebhookEndpoint.description: An HTTPS endpoint that receives webhook events. The secret is never exposed in this representation.

enabled_events.description: List of event types this endpoint subscribes to. `invoice.sent` is a deprecated alias of `invoice.issued` (same instant, same `data.object`): it is still accepted so existing endpoints keep working, but new integrations should subscribe to `invoice.issued`.

status.description: Status of the endpoint: `active` (it receives deliveries), `degraded` (every delivery of the last 24 hours failed: deliveries are paused until a `ping` succeeds) or `disabled` (turned off by you: it receives none).

api_version.description: Payload version (date-based, e.g. `2026-10-01`) pinned for the events delivered to this endpoint. An endpoint created without an explicit `api_version` is pinned at creation (`2026-10-01` when the effective REST version of the request is `2026-10-01` or later, `2026-05-22` otherwise). `null` only remains if it was cleared explicitly, and then the payload version of the default REST version (currently `2026-05-22`) applies, never the latest one. An endpoint pinned to a payload version before `2026-10-01` receives invoices in the previous vocabulary: `status: sent` for an issued invoice, `sent_at` equal to the issuance instant, and no `issued_at`, `is_sent` or `sent_via`.

timeout_seconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds applied when delivering to this endpoint (1–30). `null` means the system default applies.

degraded_since.description: Timestamp since which the endpoint is considered degraded (sustained delivery failures). `null` when healthy.

WeeklySchedule.description: A fixed weekly work schedule for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Defines, per weekday, the expected time ranges (from which the expected hours and the planned start time are derived). Its `mode` decides how balances are computed downstream: `validated` (the period is assumed fulfilled unless an exception) or `real_clocking` (only real clock-ins count).

id.description: Opaque identifier of the work schedule, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

name.description: Human-readable name of the schedule (e.g. `Jornada partida`).

mode.description: How the schedule computes balances: `validated` (period assumed fulfilled unless an exception) or `real_clocking` (only real clock-ins count).

week_pattern.description: Weekly pattern: one entry per configured weekday with its ordered, non-overlapping time ranges. A weekday absent from the list (or with an empty `ranges`) is a rest day.

ranges.description: Ordered, non-overlapping time ranges worked that day (empty = rest day).

weekly_hours.description: Total weekly hours derived from the sum of all time ranges in the pattern.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `active` (assignable) or `archived` (retired from use).

WeeklySchedule.title: WeeklySchedule

WooCommerceConnectionCheck.description: The outcome of testing the connection with one of your connected WooCommerce stores. The public `id` is the UUID v7 of the STORE that was tested, so you can tell which shop this diagnosis is about. Nothing is stored: this resource is a diagnosis, not a record. Read `reachable` and `credential_accepted` together — `reachable: false` means the shop did not answer, while `reachable: true` with `credential_accepted: false` means it answered and rejected the credential — and read `failure_code` for the concrete cause, which is what tells «your key is not valid» apart from «your REST API is not published».

id.description: UUID v7 of the store that was tested. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `woocommerce_connection_check` for this resource.

reachable.description: Whether the shop answered at all. `false` covers a timeout, a transport failure, a 5xx from the merchant hosting and a destination your company has not authorised for outbound traffic.

credential_accepted.description: Whether the shop accepted the consumer key and secret. Always `false` when `reachable` is `false`: we never got to ask.

store_version.description: WooCommerce version the shop reports, or `null` when it does not report one. Informational: nothing is gated on it.

api_version.description: WordPress version the shop reports, or `null` when it does not report one. WooCommerce does not publish any REST API version of its own — the version this connector speaks (`wc/v3`) is fixed on our side, not something the shop reports — so this field carries the version of WordPress, which is what serves `/wp-json/`, decides whether the route exists depending on the permalink setting and therefore explains most failures of this surface. Informational: nothing is gated on it.

failure_code.description: Code naming the concrete cause when the check did not succeed, or `null` when it did. Today `woocommerce_store_unreachable` (the shop did not answer — the only one worth retrying), `woocommerce_credentials_rejected` (the shop rejected the credential, or it could not be used) and `woocommerce_rest_route_missing` (the shop answered but its REST API is not published, usually because WordPress permalinks are on the plain setting). Not an exhaustive enumeration: new causes may appear without a breaking change, so treat an unknown value as a failure you cannot classify.

checked_at.description: When the check ran (ISO 8601). Nothing is cached: every call tests the shop again.

WooCommerceConnectionCheck.title: WooCommerceConnectionCheck

WorkdaySessionStatus.description: The derived state of an employee’s current workday for the Control Horario (time tracking) module, reconstructed from the open work span in the immutable ledger. There is no session table — the state is computed from the entries.

status.description: Derived workday state: `not_started`, `working`, `paused` or `finished`.

since.description: Instant of the last event of the open span (when the current state was entered), ISO 8601; `null` if the workday has not started.

last_entry_type.description: Type of the last event of the open span; `null` if the workday has not started.

WorkdaySessionStatus.title: WorkdaySessionStatus

PayloadTooLarge.description: The packaged download you asked for is too large to build, so nothing was generated and no file was left on the server. Two catalog codes carry this status, both with `error.type: invalid_request_error`: `export_document_cap_exceeded` (the request covers more documents than the cap for that artifact allows — narrow the date range or export in batches) and `export_byte_cap_exceeded` (the artifact would weigh more than the byte cap; `error.subcode` says whether it was rejected up front from the size estimate, `before_writing`, or aborted mid-packaging, `while_writing`, in which case the partial file was deleted and nothing is served). Retrying the same request unchanged returns the same error — ask for less, do not wait. A third, unrelated code shares this status on every write operation: `payload_too_large`, raised when the REQUEST body exceeds the 1 MB limit, which is about what you send and not about the size of what you asked to build.

ImportFileTooLarge.description: One of the uploaded files is larger than 5 MB, so nothing was read, classified or applied. The catalog code is `import_file_too_large` with `error.type: invalid_request_error`, and `error.param` names the offending file (`accounts_file` or `customers_file`). Split the file into several imports and send them one after another. The whole multipart request is also capped at 11 MB; above that the transport rejects it first with `payload_too_large`, before any file is inspected.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; the values of secret fields (`password`, `secret`…) count as part of the body, so retrying with a corrected secret under the same key is a different request, never the replay of the earlier answer. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency).

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Conditional request: send the `ETag` you stored from a previous response of this operation (quoted, as received) to get `304 Not Modified` without a body when the content has not changed. Omit it to always receive the full response.

FactuareaVersion.name: Factuarea-Version
FactuareaVersion.description: Pin the API version (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Stripe-style date versioning) for this request; omit to use the key's pinned version, or the latest if none. Unsupported version → `400 unsupported_api_version`; malformed → `400 parameter_invalid_format`. The effective version is echoed in the `Factuarea-Version` response header. See the [Versioning guide](/guides/versioning).

invoice_cajero_ticket_anonimo.summary: Unattended checkout · anonymous F2 ticket, paid
invoice_cajero_ticket_anonimo.description: A self-service terminal or vending machine issues a simplified invoice (`F2`) with no client, prices WITH VAT included, the payment recorded and the VeriFactu alta generated before responding. Here, a 5.00 € express car wash paid by card: `unit_price` is the FINAL price, so the API splits it into a 4.13 € base plus 0.87 € of VAT at 21 % and the invoice total is exactly the 5.00 € charged. Without `series_id` the ticket is numbered in the default series for simplified invoices of the company, created automatically the first time; an explicit series must be a simplified-invoice series (`invoice_kind: simplified`), otherwise `422` `series_invoice_kind_mismatch`. Identify the operation by `external_id`: a late retry returns the invoice already issued instead of duplicating it. The response carries the `verifactu` block (huella and QR), the `pdf` block and `public_url`.

invoice_cajero_simplificada_cualificada.summary: Unattended checkout · qualified simplified invoice (with client)
invoice_cajero_simplificada_cualificada.description: A simplified invoice that names the recipient: send `type: F2` WITH a `client_id` of your company. It is registered in VeriFactu as a qualified simplified invoice (`F1` with `FacturaSimplificadaArt7273`), so the recipient can deduct the VAT. `operation_on` records the day the operation took place when it differs from the issue date.

invoice_cajero_reenvio.summary: Unattended checkout · late retry by external_id
invoice_cajero_reenvio.description: The SAME body sent again after a network cut. Because `external_id` already belongs to an issued invoice with the same type and total, the API answers `200` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and the invoice already issued, completing the alta and the payment if they were missing. If the type or the total differ, it answers `409` `unattended_replay_mismatch`.

corrective_r1_error_fundado.description: R1 corrective invoice (well-founded error in law) that voids the whole invoice: `correction_code: R1`, `correction_type: full` and no `lines` (by differences, `TipoRectificativa I`: every original line copied back negated). Applies to full invoices F1/F3.

value.justification: Error fundado de derecho en la cuota repercutida de la factura original; se anula y rectifica la totalidad.
value.notes: Rectificativa total por error de derecho

corrective_r2_concurso.description: R2 corrective invoice (insolvency proceedings), `correction_code: R2`. Applies to full invoices F1/F3.

value.justification: Modificación de la base imponible por auto de declaración de concurso del destinatario (art. 80.Tres LIVA).

corrective_r3_incobrable.description: R3 corrective invoice (uncollectible receivables), `correction_code: R3`. Applies to full invoices F1/F3.

value.justification: Crédito total o parcialmente incobrable según los requisitos del art. 80.Cuatro LIVA (reclamación previa documentada).

corrective_r4_otras.description: R4 corrective invoice (other reasons) that corrects some amounts by differences: `correction_code: R4`, `correction_type: partial` and the adjustment `lines` (a negative quantity subtracts). Applies to full invoices F1/F3.

value.justification: Rectificación parcial por descuento posterior a la emisión sobre una de las líneas de la factura original.

lines.description: Descuento comercial posterior sobre el servicio de consultoría

corrective_substitution.summary: Substitution · replace with the correct version
corrective_substitution.description: Corrective invoice by SUBSTITUTION: `correction_type: full` and the FINAL `lines` of the correct invoice (no negative quantity). `correction_nature: S` is optional here — `full` with `lines` is a substitution by default — and is shown for clarity. VeriFactu registers it as `TipoRectificativa S` with `ImporteRectificacion` (base and tax of the original).

value.notes: Sustituye a la factura original: el precio pactado era 120 €, no 150 €

corrective_r5_simplificada.summary: R5 · correction of a simplified invoice
corrective_r5_simplificada.description: R5 corrective invoice (correction of a simplified invoice), `correction_code: R5`. Applies only to F2 — reachable thanks to the explicit `correction_code` contract (fiscal-expose-irpf-surcharge-rcode-invoice).

value.justification: Rectificación del importe de una factura simplificada (F2) emitida a consumidor final; corrige la cuota repercutida.

contact_company_dual_role.summary: Company with customer and supplier roles
contact_company_dual_role.description: Creates one canonical contact that can be selected in both sales and purchase documents.

product_physical.description: Creates a physical product with SKU, price and VAT via `tax_rate_id`.

product_service.description: Creates a service product billed per day.

quote_b2b_es.description: Creates a quote with one service line (21% VAT per line).

proforma_b2b_es.description: Creates a pro forma with one product line (21% VAT per line).

delivery_note_es.description: Creates a delivery note with shipping details and one product line.

recurring_invoice_monthly.description: Creates a monthly recurrence with a fixed fee (21% VAT per line).

webhook_endpoint_production.description: Creates a webhook endpoint subscribed to invoice events.

value.description: Webhook principal de producción.

product_update_price.description: PATCH-style update of a product (price + status).

bulk_delete_ids.description: Body of a bulk-delete operation (list of opaque UUID v7 identifiers).

product_bulk_update_stock.description: Body of the bulk-update-stock operation (several `set`/`increment`/`decrement` lines).

document_send_email.description: Body for emailing a document (invoice, quote, pro forma, delivery note): alternative recipient (`to`), copies (`cc`/`bcc`), subject and body. All fields are optional; if `to` is omitted, the client email is used.

document_public_link_update.description: Body for configuring the public link of a document. `action` (required): `activate` · `revoke` · `reset` · `extend`. With `action: extend`, `extend_days` extends the expiry (the actual limit is enforced by the plan).

employee_create.description: Full-time employee. `employment_type` (`full_time`/`part_time`), `contract_hours` (>0, ≤168), `hire_date` (`Y-m-d`) and `ccaa` (ISO 3166-2:ES) are required; `tax_id` and `job_title` are optional.

employee_update.description: Partial update: only the fields sent change. `hire_date` (`Y-m-d`) corrects the hire date; it cannot be later than `termination_date` (422 `parameter_invalid_value`, subcode `invalid_hire_date`) and changing it does not delete clock-ins or schedule assignments.

employee_deactivate.description: Deactivates (soft) an employee. `termination_date` (`Y-m-d`) is optional; when omitted, today applies.

employee_invitation_send.description: Employee invitation (the server sets the `employee` role). Only the email is sent.

time_entry_clock_in.description: Clock in. `employee_id` is the UUID v7 of the employee; `source` is `web` or `mobile`; `occurred_at` (ISO 8601) is optional (defaults to the server time).

time_entry_clock_out.description: Clock out. Same fields as the clock-in; `occurred_at` marks the end of the open work day.

time_entry_pause.description: Starts a pause within the open work day.

time_entry_resume.description: Resumes the work day after a pause.

time_entry_manual.description: Retroactive entry. `started_at`/`ended_at` (ISO 8601, end after start) and `reason` are required; `pauses` is an optional list of `{start, end}` intervals.

value.reason: El empleado olvidó fichar; jornada confirmada por su responsable.

time_correction_create.description: Correction request for a time entry. `kind` is `add_missing_entry`, `adjust_time` or `remove_entry`; `reason` is required. For `adjust_time`/`add_missing_entry`, `proposed.occurred_at` (ISO 8601, not in the future) is required.

value.reason: La hora de entrada real fue las 09:05, no las 09:30.

time_correction_approve.description: Approves a correction request. `note` is optional (the approver cannot be the requester).

value.note: Corrección verificada con el registro de acceso; se aprueba.

time_correction_reject.description: Rejects a correction request. `reason` is required.

value.reason: La corrección no coincide con el registro de acceso al edificio.

monthly_time_record_close_create.description: Monthly close of the time record. `year` (2000-2100) and `month` (1-12) of the period to close; the month must be over.

time_tracking_settings_update.description: Time tracking settings. `overtime_basis` is `weekly` or `daily`; thresholds are in minutes (optional; `null` derives them from the schedule); the missed clock-in reminder is set with `clock_in_reminder_*`.

work_schedule_create.description: Weekly schedule. `mode` is `validated` (validated work day) or `real_clocking` (actual clocking). `week_pattern` lists the days (`day` 1=Monday .. 7=Sunday) with their `HH:MM`–`HH:MM` ranges (an empty list is a rest day). A range can be flexible (`flexible: true` + `required_minutes`).

work_schedule_update.description: The update REPLACES the whole schedule: `name`, `mode` and `week_pattern` are required (there is no partial update of the pattern).

work_schedule_assign.description: Assigns the schedule to an employee with an effective-dated assignment. `employee_id` (UUID v7) and `effective_from` (`Y-m-d`). If the previous open assignment has not started yet and the new one starts on or before its start, the previous one is voided instead of returning 422.

work_schedule_unassign.description: Closes the open assignment of the schedule to an employee. `effective_to` (`Y-m-d`) is optional; when omitted, today applies. If the assignment has not started yet and `effective_to` is on or before its start, it is voided (kept in the history as an empty span) instead of returning 422.

absence_type_create.description: Absence type. Every field is required: `measurement_unit` (`days`/`hours`), a hexadecimal `color` (`#RRGGBB`) and `visibility` (`everyone`/`managers_only`).

absence_type_update.description: Partial update: each omitted field keeps its current value.

absence_policy_create.description: Absence policy. `allowance_type` is `limited` or `unlimited`; `allowance_days` is required only when it is `limited`. `accrual_method` is `annual` or `monthly`. `absence_type_ids` is the list (possibly empty) of the UUID v7 of the linked types.

absence_policy_update.description: Partial update: each omitted field keeps its value. When `absence_type_ids` is sent, it replaces the linked types entirely.

absence_policy_assign.description: Assigns the policy to one or more employees in bulk. `employee_ids` is a list of UUID v7 with at least one item.

absence_policy_unassign.description: Removes the policy from employees in bulk. `employee_ids` is a list of UUID v7 with at least one item.

absence_policy_carryover.description: Configures the carryover of unused balance. `carryover_type` is `none`/`capped`/`unlimited`; `carryover_max_days` is required with `capped`. The expiry pair (`carryover_expiry_month` + `carryover_expiry_day`) goes together: both or neither.

absence_request_create.description: Creates an absence request. In v1 `employee_id` is REQUIRED (UUID v7). `absence_type_id` is the UUID v7 of the type; the `start_date`/`end_date` range is `Y-m-d` with end ≥ start; `note` is optional.

absence_request_approve.description: Approves an absence request. `note` is optional; the approver cannot be the requester.

value.note: Aprobada; saldo suficiente para el periodo solicitado.

absence_request_reject.description: Rejects an absence request. `reason` is required.

value.reason: Coincide con el cierre trimestral; por favor, solicita otras fechas.

post.description: Factuarea POSTs this body to every subscribed endpoint when a subscribed event occurs. The receiver verifies the `Factuarea-Signature` HMAC header and SHALL respond with a 2xx status to acknowledge the delivery. A 5xx, a timeout and the client errors 408, 425 and 429 are retried with exponential backoff until the attempts run out; any other 4xx ends the delivery for good, with no automatic retry.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Always `application/json`.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw request body, used to verify the delivery is authentic. Format `t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>`; while the previous secret of a rotation is still valid it carries a second `v1` (`t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>,v1=<signature of the previous secret>`), and the delivery is authentic when any of them matches.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Event-Id
parameters.description: Stable identifier of the event (UUID v7). Identical across redeliveries of the same event.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Event-Type
parameters.description: Type of the delivered event, e.g. `invoice.paid`.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Delivery-Id
parameters.description: Identifier of the delivery (UUID v7): one event sent to one endpoint. It stays the same across the automatic retries of that delivery and across a manual retry of an account endpoint; it changes when a company endpoint delivery is replayed (the replay creates a new delivery of the same event) and from one endpoint to another. To deduplicate, use `Factuarea-Event-Id` or `Idempotency-Key`, not this header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Standard idempotency header. Its value is identical to `Factuarea-Event-Id` (the stable UUID v7 of the event), so a receiver can deduplicate redeliveries using the industry-standard header.

200.description: The receiver acknowledged the delivery. Any 2xx status is treated as success; the body is ignored.

4XX.description: The receiver rejected the delivery. `408`, `425` and `429` are retried with exponential backoff; any other 4xx is final: the delivery is marked `failed_permanently` and is not retried automatically.

5XX.description: The receiver failed to process the delivery. Factuarea retries with exponential backoff until the attempts run out.
